The Fifth Valley is just ahead!" Lev exclaimed when he saw a certain mountain on the horizon.

chapters.title: Chapter 2362 Entering the Fifth Valley
paragraphs: "We'll arrive at the Fifth Valley after we pass that mountain range," Lev commented shortly after seeing it.
"To think it took four years just to reach the Fifth Valley. This place is a little too big," Yuan sighed out loud.

"Considering how many have been exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley, it's actually beneficial for those of us in here that this place is so vast. Otherwise, we'd be constantly fighting for territory," said Lev. "That being said, since we're all Immortal, we won't die of natural causes, so the population of exiles will continue to grow for an eternity. Sooner or later, we'll have to fight, whether we want to or not. Food is already scarce as it is, after all."
Since demons were immortal by nature, and every being in the Demonic Realm was a demon, the only way to reduce their population was through killing one another.
And because of that very nature, they required an immense amount of energy to sustain themselves—whether by devouring magical beasts or... other demons.
While they won't die if they don't eat, it would mess with their mental stability or, in the worst case, cause them to lose control, thus turning them into a Forsaken.
"Before we enter the Fifth Valley, I must warn you about something," Lev suddenly said as they closed in on the mountain range.

"We haven't been attacked so far because I am familiar with pretty much everyone in the Fourth Valley, and since your presence is nonexistent, they have no reason to approach us. However, things will be different in the Fifth Valley. Not only are the Exiles there more powerful than me, but there's a high chance they'll attack us."
"And before you ask, no, I cannot conceal my presence as perfectly as you."
"Don't worry about it," Yuan calmly responded. "If we are attacked, I will deal with it."

"I don't mean to be rude, but where is your confidence coming from? You're just a first-level False God. The Exiles dwelling within the Fifth Valley are between the fourth and fifth levels. Are Sealers really that powerful—that you can ignore the differences in cultivation?"
In the Demonic Realm, cultivators at the God Ascension level are called False Gods.
"Well, what do you know about Sealers?" Yuan questioned.

"I know that they were a powerful force that existed for a short period when Supreme Ruler Dena was still in power, and that they have a special ability that allows them to seal others. Unfortunately, that's all I know since information on them is restricted. In fact, it's forbidden to talk about them outside of this place."
"Again with that..." Yuan shook his head, silently wondering who was trying so hard to control such information.
Yuan couldn't help but recall his previous visit to the Demonic Realm, back when he was Tian Chengyu.
His first impression had been dreadful, largely due to the hatred he once harbored toward demons.
However, over time, the situation gradually improved, and he even befriended many demons. Among them was Supreme Ruler Dena, one of the three supreme rulers who governed the entire Demonic Realm.
"If you don't mind me asking, what do you intend to do after meeting Supreme Ruler Dena? Since she's now a Forsaken, I doubt you'll even be able to have a proper conversation."
Yuan casually shrugged.
"I'll figure it out once I meet her."
Lev was left speechless. He couldn't believe how careless Yuan was being about meeting one of the most dangerous entities in their world.
A few days later, they crossed the mountain range and officially entered the Fifth Valley.
And not even an hour into the Fifth Valley, Yuan and Lev were attacked by a fourth-level False God Lower Demon.
"A first-level and second-level False God dares to enter the Fifth Valley?! You're only begging me to eat you!"
"A Forsaken!" Lev exclaimed.
"Is that so?"
Hearing this, Yuan retrieved the Demon Devouring Sword from his spatial ring and, without hesitation, swung it at the incoming demon.
When the Demon Devouring Sword appeared, both Lev and the Forsaken demon suddenly felt their strength vanish into thin air.
"What is going on?!" The Forsaken exclaimed in shock.
"You're dead, that's what."

In the next moment, Yuan swung his sword. Infused with Demon Sealing Aura and amplified by Supreme Sword Aura, the blade cleaved through the demon instantly, splitting it cleanly in half before sealing it.
However, the demon was not dead yet.
"Devour," Yuan muttered before the demon could recover.

Suddenly, a massive hole appeared in the demon's bisected body, as if something had taken an enormous bite out of it. Before the demon could even comprehend what was happening, the rest of its body was completely devoured.
Despite witnessing everything from beginning to end, Lev failed to comprehend what had just happened. He could only stare at Yuan with a bewildered expression.
Though he had no idea what Yuan had done to the Forsaken demon, Lev silently swore to himself that he would never offend Yuan—no matter the cost.
"Let's continue," Yuan said calmly, sheathing his sword before flying onward as though nothing had happened.
Lev swallowed nervously and followed behind. Though he wanted to ask what had just occurred, fear kept his mouth shut.
'He killed a fourth-level Forsaken just like that?! If he wanted to, he could've easily killed all of us back then, and we wouldn't even know it happened!' he cried inwardly.
A few hours later, another demon attacked them.
"Stay away or you'll regret it!" Lev warned the approaching demon.
"Hahah! Who the hell do you think you're trying to scare with that cultivation?! You'll be my first meal in a million years!"
"Is this idiot a Forsaken?" Yuan asked.
Lev shook his head, "No..."
"In that case..."
[Swords of Eternal Torment!]
Several golden swords of light materialized in the sky above the demon before plunging downward, impaling it and pinning its body to the ground.
"AHHH! IT HURTS! IT HURTTTSSS!" The demon immediately cried out in agony, its scream so loud that it shook the air around them.

chapters.title: Chapter 2363 Scarecrow
paragraphs: Lev stared at the demon pinned to the ground by Yuan's Swords of Eternal Torment, a dazed expression plastered on his face.
"Wait... pain? It's painful?" he suddenly muttered, realizing the strange remark.
'He's actually feeling pain?!' Lev cried inwardly. 'But our pain tolerance is so high that even being thrown into a shredder wouldn't make us feel anything!'
After allowing the demon to endure a few moments of agony, Yuan deactivated the swords' ability and casually made a gesture with his hand.
In the next instant, the demon was lifted off the ground and dragged into the air—still impaled by the swords embedded in his body.
"W-What do you plan on doing with him?" Lev asked in a fearful voice.
"I'm going to use him to make our journey more smooth," Yuan calmly replied, refusing to elaborate.
"What have you done to me?! Let me go!"
Meanwhile, the demon struggled desperately to free himself from the swords. However, no matter how much he twisted or pulled, they refused to budge, as if they had fused with his body.
Seeing this, Yuan activated the swords' ability once more.
"AHHHH!"
Agony surged through the demon's body again, forcing another ear-piercing scream from his throat.
"The less you talk, the less painful it will be," Yuan said in a cold voice.
The demon wanted to cry but had no tears, and he reluctantly nodded in silence.
"Let's continue forward," Yuan said to Lev, who was still trying to figure out what Yuan was planning.
A few hours later, Lev sensed another presence approaching them.
However, before he could even warn Yuan, a loud scream suddenly tore through the air, startling him.
He quickly turned toward the source of the scream, and sure enough, it came from the demon Yuan had captured and forced to follow them.
'Don't tell me he's—!'
A chilling realization crept into Lev's bones the moment he understood why Yuan had dragged the demon along with them.
'He's using him like a scarecrow... to drive others away!' Lev cried inwardly.
Even though the demon attacked them first, Lev couldn't help but pity him.

Sure enough, when the approaching presence heard the demon's agonized screams and saw the dreadful sight of an impaled demon being dragged through the air, they immediately turned around and fled at twice their original speed.
However, they didn't leave completely. Instead, they lingered at a safe distance, observing the situation with clear curiosity.
Using this method, Yuan and Lev were able to travel in peace for several months. Unfortunately, their strange spectacle had also drawn a growing audience of demons quietly following behind them.
"Who the fuck is that crazy bastard? He's dragging Dune around while torturing him!"
"Do you think Dune is genuinely feeling pain, or is he merely acting for some reason?"
"I don't know, but his screams are real enough to send shivers down my spine, no matter how many times I've heard them."
"Poor guy. I wonder what he did to offend that madman."
"I have never witnessed such savagery in all my life..."
"Look at his perfect appearance. He's definitely a noble."
"But what would a noble be doing so deep inside the Deprived Crimson Valley?"
After using the demon as a scarecrow for an entire year, Yuan also started feeling bad about it, so he decided to release the demon.
"Thanks for your assistance for the past year," Yuan said as he completely deactivated Swords of Eternal Torment.
The demon coughed up a mouthful of blood when Yuan made it sound like he volunteered to help them. However, he didn't dare to correct Yuan and simply said, "It was a pleasure..."
The moment he was freed, the demon spun around and fled at full speed, running as though death itself were chasing him, completely ignoring the group of demons signaling to him from afar.
Seeing that the demon had no intention of stopping for them, several of the demons broke away from the group and chased after him.
"Hey! Dune! What the hell was that about?!"
"Did you really feel pain? Or were you only pretending?!"
"What did it feel like?!
Since demons were incapable of feeling pain, the concept itself naturally stirred their curiosity.
"Fuck! Get away from me! I don't want to talk about it!" The demon named Dune shouted at them.
"If you're so curious, go attack that fucking crazy bastard yourselves! I bet he's already looking for my replacement!"
Hearing this, several demons actually paused to consider the idea. Since they had never experienced pain before, the thought of feeling it for the first time strangely intrigued them.
Eventually, a few of them turned around and flew at Yuan while exuding killing intent.
"I don't believe that you can actually inflict pain on us!"
"If you can really hurt us, I'd really like to experience it myself!" "You want to experience pain?" Yuan's expression remained nonchalant as he watched three demons soaring toward him.
"Then I'll let you experience so much of it that you'll never want to experience it ever again!"
[Swords of Eternal Torment!]
A dozen swords glowing with golden brilliance materialized around the demons, surrounding them from all sides.
Although the demons could have easily avoided the attack, they chose not to, allowing the swords to impale their bodies.
The instant the swords drove through their bodies, a foreign sensation erupted within them, overwhelming their senses and plunging them into unimaginable pain.
"AAAGH!"
"WHAT IS THIS FEELING?!"
"IS THIS PAIN?! IT HURTS LIKE HELL!"
Even as the unbearable pain overwhelmed them, not a single demon asked Yuan to stop.

Lev swallowed nervously as he watched the demons willingly subject themselves to such agony. Yet at the same time, he found himself growing intrigued. The concept of pain was so foreign to demons that it held a strange allure.
Yuan was no stranger to their masochistic behavior. In the past, many demons would deliberately provoke him, hoping to experience pain for the first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 2364 The Sixth Valley
paragraphs: With three willing scarecrows now in tow, Yuan resumed his journey toward the Sixth Valley. Whenever a demon approached with hostile intent, he would activate the swords, and the scarecrows' agonized screams would echo like a warning siren.

However, while most demons either fled or joined the growing crowd spectating Yuan, some ignored the warnings entirely and attacked anyway. Without exception, they were all Forsaken—demons who feared nothing.
Seeing this, Yuan did not hesitate to strike them down with the Demon Devouring Sword.
Just as he had done with the first one, he cleaved the demon in half before allowing the sword to consume its body.
Upon witnessing Yuan slaughter the Forsaken, the demons trailing him trembled subconsciously, their eyes flickering with growing fear. However, it wasn't Yuan that made them fearful.
"What kind of weapon is that? My senses are screaming at me to run away from it!"

The demons couldn't comprehend why the sword in Yuan's hand filled them with such unease. What they didn't know was that the Demon Devouring Sword had devoured countless demons over the ages. By absorbing their power, the blade had developed an oppressive aura that caused other demons to instinctively feel inferior before it.
"So he can kill a Forsaken with such ease..."
The demons swallowed nervously, their curiosity for Yuan's identity growing stronger than ever. Yet, none of them dared to approach him.
Time passed swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, several more years had passed. "We're approaching the Sixth Valley," said Lev when he noticed the change in the atmosphere.

There were no mountain ranges separating the Fifth Valley from the Sixth Valley, but there was a drastic change in atmosphere, and when the demons following Yuan sensed it, they began slowing down until they came to a complete stop.
"What's wrong with them?" Yuan asked Lev, who also appeared to be struggling against something.
"Y-You can't sense it?" Lev looked at him with a bewildered face.
Yuan raised an eyebrow and focused on his surroundings. Yet, he was unable to sense anything out of the ordinary.
'Perhaps it's something that can only be sensed by demons...' he thought to himself.
"You might not know this, but inside the Deprived Crimson Valley, most of the Forsakens dwell within the Sixth Valley and beyond, and only the weakest ones wander to the other valleys."
"You might not know this, but inside the Deprived Crimson Valley, most of the Forsakens dwell within the Sixth Valley and beyond, and only the weakest ones wander to the other valleys.
"Is there a reason they gather at the Sixth Valley?" Yuan asked, finding the phenomenon somewhat intriguing.
Lev shook his head. "Honestly, we don't know. Forsaken think and act differently from the rest of us, but for so many of them to gather in one place, there has to be a reason."

He then shrugged. "Unfortunately, no one's brave enough to find out. Getting close to them is far too dangerous. On top of that, many fear their condition might be contagious, so most demons keep their distance."
"Contagious?" Yuan wore a puzzled expression. "When did that become a concern?"

When he had visited the Demonic Realm as Tian Chenyu, it was widely believed that the Forsaken had become what they were because they had been abandoned by their God—hence their name. Since it wasn't considered an illness, very few demons had ever feared it might be contagious.
"Well... more and more people are turning into a Forsaken these days, so..."
Yuan shook his head and said, "Although I cannot guarantee you that you will never become a Forsaken, I can guarantee you that it's not contagious."
"Anyway, let's enter the Sixth Valley. Even if Forsakens attack us, I'll make sure to protect you."
"Alright..."
After witnessing Yuan effortlessly execute multiple Forsaken, Lev no longer doubted his abilities. That said, he was still nervous about entering the Sixth Valley, something he had never done before.
After taking a moment to resolve himself, Lev followed Yuan into the Sixth Valley while trying his best to ignore the oppressive and dreadful pressure emitting from the place.
"Hey... if I ever turn into a Forsaken, can you kill me?" Lev suddenly asked.
"Sure," Yuan replied without hesitation. His immediate answer both surprised and relieved Lev.
"Thank you. I'd rather die than spend an eternity living like a beast."
Suddenly, the presence of two sixth-level False Gods appeared in the distance.
"They're here! Forsakens!" Lev warned.
Yuan, who noticed their presence before Lev, was already prepared to confront them.
However, when the demons arrived, they did not attack immediately. Instead, they stopped at a distance and silently observed them—or more precisely, the Demon Devouring Sword in Yuan's grasp.
'Oh? Are they wary of the Demon Devouring Sword? Is it instinct, or is it something else?' Yuan wondered.
After lingering for a few moments, the two demons suddenly turned around and left without a word, leaving Yuan and Lev puzzled.
"What was that about?" Lev wondered out loud.
Yuan didn't say anything.
Then, after a moment of silence, he said, "You should hide for a bit."
"Huh?"
Before Lev could even process Yuan's words, multiple powerful presences appeared out of thin air.
"W-What a strong presence!" Lev felt as if his entire body was being crushed by a mountain.
"Leave before it's too late," Yuan warned him again.
Without hesitation, Lev descended to the ground before going into hiding.
A moment after Lev left, a group of demons appeared on the horizon, steadily approaching Yuan. There were around a dozen of them, with a single demon leading from the front.
Unlike the others—who were clearly Lower Demons—the one leading them had a black crystal embedded in the center of his chest, marking him as an Elite Demon.
Intrigued by their purpose, Yuan didn't immediately start slaughtering them and waited for them to act first.
However, instead of doing anything, they merely stared at the Demon Devouring Sword.
"Interested?" Yuan suddenly lifted his sword in their direction and asked, starting the conversation.
"Where did you acquire that sword?" The Elite Demon questioned with a wary look on his face, as if he knew about the Demon Devouring Sword.

"Well... more and more people are turning into a Forsaken these days, so..."
Yuan shook his head and said, "Although I cannot guarantee you that you will never become a Forsaken, I can guarantee you that it's not contagious."
"Anyway, let's enter the Sixth Valley.
Even if Forsakens attack us, I'll make sure to protect you."
"Alright..."
After witnessing Yuan effortlessly execute multiple Forsaken, Lev no longer doubted his abilities.
That said, he was still nervous about entering the Sixth Valley, something he had never done before.
After taking a moment to resolve himself, Lev followed Yuan into the Sixth Valley while trying his best to ignore the oppressive and dreadful pressure emitting from the place.
"Hey... if I ever turn into a Forsaken, can you kill me?" Lev suddenly asked.
"Sure," Yuan replied without hesitation.
His immediate answer both surprised and relieved Lev.
"Thank you.
I'd rather die than spend an eternity living like a beast."
Suddenly, the presence of two sixth-level False Gods appeared in the distance.
"They're here!
Forsakens!" Lev warned.
Yuan, who noticed their presence before Lev, was already prepared to confront them.
However, when the demons arrived, they did not attack immediately.
Instead, they stopped at a distance and silently observed them—or more precisely, the Demon Devouring Sword in Yuan's grasp.
'Oh?
Are they wary of the Demon Devouring Sword?
Is it instinct, or is it something else?' Yuan wondered.
After lingering for a few moments, the two demons suddenly turned around and left without a word, leaving Yuan and Lev puzzled.
"What was that about?" Lev wondered out loud.
Yuan didn't say anything.
Then, after a moment of silence, he said, "You should hide for a bit."
"Huh?"
Before Lev could even process Yuan's words, multiple powerful presences appeared out of thin air.
"W-What a strong presence!" Lev felt as if his entire body was being crushed by a mountain.
"Leave before it's too late," Yuan warned him again.
Without hesitation, Lev descended to the ground before going into hiding.
A moment after Lev left, a group of demons appeared on the horizon, steadily approaching Yuan.
There were around a dozen of them, with a single demon leading from the front.
Unlike the others—who were clearly Lower Demons—the one leading them had a black crystal embedded in the center of his chest, marking him as an Elite Demon.
Intrigued by their purpose, Yuan didn't immediately start slaughtering them and waited for them to act first.
However, instead of doing anything, they merely stared at the Demon Devouring Sword.
"Interested?" Yuan suddenly lifted his sword in their direction and asked, starting the conversation.
"Where did you acquire that sword?" The Elite Demon questioned with a wary look on his face, as if he knew about the Demon Devouring Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 2365 The Seventh Valley
paragraphs: "Why do you care where I acquired it?" Yuan responded to the Elite Demon inquiring about the Demon Devouring Sword.
The Elite Demon narrowed his eyes and spoke in a cold voice, "That thing should not exist in this world. If you hand it over willingly, I'll spare your life."
Yuan couldn't help but let out a cold chuckle.
"Do you even know what this sword is?" he questioned.
"That's the Demon Devouring Sword... isn't it?" the Elite Demon said calmly.
"Although there's almost no chance that it's the real one, I won't take that risk. That thing is a threat to our entire race."
"Whether it's real or fake... you'll find out very soon."
The moment Yuan showed even the slightest sign of resistance, the demons behind the Elite Demon sprang into action, swiftly surrounding him from every direction.
"Kill him and bring that sword to me," the Elite Demon commanded.
In the next instant, fifteen Lower Demons attacked Yuan simultaneously.
Yuan merely shook his head as he activated the Demon Sealing Zone, instantly entrapping the demons in its domain.
Before the demons could even get close, their bodies were frozen stiff without being sealed.
"What did he do?! I cannot move my body!"
The demons tried to fight against the invisible force, but even with their superior cultivation, they could only make their fingers twitch slightly.
"This power! Demon Sealing Aura! So you were a Sealer!" The Elite Demon exclaimed in shock after realizing their situation.
"Oh? You seem to know a lot more than the others." Yuan calmly approached the Elite Demon and asked, "Then do you know the name Tian Chenyu? Or Divine Paragon?"
"T-Tian Chenyu...?"
The Elite Demon wore a puzzled look on his face before it suddenly turned blank, as if he'd gone into a daze. Then, without warning, he started screaming.
"AHHH!"
Sensing something was wrong, Yuan immediately backed away from the Elite Demon.
The following moment, the Elite Demon's body started to bloat rapidly, swelling as if something inside him were forcing it outward.
In mere moments, he had ballooned to a grotesque size, resembling that of a hot balloon.
Then, with a violent pop, his body burst apart.
Not just Yuan, but even Lev and the other demons were shocked by the Elite Demon's random death, something they'd never seen before.
'What the hell? He died after hearing my name?' Yuan tried to process what had happened.
Then, he turned to look at the Lower Demons and asked, "Do you know Tian Chenyu or the Divine Paragon?"
He weakened their restrictions so they could move.
Immediately, they all shook their heads.
"Then what do you know about this sword? And what was your purpose just now?"
"W-We were only following his orders! We know nothing about the sword!" They exclaimed.
Yuan focused his gaze on the two demons from the beginning and said, "You know nothing about the sword, yet you were able to recognize it?"

"That's because our boss would talk about it all the time! He said that he'd witnessed its prowess when he was outside the Deprived Crimson Valley and that if he had it, he'd be able to conquer this world!"
Yuan sighed.
"What a stupid reason." Yuan shook his head.
"Anyways, let's get this over with."
Without another word, he slaughtered all of the demons before feeding them to the Demon Devouring Sword.
"You can stop hiding now," Yuan said to Lev afterward.
A few moments later, Lev emerged from his hiding spot and asked, "What was that about?"
Yuan shrugged.
There was definitely something happening within the Demonic Realm, but he had no clue what.
'Hopefully, Supreme Ruler Dena will have some answers for me,' he sighed inwardly.

They continued their journey, and over the next several years, they would encounter hundreds of Forsakens. However, none of them would recognize the Demon Devouring Sword or the name Tian Chenyu and simply attacked on sight.
Eventually, they arrived at the Seventh Valley.
"So this is what the Seventh Valley looks like..." Lev muttered to himself as he surveyed the surroundings in awe.
The endless plains of crimson grass had disappeared, replaced by patches of black and purple flowers scattered across the land.
The atmosphere itself was overwhelming. A crushing pressure weighed down on Lev's body, making it difficult for him to even move.

"At this rate, I won't be able to go any further than the Seventh Valley even if I wanted to," he said to Yuan, who appeared to be completely nonchalant, almost as if the pressure was nonexistent to him.
"Let me try something," said Yuan.
He suddenly activated Demon Sealing Zone, forming a domain around Lev like a barrier. However, instead of restricting him, it protected him from the oppressive presence.
"Wow! I don't feel the pressure anymore!" Lev exclaimed with excitement. "Is there anything you can't do?!"
Yuan smiled and said, "If you feel fine, let's get going."
Soon, they encountered their first Forsaken in the Seventh Valley, and it was another Lower Demon. However, it had the cultivation of an eighth-level False God.
If they were still in the Nine Heavens, this Forsaken would've been a catastrophe.
'The demons these days are much stronger than before.' Yuan thought to himself after realizing this. However, if he considered how much time had passed since his last visit, this was only natural.
Fortunately for him, a demon's cultivation meant little in the face of Demon Sealing Aura.

It might require a little more effort and time, but in the end, even an eight-level False God, which is equivalent to the eighth-level God Ascension, ended up being devoured by the Demon Devouring Sword.

"If all of the demons in the Seventh Valley are already between the seventh and ninth level of False God, are we going to encounter True Gods in the Eighth Valley? What about the Ninth Valley?" Yuan asked Lev.
A True God in the Demonic Realm was essentially a Cultivation God in the Nine Heavens. It was an existence that even Yuan was wary of.

chapters.title: Chapter 2366 True Chaotic Qi
paragraphs: Hearing Yuan's question, Lev pondered for a moment before responding, "From what I've heard, all of the True Gods dwell within the Ninth Valley and the Final Valley. Unfortunately, I don't know anything about the Eighth Valley." He silently stared at Yuan for a moment before continuing, "You know... it's not too late to turn around and go back..."
Yuan smiled and said, "If we do encounter a True God, I will have to get a little serious, but we will be fine."
Lev's jaw dropped as he asked, "Have you even fought seriously once since we started our journey?"
"What do you think?" "Uh... no?" Yuan silently smiled.

As they drew closer to the Eighth Valley, the Forsaken they encountered grew increasingly powerful. Eventually, the Lower Demons disappeared altogether, and only Elite Demons and Superior Demons would appear.
"I have never seen so many Black Cores in my life!" Lev swallowed nervously as Superior Demons showed up one after another.

In the Demonic Realm, the ranking system used to categorize demon ranks did not exist. Instead, demons were identified by their crystals. Superior Demons, who possessed black crystals, were known as Black Cores, while Lower Demons were referred to as Crimson Cores.
Of course, there was still a social hierarchy. Demons with red crystals were regarded as ordinary commoners, while those with black crystals were considered elites.

Demons whose appearance closely resembled that of ordinary humans were usually considered nobles, as many believed these forms reflected the original appearance of their ancestors. For this reason, some demons naturally assumed Yuan belonged to that class. Eventually, they arrived at the borders of the Eighth Valley. Although it had taken them nearly thirty years to reach this point, only a month had passed in the Nine Heavens.
Yuan and Lev halted at the edge of the Eighth Valley.
It appeared to be raining, but the rain was far from normal. Dark droplets of black liquid fell from the sky, each one carrying a familiar and unsettling aura.
'This is... Chaotic Essence!' Yuan suddenly extended his arm toward the rain, but when Lev saw this, he hastily pulled Yuan back and shouted, "Are you crazy?! Do you not know what that is?!"
"It's just rain, though?"

"Of course not! This is not ordinary rain! It's a Corruption Shower! And those who are contaminated by the liquid are more likely to turn into a Forsaken!" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this and said, "Isn't this just another rumor? Like Forsaken being contagious."
"No, it's not just a rumor," said Lev.

"In a certain experiment, they had a group of one thousand people drenched in a Corruption Shower, and not even a year later, more than half of them turned into Forsaken!" "Is that so? In any case, I'll be fine." Yuan said as he reached his arm into the rain, soaking it with the black liquid.

Lev watched with a nervous face, but Yuan remained as nonchalant as ever. If anything, he was quite excited inwardly. After all, he was able to absorb the Chaotic Essence from the Corruption Shower, and his second cultivation, which had stopped at the Chaotic Immortal Realm, was starting to show progress again.
"Does this rain go on forever?" Yuan turned to ask Lev, who quickly shook his head.
"No, they usually stop after a few years."
"Then I cannot waste this opportunity."
Without another word, Yuan entered the Corruption Shower, completely drenching himself in it.
"My lord!" Lev cried out loud.
"Wait for me. I'm going to cultivate for a bit," said Yuan.
"Cultivate?! In the Corruption Shower?! That's reckless!"
Lev tried to convince Yuan to come back out, but Yuan completely ignored him and spent the next seven years cultivating in the Corruption Shower.
Upon reaching the God Ascension Realm, Yuan gained the ability to perceive Celestial Qi with ease. And for the first time, he also sensed a familiar power within the Chaotic Essence.
While it wasn't the same as Celestial Qi, the power it contained felt remarkably similar.
'What is this? I never sensed anything like this, even when I was Tian Yi, the Immortal Monarch.' Yuan thought to himself.

Even though he'd created multiple Chaotic Hearts as the Immortal Monarch, he'd never sensed this sort of energy in Chaotic Essence. 'Now that I think about it, I think the Primal Monarch had mentioned something like this in the past...'
Yuan thought long and hard about what the Primal Monarch told him, but he was unable to recall such a memory for some reason.
In the end, he stopped thinking and focused on studying this new energy.
After spending five whole years studying the new energy, Yuan received a notification.
<You have discovered the existence of True Chaotic Qi>
<Your comprehension of True Chaotic Qi has improved significantly>

At the end of his seven-year cultivation, Yuan not only deepened his understanding of True Chaotic Qi, but his second cultivation also broke through Chaotic Immortal and entered Early Chaotic Supreme.
Despite that, he was unable to actually utilize True Chaotic Qi.
If he had more time, it might've been possible, but alas, the Corruption Shower ended.
"Hey... are you... okay?" Lev cautiously approached Yuan, fearing that he might have turned into a Forsaken.
Yuan looked at him and said, "I am fine."
"Seriously? You don't feel off? Even slightly?"
Yuan nodded.
Some time later, Lev followed Yuan into the Eighth Valley, and they immediately continued moving toward the Ninth Valley.

Even though Yuan assured him that everything was fine, Lev remained on edge. If someone as powerful as Yuan were to become a Forsaken, it wouldn't just spell disaster for Lev—it would threaten every demon in existence.
"It's been a while since we encountered a Forsaken," Yuan remarked a few weeks into the Eighth Valley without any encounters.
"Why does it sound like you want to encounter them?" Lev shook his head and sighed. "There's a good chance we might run into a True God, you know."
Just as the words left his mouth, a crushing pressure suddenly descended upon them, suffocating the air around them.

chapters.title: Chapter 2367 Killing a True God
paragraphs: "T-This presence! It's a True God!" The moment Lev sensed this oppressive aura, he immediately descended from the sky and went into hiding without even needing Yuan to tell him.
Not even a full second after Lev left, a silhouette slowly approached Yuan from a distance, its figure exuding an unfathomable aura that twisted and wrapped the space around them.

"In my fifty billion years of experience in this place, this is the first time I've seen a first-level False God who is bold enough to trespass into this domain meant for real Gods," remarked the demon, who had a unique appearance that looked half human and half demon.
Yuan calmly replied, "To call it trespassing, you'd have to own this place."
"Oh? And you even dare to talk back?"
In the next instant, Yuan sensed a powerful wave of Celestial Qi rushing toward him. However, it was clear that the attack wasn't meant to kill him—it was simply meant to intimidate.

In response, Yuan also released some of his Celestial Qi for the first time, and despite only being at the first level of God Ascension, his Celestial Qi was strong enough to rival that of the True God.
Seeing its Celestial Qi being destroyed by Yuan, the True God expressed surprise on their face.
"I see why you dare to come here. Unfortunately for you, that wasn't even half of my true power."
As they spoke, an even more powerful pressure suddenly descended, bearing down on Yuan like a colossal mountain.
Without a word, Yuan mixed his Chaotic Essence with his Celestial Qi, causing it to explode tremendously, even overwhelming the True God for a good moment.
"What is that power?" The True God narrowed their gaze at Yuan, looking befuddled.
"Are you just going to stand there, or are you actually going to fight me?" Yuan asked, beckoning the True God.
"Interesting. Let's see what you have up your sleeves. I am also interested in that power."
The next moment, the True God vanished from his position like a ghost before appearing right in front of Yuan.
"Blood Arts, Hell's Scythe!"
The True God condensed his own blood into a massive scythe before swinging it toward Yuan.
Instead of dodging, Yuan raised the Demon Devouring Sword and met the attack head-on.
The True God raised an eyebrow when he noticed the Demon Devouring Sword.
"What a nasty weapon you have there," he remarked.
"Thanks," Yuan responded.
In the next instant, he vanished with a movement technique and reappeared behind the True God, striking without hesitation.

Without even turning around, the True God created a turtle-like shell on his back, blocking the strike. Yet, the impact from Yuan's strike was much stronger than he anticipated, and it launched him several meters away.
"You're not a Forsaken, are you?" Yuan asked the demon afterward.
Instead of answering, the True God narrowed his eyes and asked, "What are you? You may be hiding your presence, but I can tell that you're fundamentally different.
"I'll tell you if you can beat me."
The True God fell silent for a moment before suddenly releasing a tyrannical amount of aura.
"Try not to die," he said after releasing his full cultivation.
An excited smile appeared on Yuan's face as he activated True Dragon Awakening without hesitation.
"What kind of appearance is that?"
Not just the True God, but even Lev were taken aback by Yuan's sudden transformation.
"Enough questions. I'll answer all of your questions if you can beat me," said Yuan as he launched an attack first.
It'd been a long time since he was able to fight at full strength, and this was a good opportunity for him to see his current limits.
Despite Yuan only being at the First Level of the God Ascension Realm, the True God—whose strength rivaled that of a Cultivation God—did not dare underestimate him and responded with his full power.
A powerful ripple swept across the Eighth Valley, their clash so violent that the very space around them began to crack.
For the first several hours, the two of them used only basic techniques and raw strength to fight, but eventually, they started using actual martial techniques.
[Heaven Splitting Sword Strike!]

Without needing to gather his energy like previously, Yuan could effortlessly launch Heaven Splitting Sword Strikes one after another, each powerful enough to completely erase mountains and change landscapes.

"What overwhelming and devastating prowess!" The True God could feel his back soaked in cold sweat after seeing how effortlessly and frequently Yuan was unleashing these landscape-altering attacks one after another. "Blood Arts, Crimson Downpour!"
Moments later, it burst like a bubble, releasing countless needle-like projectiles that rained down upon Yuan.
[Void Manipulation!]
Yuan's figure vanished into thin air and entered the void, completely avoiding the attack.
"You're not the only one who can use Void Manipulation!" The True God declared before also entering the void.
"What the hell is going on?! These two are monsters!" Lev cried out loud as he continued to distance himself from the battlefield.

Even though their next several exchanges occurred within the void, Lev could sense the ripple caused by their clashes, sending chills down his entire being. He'd witnessed many fights in his lifetime, but this was the first time it made him feel so small and terrified.
Then, he realized that Yuan had been fighting without his usual Demon Sealing Techniques and relied on his own prowess for some reason.
One day... three days... five days...

Yuan and the True God clashed relentlessly for an entire month. Yet even after all that time, neither side had gained a decisive advantage. Although Yuan appeared to hold the upper hand, it still wasn't enough to secure victory.
"You're not bad. I haven't had this much fun in a long time!" The True God remarked as he distanced himself from Yuan. "However, I can tell that you're still holding back."
Yuan smiled and said, "I wouldn't be able to enjoy it if I were to fight you with all of my power.
The True God opened his mouth, but before he could speak, another presence suddenly appeared.
"HEYYY! LET ME IN ON THE FUN!" A loud and obnoxious voice suddenly echoed.
A moment later, another demon appeared. Purple skin, crimson eyes, and four black horns marked its appearance.
It too possessed the aura of a True God, but its presence was clearly stronger than the one Yuan had been fighting for the past month.
A look of disgust appeared on Yuan's face when he saw the newcomer, his brows furrowing deeply as he stared at it.
The rotting stench emanating from the demon was overwhelming. It was unmistakably a Forsaken.
"Mind your own business, Mov," the True God snickered, sounding just as displeased as Yuan by the interruption.
However, the Forsaken completely ignored the True God and focused solely on Yuan.
"A False God fighting on equal terms with a True God? I wonder how you'll taste!"
Without warning, the Forsaken named Mov lunged at Yuan with its mouth wide open, as if it wanted to take a bite out of his flesh. Yuan sneered in disgust before activating the Demon Sealing Zone.
However, the Demon Sealing Zone was only strong enough to slow the Mov's movements by about twenty-five percent.
[Swords of Eternal Torment!]
Then, a hundred golden swords materialized in the sky and quickly surrounded Mov.
"What's this power?" The True God swallowed nervously when he sensed the overwhelming amount of Demon Sealing Aura gushing from Yuan's body at this moment.
"Fuck! What the hell is this?! It hurts!" Mov screamed out loud when the swords impaled its body. Before Mov could even process what was happening to him, Yuan launched his next attack.
His Demon Sealing Aura erupted to unprecedented levels, its overwhelming presence reaching demons as far as the Seventh—and even the Sixth Valley.

Mov ignored the pain in his body and focused his gaze on Yuan, who was now emitting a different aura. When Mov sensed the aura, a look of awe and reverence appeared on his face—though he was completely unaware of it himself.
"Our... God?" Mov muttered under his breath.
Yuan suddenly swung the Demon Devouring Sword in his grasp.
In the next moment, Mov felt a gentle breeze brush across his face.
Then, he ceased to exist.
The True God's eyes widened in stunned shock. But when he confirmed that Mov had actually been killed, the shock in his eyes turned into pure terror and disbelief.
'Impossible! He actually killed Mov?! And that easily?!' he cried inwardly.
Mov was a True God just like him—no, he was even stronger. Yet Yuan had killed him in the blink of an eye, making it look utterly effortless.

Not to mention the unfamiliar power Yuan had displayed. The Demon Sealing Aura alone was already shocking enough, but the second power he used—something even the True God couldn't comprehend—left him completely speechless.
"You... Who the hell are you? And what was that power you used to kill Mov?" The True God asked with clenched fists.

sentences.text: "T-This presence!

Not even a full second after Lev left, a silhouette slowly approached Yuan from a distance, its figure exuding an unfathomable aura that twisted and wrapped the space around them.

"In my fifty billion years of experience in this place, this is the first time I've seen a first-level False God who is bold enough to trespass into this domain meant for real Gods," remarked the demon, who had a unique appearance that looked half human and half demon.
Yuan calmly replied, "To call it trespassing, you'd have to own this place."
"Oh?

In the next instant, Yuan sensed a powerful wave of Celestial Qi rushing toward him.

Seeing its Celestial Qi being destroyed by Yuan, the True God expressed surprise on their face.
"I see why you dare to come here.
Unfortunately for you, that wasn't even half of my true power."

"What kind of appearance is that?"

"Enough questions.
I'll answer all of your questions if you can beat me," said Yuan as he launched an attack first.

Despite Yuan only being at the First Level of the God Ascension Realm, the True God—whose strength rivaled that of a Cultivation God—did not dare underestimate him and responded with his full power.
A powerful ripple swept across the Eighth Valley, their clash so violent that the very space around them began to crack.

Without needing to gather his energy like previously, Yuan could effortlessly launch Heaven Splitting Sword Strikes one after another, each powerful enough to completely erase mountains and change landscapes.

chapters.title: Chapter 2368 The Realm of Absolute God
paragraphs: "Who am I...?" Yuan turned to look at the True God after killing Mov. "I'm Yuan. As for the power I used, it was Demon Sealing Aura."
"Demon Sealing Aura? You were a Sealer this entire time?" The True God frowned when he realized that Yuan had been going easy on him this entire time.
Had Yuan used Demon Sealing Aura from the start to suppress him, he wouldn't have been able to fight with his full capability. However, there was another reason he felt upset.
"I don't mean your Demon Sealing Aura," he said. "That power you displayed to kill Mov... that was something entirely different!"
Yuan shrugged, pretending he had no idea what the True God was talking about.
In truth, he had briefly unleashed his Eternal Essence, overwhelming Mov instantly and killing him before he could even comprehend what had happened.
This was also Yuan's first time fusing his Eternal Essence with his Demon Sealing Aura, and unsurprisingly, the results were astonishing.
"Want to continue?" Yuan asked the True God a moment later.
The True God took a deep breath before shaking his head.
"I'm no longer in the mood, especially after realizing you've been going easy on me. I still can't believe a first-level False God was holding back against me."
"Why did you attack me in the first place?" Yuan asked suddenly. "Were you really that bothered by my presence?"
The True God shook his head. "No. At first, I believed you had wandered here by mistake, so I wanted to drive you away. This place is too dangerous for a False God, after all."
He continued, "But after fighting you, I realized I had underestimated you. Now that I know you can even kill True Gods, there's no reason for me to chase you away anymore."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at the explanation. According to him, the True God had actually been trying to help, which was truly unexpected.
"Why were you exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley?" Yuan asked, seemingly interested in the True God's background.

"My reason for being exiled...?" The True God fell silent for a moment before responding, "To be frank, I have long forgotten the reason. I wasn't even a False God when I was exiled over fifty billion years ago."
"Have you ever thought about leaving?" Yuan asked.
"Many times," the True God answered. "But escaping this place with my own strength is impossible—even for a True God."

He continued in a low voice, "And even if I did manage to escape, it wouldn't matter. We exiles carry a brand etched into our souls. No matter where we go or what disguise we wear, we will always be recognized and hunted."
The exiles of the Deprived Crimson Valley were much like the exiles of the Primordial Realm. Even if they somehow managed to escape, their branding ensured they could never truly run from their fate.
"Enough questions about me. What are you doing in the Eighth Valley? Are you just looking to fight True Gods?"
"My destination isn't the Eighth Valley, but the Final Valley," Yuan calmly replied.
"The Final Valley?! Are you out of your mind?!" The True God exclaimed in shock after hearing this.
"Forget about the Final Valley, even the Ninth Valley is too dangerous these days! Why the hell would you want to go there?"
"I have some business with Supreme Ruler Dena, that's all."
"Supreme Ruler Dena?!" The True God nearly turned and ran away the moment he heard her name.
"What's going on with the Ninth Valley?" Yuan ignored his shock and asked.

"I don't know how to explain it. It's better if you witnessed it yourself. Because of what's happening in the Ninth Valley, all of the True Gods and Absolute Gods dwelling there have moved to the Eighth Valley."
"Wait... Absolute Gods?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this new terminology. "What are those?"
The True God looked at Yuan with a puzzled face.
"You... don't know about Absolute Gods?" he had to confirm what he heard.
Yuan calmly nodded before giving a random excuse, "I was in seclusion for a long time."

"How long were you in seclusion for? The realm of Absolute God was discovered over ten billion years ago! It's basically what's above the True God Realm, and only about twenty individuals have managed to reach that level even after its discovery ten billion years ago."
'A realm above Cultivation God, huh?' Yuan thought to himself.

While the Cultivation God was considered the peak of cultivation in the Nine Heavens, the path of cultivation itself was infinite. There was no true peak—only new realms waiting to be discovered with time.

With how much time passed in the Demonic Realm compared to the Nine Heavens, it was no surprise that they had managed to discover what's above Cultivation God. The Demonic Realm being ahead of the Nine Heavens wasn't anything new to Yuan, as there were already hundreds of Cultivation Gods when he visited as Tian Chenyu, while the Nine Heavens had only discovered its existence.
"An Absolute God... I'd like to meet and fight one," Yuan remarked with a smile on his face.
"If you have a death wish, go ahead and fight one. They'll kill you before you can even register what happened," said the True God. "Are there any in the Deprived Crimson Valley?" Yuan asked.
"There are... two of them."
"If they're really that powerful, why are they afraid of the Ninth Valley?" "It's not that they're scared. They just don't want to deal with it since it's a hassle."
"Now I really want to see what's at the Ninth Valley. Thanks for the information. I'll be taking my leave now."
Yuan then called out, "Come out, Lev! We're moving again!"
A few moments later, Lev emerged from a hole he'd dug in the ground and slowly approached them with his head lowered, as if he were too afraid to even look at the True God.

chapters.title: Chapter 2369 Demon God
paragraphs: "Are you really determined to go to the Ninth Valley?" The True God suddenly spoke when Yuan and Lev prepared to depart.
"That's right. Why? You wanna come with us?" Yuan asked.

The True God fell silent for a moment before nodding, "I still have questions that need to be answered, so I'll follow you for a bit. I also want to see if the situation in the Ninth Valley has gotten any better or worse."
"If you want to follow us, go ahead," said Yuan.
"By the way, do you have a name?"
"You can call me Duk."
"Duck, huh," Yuan repeated, unaware that he'd misheard the name. Yet, he wasn't corrected.
They started making their way towards the Ninth Valley together shortly after.
Over the next several days, they sensed the presence of multiple True Gods. However, most of them didn't even bother approaching, and those who did suddenly turned back halfway for some reason.
"Thanks for sending them away, Senior." Lev suddenly said to Duk.
"What?" However, Duk wore a puzzled look on his face before calmly responding, "I didn't do anything."
"Then why did those True Gods turn around midway?"
Duk turned to look at Yuan and replied, "Probably because of the unfathomable aura he exudes when they get too close."
"What?" Lev shifted his gaze to Yuan. "I haven't sensed anything unusual from him, though."
"So you cannot sense that crazy aura, huh?" Duk muttered, sounding like he had just acquired new information.

This was the main reason he had decided to follow Yuan. He wanted to learn more about Eternal Essence. Yet even with his vast experience, he found himself unable to comprehend it, almost as if it were something he was never meant to understand.
As for the other True Gods, although they couldn't understand what they sensed from Yuan, their instincts screamed at them to retreat, and so they did.
About a month later, a True God who didn't fear Yuan's Eternal Essence went to block his path.
"It's a Forsaken," Duk warned Yuan. "I doubt you'll need any help, but if you do...
"Thanks for the offer, but I'll be fine."
Yuan approached the Forsaken with a calm expression.

However, instead of attacking, the Forsaken questioned with a frown on his face, "A mere first-level False God? How did you acquire that power?" "What power are you referring to?" Yuan asked, pretending not to know what the Forsaken was talking about.
"Don't act dumb! That aura surrounding you... That's the Demon God's powers!" The Forsaken roared.
"What?"
Not just Duk, but even Yuan was surprised by the Forsaken's claims.
"The Demon God? What the hell are you talking about?"
Rather than Yuan, it was Duk who stepped forward and questioned.

"I will not ask you again! How and where did you acquire that power!" The Forsaken completely ignored Duk and glared at Yuan with an unwavering gaze. "If you won't tell me, I'll kill you and obtain it for myself!"
A provocative smile tugged at Yuan's lips as he beckoned, "If you think you have what it takes, come get it."
Despite Yuan's blatant provocation, the Forsaken hesitated, as if weighing its decision. However, in the end, it chose to attack.
Seeing this, Yuan didn't hesitate to use Eternal Essence to fight back.
While this Forsaken was weaker than Mov, he was clearly cautious of Yuan's Eternal Essence and fought carefully instead of attacking recklessly.
It was a sight Yuan would rarely see, as most Forsaken he had faced would attack without hesitation, confident in their overwhelming regeneration and immorality.
However, in the Demonic Realm, demons were not as invincible and could be killed by other demons, hence why they were not as reckless.
"How are you going to kill me when you're too afraid to even come near me?!" Yuan mocked the Forsaken, even laughing at it.
But the Forsaken remained cautious.
"You want this power, don't you? Well, come get it!" Yuan provoked it by unleashing even more Eternal Essence.
When the Forsaken sensed the overwhelming amount of Eternal Essence radiating from Yuan, its expression suddenly went blank.
In the next instant, it charged at Yuan like a wild beast, as if it had lost all reasoning.
"Whoa!" Yuan hadn't expected his plan to be so effective, especially since he was only trying it out.
"Give it to me! The Demon God's power!" The Forsaken shouted as it charged at Yuan.
[Demon Sealing Zone!]
[Swords of Eternal Torment!]
Yuan activated his Demon Sealing Techniques, restricting the Forsaken's movements before striking with the Demon Devouring Sword.
The Forsaken, who had seemingly lost all reason, was killed in the very next moment.

Both Duk and Lev stared at Yuan with bewildered expressions, but it wasn't because of his overwhelming prowess. Rather, it was because of his Eternal Essence, which had been associated with the Demon God by the Forsaken.
In the Demonic Realm, it was commonly believed that all demons were born from the Demon God, an omnipotent existence.
To demons, the Demon God was much like the Heavens to humans in the Nine Heavens—an entity that stood above everything.

Moreover, it was widely believed that the Forsaken were demons who had been cast aside by the Demon God for going against its will—stripped of their reason and reduced to little more than wild beasts.
"That power you've been using... was the power of the Demon God?! Who the hell are you, Yuan?! I thought only the Supreme Rulers are capable of wielding such power!" Duk exclaimed.
Yuan sighed and said, "It's a misunderstanding. How could I possibly wield the Demon God's power?"
"If it's not that, then what kind of power is it?" Duk pressed, his curiosity about Eternal Essence growing stronger by the moment.
Yuan looked at him in the eyes and said, "I know you want to learn how to use this power, but unfortunately, it's not something you can learn to wield."
"How can you be so sure when I haven't even tried?!" Duk exclaimed, refusing to believe that it was something he couldn't wield.

"You want this power, don't you?
Well, come get it!" Yuan provoked it by unleashing even more Eternal Essence.
When the Forsaken sensed the overwhelming amount of Eternal Essence radiating from Yuan, its expression suddenly went blank.
In the next instant, it charged at Yuan like a wild beast, as if it had lost all reasoning.
"Whoa!" Yuan hadn't expected his plan to be so effective, especially since he was only trying it out.
"Give it to me!
The Demon God's power!" The Forsaken shouted as it charged at Yuan.
[Demon Sealing Zone!]
[Swords of Eternal Torment!]
Yuan activated his Demon Sealing Techniques, restricting the Forsaken's movements before striking with the Demon Devouring Sword.
The Forsaken, who had seemingly lost all reason, was killed in the very next moment.
Both Duk and Lev stared at Yuan with bewildered expressions, but it wasn't because of his overwhelming prowess.
Rather, it was because of his Eternal Essence, which had been associated with the Demon God by the Forsaken.
In the Demonic Realm, it was commonly believed that all demons were born from the Demon God, an omnipotent existence.
To demons, the Demon God was much like the Heavens to humans in the Nine Heavens—an entity that stood above everything.

Moreover, it was widely believed that the Forsaken were demons who had been cast aside by the Demon God for going against its will—stripped of their reason and reduced to little more than wild beasts.
"That power you've been using... was the power of the Demon God?!
Who the hell are you, Yuan?!
I thought only the Supreme Rulers are capable of wielding such power!" Duk exclaimed.
Yuan sighed and said, "It's a misunderstanding.
How could I possibly wield the Demon God's power?"
"If it's not that, then what kind of power is it?" Duk pressed, his curiosity about Eternal Essence growing stronger by the moment.
Yuan looked at him in the eyes and said, "I know you want to learn how to use this power, but unfortunately, it's not something you can learn to wield."
"How can you be so sure when I haven't even tried?!" Duk exclaimed, refusing to believe that it was something he couldn't wield.

chapters.title: Chapter 2370 Supreme Ruler Dena
paragraphs: "I just know," Yuan calmly shrugged.
"Fine, keep it to yourself," Duk said with a snort. "But I'll definitely learn it one day! Just you wait!"
He assumed Yuan was simply keeping the power to himself, which was hardly unusual. After all, only fools would share their powers so easily.
Unbeknownst to Duk, however, it was a power that only Eternals could wield. Even if he spent his entire life chasing after it, he would never be able to learn it.
Shortly after defeating the Forsaken, Yuan resumed his journey toward the Ninth Valley.
The closer they drew to the Ninth Valley, the more Forsaken appeared to confront them.
Now that Yuan knew his Eternal Essence was attracting them, he refrained from revealing it unless he intended to kill his opponent.
Over the next three years, Yuan slew more than a dozen Forsaken, each one at the True God realm. This meant he had effectively killed over a dozen beings equivalent to Cultivation Gods.

Even with his Demon Sealing Aura giving him an advantage against demons, such an achievement was nothing short of astonishing. If news of this spread throughout the Nine Heavens, it would shock the entire world—especially since Yuan had only just stepped into the God Ascension Realm.

'If he's already this powerful as a False God, I cannot imagine how terrifying he'd be once he steps into the True God Realm...' Lev swallowed nervously as he watched Yuan kill True Gods after True Gods.

Meanwhile, Duk devoted all of his attention to Yuan's Eternal Essence, carefully observing it whenever Yuan used it. However, the moment the Eternal Essence faded, the memory of it would also slip from his mind, as though he was fundamentally incapable of grasping it.
'If only I could grasp that power!' Duk gritted his teeth.
Suddenly, Yuan began to slow down when something on the distant horizon caught his attention.
At first glance, it looked as though the crimson grass of the Fourth Valley had returned. However, upon closer inspection, it turned out to be something else entirely.
"What is that...? A crimson sea?" Lev asked aloud as he stared into the distance. "No... it looks like... hair?"
Upon closer inspection, the crimson "grass" turned out to be a vast sea of countless crimson threads that resembled strands of hair.
"Goodness... We should still be in the Eighth Valley," Duk muttered, his body trembling as he stared at the crimson hair with clear unease. "To think it has spread this far already...
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the crimson sea and asked, "What exactly are we looking at?"
"Supreme Ruler Dena," Duk responded.
"Excuse me?" Yuan raised an eyebrow, convinced he had misheard.

"You heard me right," Duk said grimly. "That... is Supreme Ruler Dena. Not long after she arrived in the Final Valley, she began devouring everything within it and anything that entered her territory. Countless demons have already been consumed by her."
"Wait here for a moment," Duk said before suddenly flying off somewhere.
Several minutes later, Duk returned with a magical beast in his grasp.
"Watch this."
Duk threw the magical beast high into the air above the crimson sea.
As if they possessed a will of their own, the crimson hair shot upward, snatching the beast from the sky like a toad's tongue striking a fly, piercing the prey the instant it was captured.
Once the prey was caught, the crimson hair pulled the magical beast inward, embracing it like the sea swallowing a ship, until it disappeared entirely.
After witnessing such a horrifying scene, Lev felt every hair on his body stand on end, his body trembling uncontrollably with fear.

"As you can see, anything that tries to get close will be devoured," Duk sighed. "Forget about meeting Supreme Ruler Dena. You'll be consumed by her long before you even reach her in the Final Valley. Hell, even Absolute Gods would rather move to the Eighth Valley than deal with Supreme Ruler Dena."
Lev then said, "He's right, Yuan. This is beyond fighting True Gods. Let's just turn around and give up on meeting Supreme Ruler Dena."
Yuan turned to face them and said with a calm smile, "Sorry, but that is not an option for me.
"Why are you so intent on meeting her, anyway? Now that she's turned Forsaken, I doubt you'll even be able to have a proper conversation."
"I have my reasons."
Yuan looked at Lev and continued, "Thanks for accompanying me all this way. It'll be too dangerous for you to continue following me, so just wait here for my return."
"Wait for your return...?" Lev repeated in a daze.
In his heart, he was convinced that Yuan would never return if he entered Supreme Ruler Dena's territory. Still, he couldn't bring himself to say it out loud.
"Trust me. I'll come back."
Yuan said it as if he had read Lev's thoughts.
Without waiting for their response, Yuan immediately flew into Supreme Ruler Dena's territory.
"My god! He's actually doing it!" Lev exclaimed in shock as he watched Yuan soar into the crimson sea.
The crimson hair attacked Yuan the moment he stepped into its territory, even though he was still hiding his presence with Shadow Veil.
"So hiding my presence doesn't matter..." Yuan muttered.

Abandoning the attempt to conceal himself, he focused entirely on evasion as the crimson strands lunged at him without pause. When a single strike failed, the crimson hair adapted, attacking from every direction as its strands lashed toward him like countless grasping hands.
Before long, the attacks became too numerous for Yuan to dodge alone, forcing him to fight back.

Wielding the Demon Devouring Sword, he cut down every strand that approached him. But even with his Supreme Sword Aura, he found it surprisingly difficult to slice through the crimson hair, almost as if every strand of hair was a Celestial-grade treasure.
Meanwhile, Duk and Lev continued to watch from afar.
"That lunatic is... smiling?" Duk muttered in disbelief when he saw a smile forming on Yuan's face amidst the relentless attacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 2371 Supreme Ruler Dena(2)
paragraphs: "He's actually doing it! He's crossing the crimson sea and advancing toward the Ninth Valley!" Lev exclaimed, shock and awe written all over his face.

However, Duk shook his head. "Most True Gods can do the same. The real problem is how long he can endure without making a single mistake. One slip is all it takes to cost him his life. And the closer he gets to Supreme Ruler Dena, the more aggressive the attacks become."
Days passed in the blink of an eye, and Yuan continued to advance toward the Ninth Valley without slowing down.
Eventually, he made it so far that Lev could no longer see him, even with divine sense.
"I can't see him anymore," Lev sighed.
"I can still see him, and he's the same as ever, wielding that weird and sharp energy."

Although the demons' cultivation was far more advanced than that of the Nine Heavens, it didn't mean they surpassed them in every aspect. One area they lacked was weapon auras. Demons rarely used conventional weapons, relying primarily on their own bodies, and any weapons they wielded were usually formed from their own blood.

As a result, while demons were aware of the existence of weapon auras, none of them had attempted to master them. To them, it was pointless, especially since ordinary weapons and their auras were incapable of killing them.
Days turned into weeks, and Supreme Ruler Dena's attacks only grew more intense and powerful.
As for Yuan, he gradually increased his own power, almost as if he were deliberately matching the strength of her attacks.
Weeks turned into months, and unbeknownst to Yuan, he'd already entered the Ninth Valley and had begun approaching the Final Valley.
He'd also traveled so far that even Duk could no longer see him with divine sense.
"Hey, Dena, can you hear me?!" Yuan suddenly spoke out loud.
"This reminds me of our first encounter!"

"When I first came to the Demonic Realm and didn't understand the full situation, I went on an indiscriminate killing spree, slaughtering every demon I encountered. If it weren't for you, I would have killed many more," Yuan said as he recalled his memories as Tian Chenyu.

When Tian Chenyu first entered the Demonic Realm and found himself surrounded by demons, he didn't hesitate in the slightest. Without questioning anything, he began sealing and slaughtering every demon he saw, unaware that there was a distinction between ordinary demons and the Forsaken. To him, all demons were the same—and all of them had to be eliminated.
Tian Chenyu rampaged through the Demonic Realm like an unstoppable natural disaster. Only when Supreme Ruler Dena appeared to confront him did his indiscriminate slaughter finally cease.

That was also when Tian Chenyu learned the truth about the Forsaken—the demons who had invaded and terrorized his world—and the ordinary demons, who were no different from the people of the Divine Heaven.
[True Dragon Awakening!]

After spending a year inside the Ninth Valley, Supreme Ruler Dena's attacks had grown so powerful that Yuan could no longer cut them down with Supreme Sword Aura alone, forcing him to activate True Dragon Awakening and use Chaotic Essence.
[Absolute Dragon Awakening!]
After another year, Yuan had to use Absolute Dragon Awakening just to defend against Supreme Ruler Dena's attacks.
"Damn it... just how much stronger have you become, Dena?!" Yuan shouted as he began using Eternal Essence.
Despite being capable of killing True Gods with ease, he was barely able to keep up with Supreme Ruler Dena's attacks—and he wasn't even facing her true body, only a mere part of it: her hair.
However, Yuan wasn't particularly surprised by this. After all, in the past, Supreme Ruler Dena was the only demon Tian Chenyu couldn't defeat, even with all of his powers.

After traversing the Ninth Valley nonstop for three years and seeing nothing but Supreme Ruler Dena's crimson hair, Yuan suddenly noticed something different on the distant horizon—a massive crimson sphere floating in the sky.
However, upon closer inspection, he realized that it wasn't a sphere at all, but a gigantic cocoon-like structure woven from the same crimson hair.
As Yuan drew closer, the relentless attacks from the crimson hair suddenly ceased.
Then, before his eyes, the crimson strands twisted and intertwined, slowly shaping themselves into the figure of a woman.
Seeing this figure, Yuan tried speaking to it.
"Hey, Dena. Do you recognize me?"
"Can you hear me?"
"It's me, Tian Chenyu."
No matter how much Yuan tried to communicate with it, the figure remained silent.
"Looks like I'll have to wake you up by force, huh?" Yuan sighed out loud.
Although it was faint—almost nonexistent—Yuan could sense a presence within the cocoon.
The next moment, he moved toward it, only to be immediately blocked by Supreme Ruler Dena's clone.
"Scram!"
Yuan swung the Demon Devouring Sword, unleashing a burst of Eternal Essence.
In response, the clone swung its arm to meet the attack, exuding a similar aura.
Their energies collided, and to Yuan's surprise, they perfectly canceled each other out.
'What was that?' Yuan wondered, a slight frown appearing on his face.
The aura felt similar to Eternal Essence, but he could tell it wasn't the same.
The next moment, Yuan attacked again without hesitation, unleashing Eternal Essence once more. As expected, the clone countered with that same strange energy.
This time, however, Yuan paid close attention and carefully analyzed it.

'Although it's not real Eternal Essence, it's a carefully recreated imitation of it,' Yuan concluded after carefully analyzing the power, feeling astonished that Supreme Ruler Dena had managed to recreate Eternal Essence.

In order to imitate something, one had to understand it first. For Supreme Ruler Dena to imitate Eternal Essence meant that she had managed to grasp it to a certain degree—an astonishing feat, considering that only Eternals were capable of truly understanding and wielding it.
Even though her fake Eternal Essence wasn't as powerful as the real thing, Supreme Ruler Dena had mastered it to such a degree that it could rival Yuan's true Eternal Essence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2372 Supreme Ruler Dena's World
paragraphs: "Good heavens, Dena... To recreate Eternal Essence like this..." Yuan sighed in disbelief. "I'm speechless."
He couldn't help but wonder what had pushed her to recreate Eternal Essence, and how she had managed to understand it deeply enough to replicate it.

'Did she fight with an Eternal and somehow studied Eternal Essence that way? Or is she in contact with an Eternal?' Yuan had many questions, but unless he dealt with the clone before him, he had no way of asking Supreme Ruler Dena these questions.
Unfortunately, Supreme Ruler Dena's clone seemed to have no plan to let Yuan disturb the real her.
"Looks like I'll have to take this seriously..." Yuan said as he took a deep breath and unleashed even more Eternal Essence.
Up until now, he had only been using about half of his strength. Now, he was raising it to nearly eighty percent.
The Eternal Essence radiating from Yuan became so intense that an invisible barrier formed around him, automatically repelling everything in its vicinity, including Supreme Ruler Dena's crimson hair.
"Let's see if your fake Eternal Essence can withstand this!" Yuan roared as he swung the Demon Devouring Sword toward the clone.
The clone's aura skyrocketed in response, desperately trying to match Yuan's power. Yet even as it pushed itself further, it still fell short of Yuan's genuine Eternal Essence.
In the following second, Yuan's sword tore through the clone's arm like a knife through fragile threads, continuing through its body and splitting it in half.
But the Eternal Essence didn't stop there. The overwhelming power instantly evaporated the clone, leaving nothing behind.
However, the instant the clone was destroyed, another one formed from the endless sea of crimson hair.
But it didn't stop there. This time, two clones appeared, standing side by side as they blocked Yuan's path to the cocoon.
Seeing this, Yuan pressed forward, cutting down every clone that stood in his way—both the two before him and any others that appeared to replace them.
Before long, he arrived in front of the cocoon.

When Yuan got close enough to the cocoon, the clones continued to spawn, but they no longer attacked him. Instead, they simply stood there and surrounded the cocoon in silence, quietly glaring at him with blank expressions.
Seeing that they weren't attacking him, Yuan stopped paying attention to the clones and focused on the cocoon instead.

At first glance, the cocoon appeared to be made from the same hair-like material as the clones. However, upon closer inspection, it was several times more durable and was even reinforced by fake Eternal Essence.
After a moment of silence, Yuan raised the Demon Devouring Sword and swung it at the cocoon, unleashing eighty percent of his Eternal Essence.

A powerful ripple swept across the area when his sword collided with the cocoon. Yet even with such overwhelming power, Yuan was shocked to see that it remained completely unharmed, with not even a scratch appearing on its surface.
Yuan struck again, this time using ninety percent of his full strength.
A far more violent ripple erupted from the impact, shaking the entire cocoon. Even so, it remained unscathed.
Seeing this, Yuan paused for a moment, gathering as much Eternal Essence as he could before striking the cocoon for a third time.
The impact was so powerful that it blasted away the clones surrounding him.

When Yuan looked at the spot he had struck a moment later, he felt a brief sense of relief after noticing a small cut on the cocoon. However, that relief quickly vanished, as the damage repaired itself in less than a second, leaving the cocoon looking completely untouched once again.

Yuan closed his eyes and took a deep breath before unleashing a rapid series of strikes against the cocoon. However, no matter how quickly he attacked, the cocoon seemed to heal itself faster than he could damage it.

Moreover, it was far thicker than Yuan had anticipated, and despite his relentless assault, he had only managed to carve about thirty inches into it before it restored itself. "If this is how you want to play..."
Yuan inhaled deeply before activating God of War's Astral Arts, followed by Limitless Sword Domain.
Moments later, thousands of swords appeared in the sky. Infused with Eternal Essence and Supreme Sword Aura, they shot toward the cocoon with perfect precision, relentlessly striking the same point.
Meanwhile, Yuan advanced with his own blade, unleashing the Nine Supreme Swords, each strike more powerful than the previous one.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
The entire Deprived Crimson Valley trembled as Yuan's full prowess clashed against the crimson cocoon, shocking every exile within the valley.
Eventually, Yuan broke through the cocoon, leaving behind a small opening barely wide enough for him to pass through.
Without a moment of hesitation, he dashed forward and slipped inside just as the cocoon sealed itself once more.
When Yuan entered the cocoon, he was surprised to find an enormous space within.
From the outside, the cocoon was only four to five times larger than his own body, yet the interior stretched endlessly, as though he had stepped into another world.
"This place must be Dena's personal world..." Yuan muttered as he immediately understood where he was.

The world looked quite similar to the Fourth Valley of the Deprived Crimson Valley—a vast, empty plain covered in crimson flowers and the same crimson hair that attacked him, though they didn't react to his presence. The sky above was dyed crimson as well, almost as if a god had been slain and its blood had spilled across the entire world.
Yuan didn't wander and stayed still as he used his divine sense to look for Supreme Ruler Dena.
Several minutes later, Yuan started walking in a certain direction.
After walking for a short while, Yuan spotted a small pale figure in the distance.
The figure sat quietly on the ground, hugging her legs with slender arms while her face remained buried in her knees. Behind her stretched endless crimson hair, cascading like a boundless cape.
"Dena..."
Yuan muttered in a low voice before approaching her in slow, calm steps.
