The clone's aura skyrocketed in response, desperately trying to match Yuan's power.
Yet even as it pushed itself further, it still fell short of Yuan's genuine Eternal Essence.
In the following second, Yuan's sword tore through the clone's arm like a knife through fragile threads, continuing through its body and splitting it in half.
But the Eternal Essence didn't stop there.
The overwhelming power instantly evaporated the clone, leaving nothing behind.
However, the instant the clone was destroyed, another one formed from the endless sea of crimson hair.
But it didn't stop there.
This time, two clones appeared, standing side by side as they blocked Yuan's path to the cocoon.
Seeing this, Yuan pressed forward, cutting down every clone that stood in his way—both the two before him and any others that appeared to replace them.
Before long, he arrived in front of the cocoon.
When Yuan got close enough to the cocoon, the clones continued to spawn, but they no longer attacked him.
Instead, they simply stood there and surrounded the cocoon in silence, quietly glaring at him with blank expressions.
Seeing that they weren't attacking him, Yuan stopped paying attention to the clones and focused on the cocoon instead.
At first glance, the cocoon appeared to be made from the same hair-like material as the clones.
However, upon closer inspection, it was several times more durable and was even reinforced by fake Eternal Essence.
After a moment of silence, Yuan raised the Demon Devouring Sword and swung it at the cocoon, unleashing eighty percent of his Eternal Essence.
A powerful ripple swept across the area when his sword collided with the cocoon.
Yet even with such overwhelming power, Yuan was shocked to see that it remained completely unharmed, with not even a scratch appearing on its surface.
Yuan struck again, this time using ninety percent of his full strength.
A far more violent ripple erupted from the impact, shaking the entire cocoon.
Even so, it remained unscathed.
Seeing this, Yuan paused for a moment, gathering as much Eternal Essence as he could before striking the cocoon for a third time.
The impact was so powerful that it blasted away the clones surrounding him.
When Yuan looked at the spot he had struck a moment later, he felt a brief sense of relief after noticing a small cut on the cocoon.
However, that relief quickly vanished, as the damage repaired itself in less than a second, leaving the cocoon looking completely untouched once again.
Yuan closed his eyes and took a deep breath before unleashing a rapid series of strikes against the cocoon.
However, no matter how quickly he attacked, the cocoon seemed to heal itself faster than he could damage it.
Moreover, it was far thicker than Yuan had anticipated, and despite his relentless assault, he had only managed to carve about thirty inches into it before it restored itself.
"If this is how you want to play..."
Yuan inhaled deeply before activating God of War's Astral Arts, followed by Limitless Sword Domain.
Moments later, thousands of swords appeared in the sky.
Infused with Eternal Essence and Supreme Sword Aura, they shot toward the cocoon with perfect precision, relentlessly striking the same point.
Meanwhile, Yuan advanced with his own blade, unleashing the Nine Supreme Swords, each strike more powerful than the previous one.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!
The entire Deprived Crimson Valley trembled as Yuan's full prowess clashed against the crimson cocoon, shocking every exile within the valley.
Eventually, Yuan broke through the cocoon, leaving behind a small opening barely wide enough for him to pass through.
Without a moment of hesitation, he dashed forward and slipped inside just as the cocoon sealed itself once more.
When Yuan entered the cocoon, he was surprised to find an enormous space within.
From the outside, the cocoon was only four to five times larger than his own body, yet the interior stretched endlessly, as though he had stepped into another world.
"This place must be Dena's personal world..." Yuan muttered as he immediately understood where he was.

The world looked quite similar to the Fourth Valley of the Deprived Crimson Valley—a vast, empty plain covered in crimson flowers and the same crimson hair that attacked him, though they didn't react to his presence.
The sky above was dyed crimson as well, almost as if a god had been slain and its blood had spilled across the entire world.
Yuan didn't wander and stayed still as he used his divine sense to look for Supreme Ruler Dena.
Several minutes later, Yuan started walking in a certain direction.
After walking for a short while, Yuan spotted a small pale figure in the distance.
The figure sat quietly on the ground, hugging her legs with slender arms while her face remained buried in her knees.
Behind her stretched endless crimson hair, cascading like a boundless cape.
"Dena..."
Yuan muttered in a low voice before approaching her in slow, calm steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 2373 An Unfathomable Curse
paragraphs: Even as Yuan slowly approached her, Supreme Ruler Dena remained completely motionless, as though she hadn't noticed him at all.

Yuan, however, didn't let his guard down. Despite her stillness, he approached cautiously. Even in silence, her body radiated an invisible but overwhelming aura of tyranny, not to mention the immense amount of natural killing intent that oozed from her very existence, likely a result of her killing and devouring countless demons since she was exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley.
Yuan stopped a few meters in front of Supreme Ruler Dena and called out in a soft, gentle voice, as if he was beckoning a child, "Dena, can you hear me?"
Silence.
He waited for a few more moments before taking another step.
"Dena."
Once again, he was met with silence.
Yuan continued approaching her one step at a time until he stood right in front of her, remaining cautious the entire time and ready to attack or defend at a moment's notice.
However, when he was standing only inches away from her, Supreme Ruler Dena remained motionless, her head buried in her knees.
After a moment of silence, Yuan suddenly sat down directly in front of her.
"Dena," he called out to her again in a gentle voice. "It's me, Tian Chenyu."
Although Supreme Ruler Dena remained silent, Yuan sensed a subtle change within her aura—a faint fluctuation, almost as if she reacted to his name.
"I don't know why you're doing all of this, but it's time to wake up," Yuan continued speaking to her.
"Remember our promise? Although I'm a bit late, I have returned to fulfill it."
The fluctuation became even stronger, but for some reason, Supreme Ruler Dena remained motionless.
Yuan suddenly narrowed his eyes, staring at her—or more specifically, into her.
He then reached out and gently touched her soft hand with a finger.
However, the very next moment, Yuan quickly pulled his hand back, which was now throbbing with pain.
He stared at his hand with raised eyebrows.
"This is... a curse?" he muttered.
Yuan could instinctively tell that a powerful curse was binding Supreme Ruler Dena, likely the reason she remained unresponsive. However, it was clearly no ordinary curse.
Strangely, despite not understanding it, the aura of the curse felt oddly familiar to him.
Yuan took out the Sacred Chalice of Purification and tried to remove the curse with it. However, getting her blood proved far more difficult than he expected.
Even though she remained completely still, Yuan had to exert all his strength just to make a small cut on her hand.
"Her blood is... black..." Yuan swallowed nervously when he saw it, the color completely different from what he remembered.
However, an even greater shock came when Supreme Ruler Dena's blood was absorbed by the Sacred Chalice of Purification.
The treasure suddenly trembled violently, and cracks began to appear across its surface.
<Sacred Chalice of Purification has been damaged!>
Yuan cried out in disbelief. He never expected the curse binding Supreme Ruler Dena to be so powerful that it would damage the Sacred Chalice of Purification.
Although the outcome was disastrous and unexpected, it wasn't entirely futile since he could feel that the curse binding her had weakened significantly afterward.
"Looks like I won't be able to use this thing until I get it fixed..." Yuan sighed. After putting away the damaged Sacred Chalice of Purification, Yuan returned his focus to Supreme Ruler Dena.
A moment later, Yuan reached out and touched her hand again. The pain immediately surged back, and he could feel the curse devouring his longevity as if trying to replenish the power it had lost.
Seeing this, Yuan quickly realized that the curse was a living one—requiring energy to sustain itself, as well as growing stronger over time.
"Is the calamity outside caused by this damn curse trying to grow itself?" Yuan muttered after realizing this possibility.
"This curse might not even be a curse at all... but an organism—a parasite!"
Realizing this, Yuan immediately infused his spiritual energy into Supreme Ruler Dena's body and began examining every inch of it.
Despite her petite appearance, the inside of her body was incredibly vast, much like the space within the cocoon, almost as if it were its own world.
Yuan spent days searching through her body before finally discovering the source of the problem.
Hidden deep within her dantian, he found a grotesque mass of flesh tethered to her core, constantly siphoning Supreme Ruler Dena's energy and converting it into its own strength.

It was unlike anything Yuan had ever seen. However, he remembered hearing a theory in the past that powerful curses could eventually evolve into living entities—much like how Soul Weapons could awaken their own consciousness and give birth to a spirit.

"So it's actually possible for a curse to evolve... What an unsettling existence..." Yuan narrowed his eyes at the parasite-like curse, which looked like a caterpillar sealed inside a cocoon, waiting for the day it would transform and emerge.

Just as Yuan prepared to attack the curse before it could fully evolve, the curse sensed him, and a massive eye suddenly opened up on the lump of flesh. Moments later, numerous smaller eyes opened across the fleshy mass. At the same time, a large mouth split open beneath them, drooling with dark, viscous blood.
"Who... are... you?" The curse spoke in a chilling voice with an eerie tone.
"My identity doesn't matter," Yuan replied calmly. "But I can tell you why I'm here."
"I'm here to get rid of you, you disgusting parasite."
"Get rid... of me...? Why...?"
"Not only do you not belong here, but you're feeding off my friend while wreaking havoc outside. Just how many beings have you devoured to strengthen yourself?"
"Do you mean... the host...? This was... something... she... brought upon... herself..."
"What the hell are you talking about?" Yuan asked with a frown.
"If she hadn't... devoured me... If she had just allowed me... to be born properly...!" the curse snarled with hatred in its voice, leaving Yuan stunned into silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 2374 Consuming the Curse
paragraphs: "Wait... Wait a second..." Yuan had to do a double-take after hearing the curse's unexpected declaration, which confused the hell out of him, as the curse made it sound like it was a baby that was consumed before it could be born.
"She devoured you? Before you were born? Are you not a curse? If no, what in Heaven's name are you?" Yuan asked.
"I am... a curse now... as I cursed her... right before my death," said the curse.
"But before I became one... and before she... consumed me... I was ... in the process of being born..."
"Had I been... born... I would have... become... an... Eternal!"
Yuan's eyes widened with shock and disbelief after learning the curse's true identity—that Supreme Ruler Dena had actually consumed an Eternal before it could be born!
This explained why Supreme Ruler Dena was able to recreate Eternal Essence without being an Eternal herself, and why Yuan felt familiar with the curse's aura.
"However... I will not... allow myself... to die... so easily...!" The curse continued.
"I will... consume every... living being... in this world... and be reborn...!"
The curse stared at Yuan and said, "I can sense... Eternal Essence... emitting from you..."
"Help me... and I will... grant you any... wish...!"
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the curse.
'Does it think I am an Eternal because I can use Eternal Essence?'
Suddenly, an idea came to Yuan.
Rather than attempting to destroy the curse while it was still inside Supreme Ruler Dena—risking her life in the process—Yuan realized there was another option.
It was a method that would guarantee her safety... but it would be incredibly reckless for him.
"Sure, I'll help you, but I don't need anything from you. After all, we're both Eternals. It's only right to help out a fellow comrade," Yuan spoke with a smile on his face.
The eyes on the mass of lump grinned into a crescent, clearly very happy to hear that Yuan was willing to help it.
"However, I will need you to do something first in order for me to help you."
"What is... it...?"
Yuan extended his arm toward it and said, "Leave your current host and use me as a vessel instead!"
"What...?"
The curse looked at him with wide eyes, unable to comprehend why Yuan would make such a suggestion.
"Listen carefully. How close are you to completing your rebirth right now?" Yuan asked.
The curse fell silent for a moment before replying, "I am about... thirty percent... done."
Yuan shook his head and released a pitiful sigh.
"And how long have you been doing this? Tens of billions of years? At this rate, not only will it take you forever to finish, but I doubt you'll even succeed in being reborn."
"Why are you surprised?" Yuan chuckled. "What do you think is the most important for Eternals?"

"Eternal Essence!" Yuan answered before the curse could respond. "Even if you consumed every living being on this world, you would lack the necessary Eternal Essence to be reborn. However, if you enter my body and use me as a host, I will be able to gather and feed you Eternal Essence." "Oh... oh... OH...!" The curse exclaimed with excitement after hearing Yuan's logical explanation.
"You are... amazing...!"
"Very well... I shall... enter your body... now..."
The next moment, Yuan felt the curse begin transferring from Supreme Ruler Dena's body into his own.

The process only took a few minutes, but to Yuan, it felt as though days had passed. Throughout the entire ordeal, he had to endure immense, searing pain that felt like someone was injecting lava into his veins.
<??? has invaded
<??? has taken root within your Dantian>
"Your body is... a little smaller... but... it's much more... comfortable...!" The curse remarked shortly after entering his Dantian.
"Oh...? What is... this...?"
It was also intrigued by the nearby Spirit Tree.
The very next moment—
<Spirit Tree has sensed ???>
<Spirit Tree temporarily emerges from hibernation>
<Spirit Tree has begun to absorb ???>
"W-WHAT IS... HAPPENING...?!"
The curse cried out loud when the Spirit Tree's roots suddenly attacked it and began draining it of its energy.
'Oh?'

Yuan was pleasantly surprised to see the Spirit Tree waking up to absorb the curse even without needing him to do anything. He'd initially planned on absorbing the curse himself, but if the Spirit Tree was going to do all of the work, he was fine with that, as well.
'You...! You... lied... to me...!"
The curse immediately started fighting back, slowly overpowering the Spirit Tree.
Seeing this, Yuan decided to step in and started attacking the curse with Eternal Essence.
"Why...?! Why are you... attacking me...?!"
"I thought... we were... comrades...?!"
The curse shouted.
"Comrades?" Yuan sneered. "Although you and I have no enmity for you, I am not an Eternal."
"What...?! Then how... can you... use... Eternal Essence...?!"
"You have no need for that knowledge since you'll also turn into my Eternal Essence soon."
"No...! I... curse you...!"
"Good luck with that!" Yuan laughed out loud as he continued weakening the curse and refining it into his own Eternal Essence at the same time.
However, the process took much longer than Yuan had anticipated.
The curse, although weak and only thirty percent completed, was still tens of billions of years old with immense energy from consuming countless demons.
One year... five years... twenty years...
It'd taken Yuan nearly thirty years to finish refining the curse.
"I will... return... one day..."
The curse muttered its last words before it was completely absorbed by Yuan.
<Spirit Tree has returned to hibernation>
<Spirit Tree has entered deep hibernation>
<You have refined an incompleted Eternal>
<Your Eternal Essence has improved significantly!>
<You have learned the Skill 'Curse Creation'>

After examining his condition, Yuan discovered that his Eternal Essence had strengthened by at least triple after consuming the curse. It was an immense gain considering how little effort it took him.

"So this is what it feels like to consume an Eternal, huh? To think I'd grow this much from an Eternal that wasn't even fully born." Yuan started wondering how much stronger he'd get if he were to refine a completed Eternal.
After finishing, Yuan slowly opened his eyes.
Immediately, he was met with a pair of beautiful crimson eyes, gleaming like two ruby jewels just inches from his face.
"Hey, Dena. How are you feeling?" Yuan asked her with a calm smile on his face.
Supreme Ruler Dena had awakened, and she was crouched directly in front of him, her crimson eyes fixed on Yuan as if she were examining him.
"Tian... Chenyu?" she muttered in a low voice, sounding as if she was doubting her own eyes.
"I was Tian Chenyu, but that was long ago. Now, I am simply Yuan."
Supreme Ruler Dena nodded and then said, "Were you the one who woke me up from that everlasting nightmare?"
"What do you think? Who else besides me is here?"
A warm smile tugged at Supreme Ruler Dena's lips, causing her already ethereal beauty to shine even more radiantly.
"I have a lot of questions for you," Yuan said.
"As do I," said Dena. "But you may ask your questions first."
Yuan nodded and proceeded to ask about the Eternal.
"You... consumed an Eternal before it was born? How does that work? And why did you do it?"
Supreme Ruler Dena pondered her answer for a moment before speaking, "That's right. I sensed a familiar energy appearing somewhere in the void, so I went to investigate it, thinking it was you."
"But when I arrived, it turned out to be something else entirely. It was some kind of crystal, and it emitted an energy that I could not comprehend, so I ate it."
"You ate it just like that? Have you ever considered the consequences?" Yuan asked, even though he had no right to lecture someone else about their eating habits.

She calmly shrugged before continuing, "I thought I would be able to acquire that power after consuming it, but alas, even though I was able to comprehend it to a certain extent, I was unable to wield it."
"But you were able to replicate it. How did you do that?"
Supreme Ruler Dena raised an eyebrow and asked, "What are you talking about?"
"You... don't remember? I fought with your clones not long ago, and they were able to wield an energy similar to Eternal Essence."
Supreme Ruler Dena then said, "My memories are still a bit blurry since I've only just woken up."
"Well, what do you remember?"
"That I consumed the crystal and returned home. But anything after that is a haze."
"Is that so..." Yuan muttered.
"It's my turn to ask some questions," Supreme Ruler Dena then said.
"Where are we?" she then asked.
"Huh? When did you wake up?" Yuan asked.
"Shortly after you removed that thing inside me."
"And you haven't bothered to go outside even once?" "No. I didn't want to leave your side," she calmly replied, leaving him speechless.

"I was Tian Chenyu, but that was long ago.
Now, I am simply Yuan."
Supreme Ruler Dena nodded and then said, "Were you the one who woke me up from that everlasting nightmare?"
"What do you think?
Who else besides me is here?"
A warm smile tugged at Supreme Ruler Dena's lips, causing her already ethereal beauty to shine even more radiantly.
"I have a lot of questions for you," Yuan said.
"As do I," said Dena.
"But you may ask your questions first."
Yuan nodded and proceeded to ask about the Eternal.
"You... consumed an Eternal before it was born?
How does that work?
And why did you do it?"
Supreme Ruler Dena pondered her answer for a moment before speaking, "That's right.
I sensed a familiar energy appearing somewhere in the void, so I went to investigate it, thinking it was you."
"But when I arrived, it turned out to be something else entirely.
It was some kind of crystal, and it emitted an energy that I could not comprehend, so I ate it."
"You ate it just like that?
Have you ever considered the consequences?" Yuan asked, even though he had no right to lecture someone else about their eating habits.

She calmly shrugged before continuing, "I thought I would be able to acquire that power after consuming it, but alas, even though I was able to comprehend it to a certain extent, I was unable to wield it."
"But you were able to replicate it.
How did you do that?"
Supreme Ruler Dena raised an eyebrow and asked, "What are you talking about?"
"You... don't remember?
I fought with your clones not long ago, and they were able to wield an energy similar to Eternal Essence."
Supreme Ruler Dena then said, "My memories are still a bit blurry since I've only just woken up."
"Well, what do you remember?"
"That I consumed the crystal and returned home.
But anything after that is a haze."
"Is that so..." Yuan muttered.
"It's my turn to ask some questions," Supreme Ruler Dena then said.
"Where are we?" she then asked.
"Huh?
When did you wake up?" Yuan asked.
"Shortly after you removed that thing inside me."
"And you haven't bothered to go outside even once?" "No.
I didn't want to leave your side," she calmly replied, leaving him speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 2375 Supreme Ruler Dena's Awakening
paragraphs: "You didn't want to leave me alone? What am I, a child who cannot be left alone?" Yuan shook his head at her reasoning, but a smile tugged at his face.
"By the way, we're inside the Deprived Crimson Valley. The Final Valley, at that."
"...Is that so?" said Supreme Ruler Dena, seemingly not surprised by their location.
"You're not surprised? Do you remember being exiled?" Yuan inquired with a raised eyebrow.
She shook her head.
"I think I vaguely remember something like that. Not that it matters. I can leave this place whenever I want, anyway."
"Because you were given the title of Supreme Ruler, right? Now that I think about it, you might be the first Supreme Ruler to be exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley," Yuan remarked.
"Probably," she calmly replied with a nonchalant look on her face, almost as if she couldn't care less about such an achievement.
"Now, back to my questions."
"You... Why have you returned to this world?" Supreme Ruler Dena's expression suddenly turned serious as her crimson eyes stared directly into his.
Yuan sighed before replying, "To be honest, it wasn't my intention. I ended up here by accident."
"So you don't have any business with our world... or our people?" she continued to ask, clearly seeking reassurance.
"Don't worry, I have already promised not to interfere with the people of this world as long as you don't invade my world again."
Supreme Ruler Dena nodded and said, "As long as I am here, such a thing will never occur again."
"You mean as long as you are the Supreme Ruler. Unfortunately, since you have been exiled for some reason, we have a new Supreme Ruler," Yuan sighed.
"So what if I had been exiled and replaced? I can simply reclaim my position by getting rid of the current Supreme Ruler."
'Despite her calm voice and cute face, she's saying some awfully terrible thing,' Yuan sighed inwardly. However, he was already used to her character, so it wasn't too surprising.
"If you do that, you'll become a tyrannical ruler. Do you remember what happened to the last one who tried to rule with absolute authority?" Yuan said a moment later.
"Then what should I do?" she asked him.

"Before we even consider anything, we need to figure out the reason behind your exile. I thought it was because you had turned into Forsaken at first because of what I was told, but that's clearly not the case."
"Me? A Forsaken? Ridiculous," she quietly sneered in disdain at whoever made up such a bold lie.
"Honestly, I wouldn't blame them if they thought you had turned Forsaken. After all, you were being controlled by that curse." "..."
Supreme Ruler Dena fell silent, as she had no excuses for that.
"Anyway, are you ready to leave this place?" Yuan then asked.
Supreme Ruler Dena stood up and replied, "Yes."
Yuan also got off the ground and did a quick stretch. The next moment, Supreme Ruler Dena withdrew her personal domain, sending them back to the world outside.
When they returned to the Final Valley, Yuan was stunned by the barren landscape that stretched before him.
The crimson sea was gone, but it had already consumed all life that once existed there.
Supreme Ruler Dena stared silently at the barren land for a moment before asking quietly, "Am I responsible for this?"
Yuan didn't try to sugarcoat his answer. "Even if it wasn't by your own will, you are technically responsible."
After another moment of silence, Supreme Ruler Dena lifted her palm above the lifeless land and let a single drop of her now-crimson blood fall to the ground.
In the next instant, a powerful ripple spread outward, restoring the land's lost life force and breathing new vitality into it.
The land, which had remained dead for billions of years, suddenly came back to life as crimson grass and weirdly shaped trees began to grow rapidly.
"Where do you want to go?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked after taking a moment to admire her own work.
"The Eighth Valley. I have some people waiting for me there."
Without another word, Supreme Ruler Dena grabbed Yuan's hand and took a step forward.
In the next instant, Yuan was pulled into a different dimension.
'Void Manipulation!'
He immediately recognized the power she had used, and it was several levels more advanced than his own.
In mere moments, they arrived at the border between the Eighth and Ninth Valleys—something that had taken Yuan several years to traverse before.
Seeing how convenient Void Manipulation was, Yuan decided to master it as soon as possible.
Meanwhile, Lev, who had been hiding not far away, suddenly sensed Yuan's presence return. "This presence... he's back!?"
Realizing whose presence it belonged to, Lev hurried out of his hiding place, unable to hide his excitement.
However, his excitement quickly turned into shock and terror when he noticed the beautiful young woman standing beside Yuan.

She possessed a slender and modest figure, her head almost reaching Yuan's chest, and she looked as though she had only recently reached adulthood. Her pale skin, long crimson hair, and sharp crimson eyes made her appearance both striking and unsettling.
Yet the most frightening thing about her was the terrifying aura she emitted, one that could not be hidden—not that she was trying to hide it in the first place.
"S-S-Supreme Ruler Dena?!?!" Lev cried out loud, not daring to believe his eyes.
When he saw her, he subconsciously turned around and started running away, even though Yuan was also with her.
"Where do you think you're going?"
Yuan immediately activated Demon Sealing Zone to prevent Lev from running away without hurting him.
"Please spare my life!" Lev cried as tears literally flowed from his eyes.
"Calm down. Nobody is trying to take your pitiful life." Yuan sighed out loud, but Lev continued pleading for his life, as if he couldn't hear Yuan.
"Who is this weirdo?" Supreme Ruler Dena questioned Yuan about his relationship with this odd individual.
"A friend I made along the way to meet you," he replied with a weak smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 2376 Leaving Deprived Crimson Valley
paragraphs: When Lev refused to calm down even after his movements were restricted by the Demon Sealing Zone, Yuan realized he had no choice but to take more drastic measures.
Without hesitation, he summoned the Swords of Eternal Torment and impaled Lev with a single blade, unleashing intense agony upon him like brutal shock therapy.
"Ah! I'm dying!" Lev screamed after experiencing physical pain for the first time.
However, as the agony persisted and he realized that he wasn't actually dying, he slowly turned toward Yuan and begged, "P-Please..."
Yuan deactivated the techniques and asked, "Have you finally calmed down a little?"
Lev nodded, but when his gaze noticed Supreme Ruler Dena again, his body started to tremble uncontrollably.
"I-I'm sorry... I don't know what's happening to my body... It's not listening to me..." Lev said as he struggled to stop himself from running away again.
Yuan glanced at Supreme Ruler Dena and sighed. "I completely forgot that your presence can terrorize others. Can you do something about it like before?"
"What a pain in the ass," she muttered before suppressing her presence.
However, even after Supreme Ruler Dena suppressed all of her presence, the aura naturally emitted by her soul could not be completely concealed, not to mention her naturally cold gaze.
Although he no longer felt the overwhelming urge to flee, Lev's body continued to tremble slightly.
"You'll get used to it," Yuan said to him.
Lev nodded and quickly bowed to Supreme Ruler Dena. "I-I apologize for my earlier reaction. It was disrespectful of me. This lowly subject greets the Supreme Ruler."
Supreme Ruler Dena remained silent, not even bothering to acknowledge his greeting.
Lev didn't mind in the slightest.
Genuinely.

In the Demonic Realm, the Supreme Rulers stood above all, and they rarely spared even a glance at those beneath them. For her to simply look in his direction without turning away was already an immense honor.
Of course, Yuan also knew of this, so he didn't mention it.
"Lev, where's Duck?" Yuan asked a moment later.

"Oh... he left shortly after he could no longer see you, saying that it would only be a waste of time to wait for your return," Lev sighed. "Well, I can't blame him for that," Yuan said with a slight chuckle. "Then why did you stay?"

Lev scratched the back of his head awkwardly. "To be frank with you, I would've left if I could. But with my cultivation, there's no way I'd make it back alone. So my only options were to wait for your return... or wait for death to come for me here."
"Sorry..." Yuan couldn't help but pity Lev.
"You have no reason to apologize. I was the one who decided to follow you here while knowing full well that I would probably never return alive."
Yuan then said to Supreme Ruler Dena, "He's going to leave the Deprived Crimson Valley with us."
In response, she gave a simple head nod.
The next moment, without warning, Supreme Ruler Dena casually tore open the space before her with a single motion of her arm and stepped forward, pulling Yuan with her.
Lev was dragged along as well, though far less elegantly, carried by her spiritual energy like a piece of luggage.
Several moments later, they emerged from the void.
While Supreme Ruler Dena and Yuan landed gracefully, Lev fell face-first onto the ground.
As he scrambled back to his feet and surveyed his surroundings, his eyes widened in shock when he realized they were already at the First Valley.
"This is... the First Valley?!"
The only reason he realized this so quickly was because of the sight before him.
A massive semi-transparent barrier that stretched across the horizon, surrounding the entire Deprived Crimson Valley and keeping the exiles imprisoned within.
The barrier had existed for longer than anyone could remember. Some even believed it had been formed by nature itself when the world was first created.
Every demon ever exiled to the Deprived Crimson Valley had attempted to break through it at least once, but no matter how much time passed, the barrier remained untouched and unscarred.
Because of this, it came to be known as "The Invincible Wall."
Seeing the barrier, Lev couldn't help but recall the numerous times he had tried—and failed—to break through it.
The Invincible Wall wasn't just indestructible. It even prevented those capable of using Void Manipulation from passing through.
It was, without question, the perfect barrier.
"So, how are you going to get us out of here?" Yuan asked as he stared at the barrier. "I doubt I will be able to crack it even with my full strength."
Supreme Ruler Dena calmly replied, "Only those who have been given the title of Supreme Ruler are allowed to control the barrier."
"Will it work even if you are no longer the Supreme Ruler?"
"It's not just a title, you know," she said. "Although anyone can claim to be one, only those who have undergone the ritual and experienced the process are considered a true Supreme Ruler."

"During that ritual, we are granted the authority to govern this world through our souls. One such authority is control over the Invincible Wall. The only way for that power to be removed is through the same ritual... or true death."
"And since I can still sense that authority within me, there should be no problem."
"Is that so? In that case, I'll leave it to you."
Supreme Ruler Dena nodded before shifting her gaze to the Invincible Wall.
Suddenly, the word 'Authority' manifested on her forehead, emitting a soft but profound crimson glow.
She then gently tapped the surface of the Invincible Wall.
In the next instant, as if obeying her command, the barrier parted, creating an opening just large enough for three people to walk through.
Without saying a word, Supreme Ruler Dena calmly stepped through the barrier and then turned to look back at them.
Yuan followed her without hesitation.
Lev, however, remained frozen for a brief moment, as if needing to confirm he wasn't dreaming before finally stepping forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 2377 Demon God’s Wrath
paragraphs: After leaving the Deprived Crimson Valley, Supreme Ruler Dena looked at Yuan and asked, "What now?"

"Before we decide what we want to do, I need to know what you plan on doing now, Lev." Yuan turned to face Lev, who stood still with a dumbfounded look on his face, almost as if he was still having trouble believing that he was outside of the Deprived Crimson Valley.

However, he quickly snapped out of it and said, "Although I am grateful to you for helping me leave the Deprived Crimson Valley, it won't change the fact that I am still an exile, and that my soul is still branded as one. But that won't stop me from avenging my family!"
Yuan then asked Supreme Ruler Dena, "Can you do something about the branding with your Authority?"
She calmly nodded and pointed a finger at Lev.
Lev swallowed nervously, wondering what she was going to do to him.

The 'Authority' symbol appeared on Supreme Ruler Dena's forehead again, and the next second, a single strand of her crimson hair suddenly shot toward Lev's forehead, penetrating his skin like it was wet paper and striking his soul.
"It's done," she calmly said as she retrieved her hair.
"What...?"
Lev wore a blank look on his face, as if he didn't even realize what she'd done to him. In fact, it happened so fast that he wasn't even able to react!
"Congratulations, Lev. You're no longer an exile," Yuan said with a faint smile.
Before Lev could respond, Yuan continued, "I won't tell you how to live your life, but I wouldn't recommend dedicating it entirely to revenge. I've lived that way before, and it leads nowhere good."
Lev lowered his head to stare at the ground for a moment before responding in a low voice, "Then what else am I supposed to do?"

"I survived the Deprived Crimson Valley for so long because of my desire to avenge my family. However, now that I think about it, with how much time has passed, I doubt I will even be able to find the person who killed them—if they're even still alive."

Yuan then spoke, "If you don't know what you want to do, why don't you continue following us for now and think it over? Perhaps you might find a new purpose in life. That said, I cannot guarantee your safety."
Lev didn't need to spend much time pondering about Yuan's offer and quickly nodded, "If you don't mind having me, it'd be an honor to continue being by your side."
"Now then..." Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena and said, "Let's figure out why you were exiled first before we decide on anything."
"How are we going to do that?"
"We can ask around—"
"Please don't do that." Lev suddenly interrupted.
"Have you forgotten? We are prohibited from mentioning her name outside the Deprived Crimson Valley," he reminded Yuan.
"So what? It's not like such rules have never been broken before."

However, instead of Lev, Supreme Ruler Dena spoke, "No, he's right. If the current Supreme Ruler prohibited my name from being mentioned, anyone who utters it—even if nobody is listening—will be struck by the Demon God's Wrath."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this information, wondering if this Demon God's Wrath was akin to Heavenly Tribulation in his world, where those who defy the Heavenly Laws will be punished.
"This is my first time hearing about such a thing," he remarked.
"What? How is that even possible?" Lev stared at Yuan in disbelief. "The Demon God's Wrath is basic common sense. Even a newborn knows about it."
"Oh, right." Yuan glanced at him and smiled. "Since you'll continue traveling with us from now on, I should probably catch you up on a few things."
"First of all, I am not from this world."
"Huh?" Lev's eyes widened as he tried to comprehend Yuan's words.
However, Yuan wasn't done, and he continued to bombard Lev with more shocking revelations.
"Not only do I not belong to this world, but I'm also not a demon. I'm actually a human. That's why there are many things about this world that I don't know," Yuan revealed.
"Although I visited this place before, it's been so long that most of my knowledge is probably no longer reliable."
After several moments of silence, Lev finally spoke in a nervous tone, "I knew you were strange, but to think you're actually from the world of countless legends... the Divine Heaven!"
He continued, "I read in some ancient history books that the Forsaken used to be sent there to save resources and space, but for some reason, that practice stopped."
"Ahem."

Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly cleared her throat loudly before speaking. "That's not correct. We didn't send the Forsaken to the Divine Heaven. At the time, we weren't even aware of its existence. We only believed we were sending the Forsaken somewhere into the boundless void."

"It wasn't until a certain individual appeared in our world and began wreaking havoc that we realized the truth—and the consequences of our careless actions," she continued with a soft sigh, her crimson eyes staring directly at Yuan with a somewhat apologetic gaze.
"Is that so...? I was born after that period, so I had no idea."
"Hm? If you're not from our world, then what were you doing inside the Deprived Crimson Valley? In fact, how the hell did you even get inside?" Lev turned to look at Yuan and asked.
Yuan shrugged and said, "I came here by accident."
"Seriously...? Then you're incredibly lucky that Supreme Ruler—"
Lev abruptly sealed his mouth with his hands when he realized that he had nearly committed a serious offense and invoked Demon God's Wrath.
"That was close. I almost uttered something I shouldn't have."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at his reaction. Then, after a moment of silence, he said, "Lev, move away from me. You too, Dena."
"What are you trying to do?" Lev asked with a puzzled face.
He smiled and calmly replied, "I want to see for myself the prowess of the Demon God's Wrath and whether it's truly threatening or not."
"You want to purposefully invoke Demon God's Wrath?! Are you insane?!" Lev cried out loud.
Then, without hesitation, he distanced himself from Yuan, moving so far away that he turned into a tiny black dot in the distance.
"Are you really going to do it?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked.
Although her words sounded concerned, her face remained completely calm.
"The Demon God's Wrath is unfathomably powerful, and depending on the severity of your crime, it could even exterminate a True God," she explained.
Yuan nodded, "I will be fine."
Without another word, Supreme Ruler Dena distanced herself from Yuan. However, unlike Lev, she moved only several meters back and remained very much in view.
Yuan took a deep breath before mumbling in a low voice, "Supreme Ruler Dena."
He immediately prepared to confront the Demon God's Wrath after uttering her name. "..."
However, nothing happened even a few seconds later, prompting Yuan to try again, this time louder.
"Supreme Ruler Dena," he spoke in a normal tone.
When nothing happened again, he shouted loudly, "SUPREME RULER DENA!"
Yet, even after waiting for many moments, the Demon God's Wrath never occurred.
"What the hell?" Yuan cursed out loud before turning to look at Lev. "Are you sure it's forbidden to say her name?"
Lev's head popped out from behind a tree as he replied, "Of course! I remember very clearly when the Supreme Ruler publicly announced it, as well as the hundreds of Demon God's Wrath that followed!"
"Then why isn't it coming after me? Is it because I don't belong to this world, so its rules don't apply to me?" he wondered out loud.
"Seriously...?" Lev mumbled in a dumbfounded voice, suddenly feeling an urge to test it out himself.
However, before he could do so, Supreme Ruler Dena beat him to the punch, speaking in a calm voice, "Supreme Ruler Dena."
The very next moment, Yuan sensed a sudden change in the surrounding atmosphere, sending a faint shiver down his body.
"This feeling..."
He subconsciously lifted his head to look at the sky, and sure enough, there was a reaction above. The clouds had darkened and twisted into a swirling vortex that resembled the eye of a hurricane.
Then, from the very center of that eye, a massive crimson beam suddenly descended.
Unsurprisingly, its target was Supreme Ruler Dena.
The beam was so massive that Yuan had to retreat to avoid being caught in it.
And the moment he exited its range, the beam struck Supreme Ruler Dena without mercy, completely engulfing her figure in its massive crimson light.
The Demon God's Wrath lasted only a little over a second, yet in that brief moment, it carved a massive crater into the ground—so deep that its depths were swallowed in pitch-black darkness.
Meanwhile, Supreme Ruler Dena was nowhere to be seen, as if she had been completely vaporized by the attack.

"Before we decide what we want to do, I need to know what you plan on doing now, Lev." Yuan turned to face Lev, who stood still with a dumbfounded look on his face, almost as if he was still having trouble believing that he was outside of the Deprived Crimson Valley.

However, he quickly snapped out of it and said, "Although I am grateful to you for helping me leave the Deprived Crimson Valley, it won't change the fact that I am still an exile, and that my soul is still branded as one.
But that won't stop me from avenging my family!"
Yuan then asked Supreme Ruler Dena, "Can you do something about the branding with your Authority?"
She calmly nodded and pointed a finger at Lev.
Lev swallowed nervously, wondering what she was going to do to him.

The 'Authority' symbol appeared on Supreme Ruler Dena's forehead again, and the next second, a single strand of her crimson hair suddenly shot toward Lev's forehead, penetrating his skin like it was wet paper and striking his soul.
"It's done," she calmly said as she retrieved her hair.
"What...?"
Lev wore a blank look on his face, as if he didn't even realize what she'd done to him.
In fact, it happened so fast that he wasn't even able to react!
"Congratulations, Lev.
You're no longer an exile," Yuan said with a faint smile.
Before Lev could respond, Yuan continued, "I won't tell you how to live your life, but I wouldn't recommend dedicating it entirely to revenge.
I've lived that way before, and it leads nowhere good."
Lev lowered his head to stare at the ground for a moment before responding in a low voice, "Then what else am I supposed to do?"
"I survived the Deprived Crimson Valley for so long because of my desire to avenge my family.
However, now that I think about it, with how much time has passed, I doubt I will even be able to find the person who killed them—if they're even still alive."
Yuan then spoke, "If you don't know what you want to do, why don't you continue following us for now and think it over?
Perhaps you might find a new purpose in life.
That said, I cannot guarantee your safety."
Lev didn't need to spend much time pondering about Yuan's offer and quickly nodded, "If you don't mind having me, it'd be an honor to continue being by your side."
"Now then..." Yuan looked at Supreme Ruler Dena and said, "Let's figure out why you were exiled first before we decide on anything."
"How are we going to do that?"
"We can ask around—"
"Please don't do that." Lev suddenly interrupted.
"Have you forgotten?
We are prohibited from mentioning her name outside the Deprived Crimson Valley," he reminded Yuan.
"So what?
It's not like such rules have never been broken before."
However, instead of Lev, Supreme Ruler Dena spoke, "No, he's right.
If the current Supreme Ruler prohibited my name from being mentioned, anyone who utters it—even if nobody is listening—will be struck by the Demon God's Wrath."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this information, wondering if this Demon God's Wrath was akin to Heavenly Tribulation in his world, where those who defy the Heavenly Laws will be punished.
"This is my first time hearing about such a thing," he remarked.
"What?
How is that even possible?" Lev stared at Yuan in disbelief.
"The Demon God's Wrath is basic common sense.
Even a newborn knows about it."
"Oh, right." Yuan glanced at him and smiled.
"Since you'll continue traveling with us from now on, I should probably catch you up on a few things."
"First of all, I am not from this world."
"Huh?" Lev's eyes widened as he tried to comprehend Yuan's words.
However, Yuan wasn't done, and he continued to bombard Lev with more shocking revelations.
"Not only do I not belong to this world, but I'm also not a demon.
I'm actually a human.
That's why there are many things about this world that I don't know," Yuan revealed.
"Although I visited this place before, it's been so long that most of my knowledge is probably no longer reliable."
After several moments of silence, Lev finally spoke in a nervous tone, "I knew you were strange, but to think you're actually from the world of countless legends... the Divine Heaven!"
He continued, "I read in some ancient history books that the Forsaken used to be sent there to save resources and space, but for some reason, that practice stopped."
"Ahem."
Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly cleared her throat loudly before speaking.
"That's not correct.
We didn't send the Forsaken to the Divine Heaven.
At the time, we weren't even aware of its existence.
We only believed we were sending the Forsaken somewhere into the boundless void."

"It wasn't until a certain individual appeared in our world and began wreaking havoc that we realized the truth—and the consequences of our careless actions," she continued with a soft sigh, her crimson eyes staring directly at Yuan with a somewhat apologetic gaze.
"Is that so...?
I was born after that period, so I had no idea."
"Hm?
If you're not from our world, then what were you doing inside the Deprived Crimson Valley?
In fact, how the hell did you even get inside?" Lev turned to look at Yuan and asked.
Yuan shrugged and said, "I came here by accident."
"Seriously...?
Then you're incredibly lucky that Supreme Ruler—"
Lev abruptly sealed his mouth with his hands when he realized that he had nearly committed a serious offense and invoked Demon God's Wrath.
"That was close.
I almost uttered something I shouldn't have."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at his reaction.
Then, after a moment of silence, he said, "Lev, move away from me.
You too, Dena."
"What are you trying to do?" Lev asked with a puzzled face.

Are you insane?!" Lev cried out loud.

chapters.title: Chapter 2378 Demise Ravine
paragraphs: "M-My god! Don't tell me she's dead?!" Lev approached the hole after witnessing the Demon God's Wrath strike Supreme Ruler Dena with enough prowess to completely obliterate a True God with ease.
However, Yuan remained calm as he looked down the pitch-black hole and asked, "Hey, are you hurt?"
A few moments later, Yuan and Lev watched as a crimson sphere slowly rose from the crater.
It was Supreme Ruler Dena, her entire figure concealed beneath her crimson hair, which wrapped tightly around her body like a protective barrier.
Once she landed, the hair slowly retracted, revealing that she was completely unharmed.
"What do you think?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked Yuan, acting like nothing out of the ordinary had just occurred.
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "It's a little more powerful than I expected. Not only that, but I could sense a hint of Eternal Essence within that attack just now."
"Eternal Essence..." Supreme Ruler Dena raised an eyebrow. "What is Eternal Essence? I feel like I have heard it before," she suddenly asked.
"What?" Yuan stared at her with wide eyes. "You don't know?"

He figured that with her prowess and experience, she would've already been aware of Eternals and their power. "That power you sensed from the crystal you consumed. That's Eternal Essence," he gave a brief explanation.
He then emitted a little Eternal Essence just to let her see it again.
"This is Eternal Essence."
Supreme Ruler Dena gazed at the unique aura emanating from him, her crimson eyes flickering with intrigue and excitement, seemingly mesmerized.
"How did you acquire that power?" she quickly asked.
She consumed the crystal without knowing its identity because she wanted to acquire its power, but it backfired on her.
"How...? It's a long story, so let's save it for later."
"Why? We have time," she said.
"Um..." Lev suddenly interrupted. "We should probably get out of here as soon as possible. Not only did we escape from the Deprived Crimson Valley, but we even invoked Demon God's Wrath."
"Lev's right. Let's leave before we give ourselves into unnecessary trouble."
Without another word, Yuan picked a random direction and started flying away.
Lev immediately followed, with Supreme Ruler Dena being the last to leave.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Demonic Realm, a messenger approached a fully cloaked figure and said, "Supreme Ruler, we have a situation."
"Speak."
"We have just received reports that the one who dwelled within the Final Valley of the Deprived Crimson Valley has vanished. Someone also invoked Demon God's Wrath right outside the Invincible Wall."
The Supreme Ruler turned to face the messenger and asked, "Are you telling me that Dena had left the Deprived Crimson Valley and invoked Demon God's Valley so soon afterward?
"We're not certain if she had really left the Deprived Crimson Valley, but we can never be too careful. It's that monster we're talking about, after all."

"Dena has spent tens of billions of years inside the Final Valley without leaving that area. Why would she suddenly leave the Deprived Crimson Valley now? Investigate it immediately," commanded the Supreme Ruler.
"I have already sent some people to investigate the Demon God's Wrath. As for the situation inside the Deprived Crimson Valley, that will take a little longer..."
"What should we do if it turns out that she'd really left the Deprived Crimson Valley?"
The Supreme Ruler remained silent for an entire minute before responding, "If we allow a monster like her to roam our world, who knows how much longer it'll last."
"Don't worry, if it really comes down to it, I'll deal with Dena myself."
"Yes, Supreme Ruler."
Shortly after Yuan and his group left, several True Gods arrived at their location to investigate the cause of the Demon God's Wrath.
"I can't believe they sent five whole True Gods to investigate a mere Demon God's Wrath," one of them remarked as they arrived.
"What a waste of time. Whoever invoked it is definitely already dead," said another.
"I have never seen a Demon God's Wrath cause such destruction before. Whoever invoked it must have been either really powerful or did something unfathomably evil."
"Likely the latter. Only an Absolute God would be powerful enough to invoke such a strong reaction, but none of them would be foolish enough to offend the Demon God."
The True Gods barely investigated the scene before leaving to report that nothing was out of the ordinary.
At the same time, Yuan and his group arrived at a new location.
"Where are we?" Yuan asked, his gaze fixed on the eerie landscape before him.

Lev answered in a subdued voice, "The Deprived Crimson Valley is bordered by four dangerous regions—the Death Desert in the south, the Forest of Entrapment in the north, the Sea of Death in the west, and the Demise Ravine... which is where we are now."
"The Demise Ravine, huh? I've heard of it," Yuan remarked as Tian Chenyu's memories resurfaced in his mind.
Although he had never personally visited the Demise Ravine before, he was familiar with its infamous reputation—a perilous land where powerful spiritual beings, similar to ghosts, roamed freely.

These ghost-like entities were known as Nether Wraiths. Not only did they possess spectral appearances, but they were also immune to physical attacks, making them troublesome opponents for demons, who mostly relied on their own blood as weapons.

It didn't help that spiritual techniques were extremely rare in the Demonic Realm. Although demons could still use their Soul Strength to attack, they could only release it outward in a crude manner, like expending spiritual energy without any technique behind it. It was both incredibly inefficient and lacking in power.

"Um... do you think it's possible to just use Void Manipulation and skip this entire place? This place is arguably even more dangerous than the Deprived Crimson Valley itself..." Lev suggested out loud as he looked at Yuan, while his eyes would glance at Supreme Ruler Dena, not daring to actually ask her.
Supreme Ruler Dena then said, "Using Void Manipulation is too tiring."
Although she didn't outright reject the idea, it was basically the same thing.
"Even though you used it inside the Deprived Crimson Valley...?" Lev mumbled in a dumbfounded voice.
Yuan smiled and said, "She doesn't want to admit it, but she's a little tired from blocking the Demon God's Wrath."
"Really? Even though she looks perfectly fine?
"That's precisely why she's exhausted. That Demon God's Wrath was powerful enough to obliterate a dozen True Gods with ease. Moreover, she's not currently at her full strength."
"What?" Lev raised his eyebrows in a puzzled manner.
However, Yuan refused to elaborate further and said, "What are you so worried about? It's just some spirit. I'll handle them with ease."
"If you say so..." Lev decided not to question further and accepted his fate.
"Let's go then. Stay close to me."
Yuan entered the Demise Ravine shortly after, where only a single wide path cut through the land, trapped between two enormous mountain ranges whose towering peaks seemed to pierce the heavens.
An eerie silence filled the Demise Ravine, broken only by the occasional sound of rocks tumbling down the mountains and splashing into the river beneath.
A thin layer of fog lingered throughout the ravine, veiling anything beyond several miles from view. Though that might sound far, such a distance could be closed in an instant.
As they traveled, Yuan spoke to Supreme Ruler Dena using voice transmission.
"How are you feeling?"
"Fine."
"We both know that's not true."
Although Supreme Ruler Dena appeared perfectly fine on the outside, she was actually greatly weakened after having her life force and energy drained by the curse for tens of billions of years.
To make matters worse, she had just invoked the Demon God's Wrath, which forced her to expend the little energy she had recovered since awakening.
In her current state, Supreme Ruler Dena didn't even possess ten percent of her former strength.
"I am fine," Supreme Ruler Dena repeated after a moment of silence.
Seeing how stubborn she was being, Yuan said, "Is that so? If you're fine, then I guess I won't need to feed you."
"Huh?" Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly turned to look at him with wide eyes. "What did you just say?"
Yuan smiled and replied, "I was going to feed you some of my blood to help you recover. However, since you're fine, you won't need it."
"T-That's..."
Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly recalled the taste of Yuan's blood. Even though tens of billions of years had passed since she last tasted it, the memory remained as vivid as if it were only yesterday.
At the thought of that heavenly taste, Supreme Ruler Dena subconsciously began to drool.

When Lev saw this, he initially thought he was seeing things. However, after turning away and looking back a few seconds later, only to find the drool still there—even increasing in quantity—he became utterly bewildered.
"Blood... I want it!" Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly declared out loud.

chapters.title: Chapter 2379 Nether Wraiths
paragraphs: "Blood? Are you hungry?" Lev misunderstood Supreme Ruler Dena's random demand and asked. Unlike humans, who could completely replace food and water with spiritual energy, demons lacked such an ability due to their heavy reliance on blood-based techniques. To strengthen or replenish their blood, they needed to consume meat or drink blood.

Fortunately, if they did not use any blood techniques or seek to strengthen their blood, demons could survive for far longer without food. However, doing so would essentially cripple them, as they would be unable to grow stronger or even fight properly.
Because of this weakness, the food resources of the Demonic Realm had grown incredibly scarce after billions of years of overhunting, leading to a widespread shortage.
Nowadays, only nobles and powerful demons were able to enjoy meat and fresh blood. Ordinary demons like Lev and everyone else had no choice but to resort to cannibalizing one another.

The Demonic Realm had tried to curb the problem by suppressing birth rates, but the demons' immoral nature made such a solution short-lived. Eventually, they turned to harsher rules and ruthless enforcement to reduce their population.

However, one day, they discovered that they could send their people—or more specifically, the Forsaken who had been abandoned by the Demon God—into the boundless void. As a result, living conditions in the Demonic Realm improved significantly. Of course, this gave rise to another problem, but it was not something they became aware of until a certain someone appeared in their world and caused havoc.
"I doubt we'll be able to find any within the Demise Ravine, since there are only spiritual beings here," Lev continued.
Hearing his words, Supreme Ruler Dena turned to look at him.
"D-Don't tell me..." Lev swallowed nervously, suddenly wondering if she intended to consume him instead.

Although demons possessed endless regeneration and could theoretically sustain themselves by consuming their own flesh or that of others, such a thing was not actually possible—as though the universe had anticipated this loophole and corrected it in advance. Because of this, the only way for a demon to strengthen itself or satisfy its hunger through another demon was to consume that demon's core, an act that would inevitably result in the other demon's death.
"I haven't consumed another demon for billions of years now. Why would I want to consume you?" Supreme Ruler Dena remarked.

Lev opened his mouth but quickly closed it without uttering a word. He wanted to say that she'd consumed countless demons within the Deprived Crimson Valley over the course of billions of years, but he decided not to question it. Of course, Lev was unaware of Supreme Ruler Dena's situation with the curse. He wanted to ask Yuan about what happened between them and why the crimson sea suddenly vanished with Supreme Ruler Dena acting like she wasn't even responsible for it, but decided not to question it.
Yuan then spoke, "I'll let you consume my blood later, once we find a safe place to sit down."
Without a word, Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly unleashed some of her aura and proceeded to punch the mountain beside them, creating a massive hole in it.
"We can do it here," she calmly said afterward.
Yuan and Lev stared at her with dumbfounded expressions.
"You...! Why did you do that?! That definitely alerted the Nether Wraiths!" Lev cried out loud. "We need to leave immediately before we're swarmed by them!"
Yuan rubbed his eyes and let out a sigh. "Dena, you really need to stop acting before you think..."
The next moment, ghostly wails reverberated throughout the ravine, sending chills down Lev's spine.
"T-They're coming!" he cried out loud.
"Let's go."
Without hesitation, Yuan surged forward. Lev hurried after him, with Supreme Ruler Dena following close behind, a slight pout still on her face.
However, they weren't able to get far before a dozen Nether Wraiths surrounded them.
These Nether Wraiths possessed a spectral appearance, their semi-transparent bodies drifting through the air like human figures shrouded in crimson veils.
Although these beings possessed no discernible presence, a subtle aura still lingered around them, revealing their cultivation at the peak of the False God realm.
"Oh my god! There are so many of them!" Lev exclaimed in a terrified voice.
Yuan retrieved the Demon Devouring Sword and wanted to try devouring them. However, in the end, the Demon Devouring Sword could only devour demons.
"What are you doing?! Nether Wraiths are immune to physical attacks!" Lev, who thought Yuan wanted to fight using his sword, loudly explained.
"I know. I just wanted to try something." Yuan calmly replied.
'If they're anything like the corrupted souls in the Shadow Realm...'
With that thought in mind, Yuan suddenly unleashed a tremendous amount of Soul Strength, causing a profound pressure to blanket the entire area. It startled not only the Nether Wraiths but even Lev.

But he didn't stop there and continued to increase the output. Soon, the Nether Wraiths quickly began screaming in agony, their shrill wails echoing throughout the ravine. A few seconds later, their figures began to fade, as if they were being erased from existence itself.

Yuan's Soul Strength had reached an unfathomable level after cultivating for trillions of years during the phenomenon. Of course, he had not received its full benefits, but even so, it had improved so drastically that it had surpassed what even Cultivation Gods could achieve.
"Hm? That was it? They're a lot weaker than I anticipated," Yuan remarked after killing all Nether Wraiths without even lifting a finger.
Lev could only stare at him in awe.
"Just what the hell are you? That amount of Soul Power... I have never felt anything that powerful!" he commented.
In the Demonic Realm, Soul Strength was called Soul Power.
Even Supreme Ruler Dena was looking at him with her eyebrows slightly raised, seemingly surprised.
"That power is not something a first-level False God should possess," she spoke a moment later, before asking, "How did you train your Soul Power?"
"How? I cultivated it normally," he calmly replied.

sentences.text: "Blood?
Are you hungry?" Lev misunderstood Supreme Ruler Dena's random demand and asked.
Unlike humans, who could completely replace food and water with spiritual energy, demons lacked such an ability due to their heavy reliance on blood-based techniques.
To strengthen or replenish their blood, they needed to consume meat or drink blood.
Fortunately, if they did not use any blood techniques or seek to strengthen their blood, demons could survive for far longer without food.
However, doing so would essentially cripple them, as they would be unable to grow stronger or even fight properly.
Because of this weakness, the food resources of the Demonic Realm had grown incredibly scarce after billions of years of overhunting, leading to a widespread shortage.
Nowadays, only nobles and powerful demons were able to enjoy meat and fresh blood.
Ordinary demons like Lev and everyone else had no choice but to resort to cannibalizing one another.
The Demonic Realm had tried to curb the problem by suppressing birth rates, but the demons' immoral nature made such a solution short-lived.
Eventually, they turned to harsher rules and ruthless enforcement to reduce their population.
However, one day, they discovered that they could send their people—or more specifically, the Forsaken who had been abandoned by the Demon God—into the boundless void.
As a result, living conditions in the Demonic Realm improved significantly.
Of course, this gave rise to another problem, but it was not something they became aware of until a certain someone appeared in their world and caused havoc.
"I doubt we'll be able to find any within the Demise Ravine, since there are only spiritual beings here," Lev continued.
Hearing his words, Supreme Ruler Dena turned to look at him.
"D-Don't tell me..." Lev swallowed nervously, suddenly wondering if she intended to consume him instead.

Although demons possessed endless regeneration and could theoretically sustain themselves by consuming their own flesh or that of others, such a thing was not actually possible—as though the universe had anticipated this loophole and corrected it in advance.

Because of this, the only way for a demon to strengthen itself or satisfy its hunger through another demon was to consume that demon's core, an act that would inevitably result in the other demon's death.
"I haven't consumed another demon for billions of years now.
Why would I want to consume you?" Supreme Ruler Dena remarked.
Lev opened his mouth but quickly closed it without uttering a word.

Of course, Lev was unaware of Supreme Ruler Dena's situation with the curse.

chapters.title: Chapter 2380 Path of Enlightenment
paragraphs: "Cultivate normally...?" Lev's face twitched at Yuan's ridiculous answer.
There was simply no way that was true, but Lev had no evidence to prove it.

Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly asked, "When you entered False God, how long did you spend inside the Path of Enlightenment? How far did you go?" The phenomenon one experiences when attempting to enter God Ascension or False God is called the Path of Enlightenment in the Demonic Realm.
Yuan pondered for a moment before responding, "It happened only recently, but for some reason, I cannot recall exactly how far I was able to traverse, but I definitely remember passing 600 layers."
"Six hundred layers?!"
Not just Lev, but even Supreme Ruler Dena exclaimed in disbelief, their faces full of shock.

"I don't mean to be rude, but there's absolutely no way you have broken through 600 layers! You must have recalled wrong!" Lev said, refusing to believe Yuan's claim of 600 layers, unaware that Yuan had actually passed the 1,000th layer.

"I don't know if it still holds true now, but I was once considered to have gone the furthest at the Path of Enlightenment," said Supreme Ruler Dena. "And I was only able to reach the 300th layer. Yet, you somehow managed to double that?"
"You don't believe me?" Yuan raised his eyebrows. "I'm not lying, though."

Supreme Ruler Dena shook her head and said, "I believe you, since that's the only logical reasoning to your absurd level of Soul Power. I can only imagine how much stronger it'll get once your level advances and you reach True God, as your Soul Power will continuously grow with every level, depending on how far you have traversed in the Path of Enlightenment."
"And once you become a True God...you will regain all of the Soul Power you've lost."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this information.
"I will regain all of the Soul Power I cultivated during the Path of Enlightenment when I reach True God?"
He had reached Cultivation God before, but he never regained all of his Soul Strength, so this was news to him.
Supreme Ruler Dena fell silent for a moment before replying, "Or maybe it was the realm of Absolute God. I forgot."
"It's likely Absolute God, but the furthest I've ever gotten was True God. I wasn't even aware of the existence of the Absolute God until I returned here," Yuan said.
"Wait a second," Lev suddenly cut in. "What do you mean the furthest you've gotten was True God when you're clearly only at the first level False God? Did your cultivation regress?"
"No, I died and reincarnated." Yuan calmly explained his bizarre existence as if it were something ordinary.
"R-Reincarnated...?" Lev's jaw dropped.
The concept of reincarnation also existed within the Demonic Realm, but nobody had ever been able to prove that it was real.
"You... died?" Even Supreme Ruler Dena was looking at him with a dumbfounded expression, as Yuan had never explained in detail why he was now called Yuan instead of Tian Chenyu.
She simply assumed that he'd decided to change his name for some reason.
However, what truly surprised her wasn't the fact that he'd been reincarnated but that he'd died.
"How did you die?" Supreme Ruler Dena inquired, her crimson eyes narrowing slightly as a dangerous glint flickered within them.
Having fought Tian Chenyu herself, she was very well aware of his prowess. In fact, Tian Chenyu was the only individual whom she couldn't kill, even with all of her might.
"You don't want to know," Yuan said with a calm smile.
"I do," she insisted.
"I'll tell you when the time comes."
"Then give me your blood," she then said. "We've gotten rid of the Nether Wraiths, after all."

However, Yuan started stretching and responded in a tired voice, "I would love to, but after using so much power to get rid of them, I am now exhausted. I'll give you my blood once I recover a little.

Anyone, including Lev, could tell that Yuan was making things up, as he'd barely exerted any effort to deal with the Nether Wraiths. Yet, Supreme Ruler Dena could only accept it while silently gritting her teeth.
'Was the Supreme Ruler always this... docile?' Lev wondered inwardly as he glanced at Supreme Ruler Dena.

According to rumors, Supreme Ruler Dena was one of the most stubborn and troublesome Supreme Rulers to ever rule the Demonic Realm. Not only was she lazy and quick to push all of her responsibilities onto her subordinates, but she was also notoriously overbearing whenever things did not go her way.
Yet the Supreme Ruler Dena was the complete opposite right now, as she seemed to listen to Yuan without questioning his demands or forcing herself on him.
They resumed their journey shortly afterward.
Unsurprisingly, more Nether Wraiths appeared to attack them along the way. However, Yuan easily erased them from existence with his Soul Strength.
'This journey is far more relaxing than I anticipated...' Lev thought to himself, having already prepared for the worst.
He turned to look at Yuan, who was doing all of the work, and asked, "If you don't mind me asking, what's your world, the Divine Heaven, like?"
"It's pretty much the same as this world, but nowhere near as grim."
"Huh? What do you mean by grim?" Lev asked with a genuinely puzzled look on his face.

"Deprived Crimson Valley, Sea of Death, Valley of Blood, Corpse Mountain... most of the places in this world bear such grim names. Even the world itself is dyed in crimson, as if the entire realm has been soaked in blood."
"Is that so? They sound pretty ordinary to me," Lev said.
"Oh, my world is no longer called the Divine Heaven. After it was split into nine separate realms, it came to be known as the Nine Heavens."
"What?! Is that even possible? How could something like that even happen?" Lev asked, his gaze brimming with intrigue.
"Long story short, a huge fight broke out, and as a result, it split the world."

chapters.title: Chapter 2381 Forsaken
paragraphs: "A fight intense enough to split an entire world? I can't even begin to imagine what kind of beings would be involved," Lev said, shaking his head. "More importantly, how could a world remain intact after being split apart? If you smash a toy into several pieces, it becomes useless."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at Lev's comment, as the thought had never really occurred to him before.

'Now that I think about it, the Divine Heavens didn't collapse after being split apart. Normally, when a star is shattered, it explodes. Could the Absolute Power have had something to do with it?' he wondered inwardly.
"What about the people living in your world? Are they all as strong as you... Or near your level?" Lev continued to ask.

"There are many people with a higher cultivation base than I out there. However, if we're talking about pure combat prowess... I wouldn't lose to Cultivation Gods... probably. They're basically equivalent to True Gods in this world."

"Huh?" Lev looked at him with a puzzled expression. "What do you mean by 'probably'? If Cultivation Gods are equivalent to True Gods, you'll definitely defeat them, as you have already killed several of them here—with relative ease, at that."

Yuan shook his head and explained, "While that may be true, I possess an overwhelming advantage against the people of this world because of my Demon Sealing Aura, a power created specifically to counter your kind. If I were fighting a fellow human cultivator, I wouldn't have such an advantage. Even so, I am fairly confident that I would still be able to defeat them."

"Demon Sealing Aura... I've heard many stories about it, but its origins still remain a mystery to me. Why would someone create such a power? Were they trying to exterminate our race or something?" Lev asked.

A stiff smile appeared on Yuan's face as he replied, "Indeed, that's exactly why that individual created such a power. He wanted to completely annihilate demons—the same demons who killed his lover and terrorized his entire world for hundreds of years. However, he later learned that the demons who terrorized his world were different from the ones that lived in this world." "The Forsaken, huh?" Lev immediately understood what Yuan meant and let out a sigh.

"They were once ordinary people. But after being 'abandoned' by the Demon God, they turn into bloodthirsty monsters. Every day, every living being in this world lives with the constant fear of becoming a Forsaken, which is especially cruel for us, who are immortal. If I could meet the Demon God, I would want to ask him why he made us this way."

Moreover, according to some of the most ancient records available, the inhabitants of the Demonic Realm had not always been demons. Some accounts even claimed that they had once all resembled humans, just like Supreme Ruler Dena and those regarded as having 'noble' bloodlines.
"The Demon God, huh?" Yuan mumbled before asking aloud, "Has anyone actually seen the Demon God before? Or any evidence that he truly exists and isn't just some imaginary being?"
Lev shook his head and replied, "While I have never seen the Demon God before, he definitely exists."
Supreme Ruler Dena then said, "The Demon God is real."
Hearing the confidence in her voice, Yuan had to ask, "You... have you seen the Demon God before? I find it hard to believe that a Supreme Ruler would never have any contact with him."
"I have never personally met the Demon God before, but I have definitely spoken to him. It happened during the ritual where I obtained my title. It was also the Demon God who granted me this power.
Supreme Ruler Dena said while pointing to her forehead, or more specifically, the 'Authority' branded into her soul.
Supreme Ruler Dena said while pointing to her forehead, or more specifically, the 'Authority' branded into her soul.
"What did you talk about?" Yuan asked, his interest piqued.

Supreme Ruler Dena pondered for a moment before replying, "It happened so long ago that I can no longer remember much of it, but most of what he said concerned my responsibilities as a Supreme Ruler and the things I was forbidden from doing."
"Such as?"
"Such as..."
Supreme Ruler Dena paused for a bit before shrugging, "I don't remember."
"What? How can you forget about something so important?" Yuan exclaimed in disbelief. "What if you accidentally do said forbidden thing?"

"I was able to remember it perfectly when I was still the Supreme Ruler. However, after being replaced, I can feel my memories of the Demon God slowly vanishing. It'll only be a matter of time before I completely forget about our conversation."
"Is that so?"
"But the Demon God is definitely real. I can guarantee you that," she insisted, thinking Yuan didn't believe her.
However, to her surprise, Yuan spoke with a calm smile, "You do not have to convince me. I never doubted the Demon God's existence. In fact, I have personally met the Demon God before."
"What?! Is that true?!"
Both Lev and Supreme Ruler Dena halted their movements and shouted at him simultaneously.
He nodded and elaborated, "It happened shortly after I left the Demonic Realm in the past, and he was the one who approached me."
"What... What did the Demon God look like?" Lev asked.
"What did you talk about?" Supreme Ruler Dena questioned.
The two of them stared at Yuan with gazes so intense it felt as though they could burn a hole through his body.
Yuan opened his mouth but delayed his words for a good moment.
Then, he said, "I... forgot."
"What?! How can you forget about something so important?!" Lev exclaimed.
Yuan shrugged. "Since I died several times before my current incarnation, I'm still in the process of recovering all of my memories, so I don't remember everything."
"No way!"
Just as they were about to voice their complaints, an overwhelming pressure suddenly descended, swallowing what felt like the entire ravine.
The instant Yuan and his group sensed it, their bodies froze stiff.
"T-This presence! It could only be that thing!" Lev exclaimed in a low voice, his body shivering in fear.
"What thing?" Yuan asked with a slight frown.
"The undisputed ruler of the Demise Ravine—the Wraith Queen of Demise!"
