chapters.title: Chapter 2382 Queen Wraith of Demise
paragraphs: "Queen Wraith of Demise? What's so special about it? Isn't it just a slightly stronger Nether Wraith?" Yuan asked.
"Of course not! The Queen Wraith of Demise is immortal! Like, true immortality! Unlike ordinary Nether Wraiths, it will keep returning no matter how many times you kill it!" Lev explained.
"True immortality, huh? We'll see about that..." Yuan mumbled, doubting it truly couldn't be killed.
A few moments later, the Queen Wraith of Demise emerged from the right side of the mountain, its enormous figure slowly coming into view as it loomed over them like a giant.
"Holy shit..." Lev muttered with a dumbfounded look, clearly not expecting the Queen Wraith of Demise to be so massive.
Even Yuan was a bit surprised by its sheer size. As for its appearance, it resembled the Nether Wraiths, but rather than crimson, it was a deep violet.
"True God, huh." Supreme Ruler Dena calmly gazed at the massive wraith.
The Queen Wraith of Demise did not attack immediately after appearing. Instead, it merely watched them from above, like a god staring down at insignificant mortals.
Soon, even more wraiths appeared, and within moments, thousands of Nether Wraiths surrounded the Queen Wraith of Demise like an army of soldiers protecting their queen.
"Yuan... do you think you can handle this...?" Lev asked him in a trembling voice.
Yuan remained silent, which only further worried him.
"The Nether Wraiths seem to be communicating with the queen," Yuan suddenly remarked.
Although they had no mouths and could only produce ghostly noises, he could tell they were conveying something to the Queen Wraith of Demise.
"They're probably seeking the queen's help because you killed so many of them," Supreme Ruler Dena said.
"Well, what else was I supposed to do when they attacked us first?" Yuan shook his head.
"Thirty-five..."
A voice suddenly spoke to Yuan, but it was transmitted directly into his mind through voice transmission.
Yuan immediately realized who this unfamiliar voice belonged to and turned to stare at the Queen Wraith of Demise.
"That is the number of my children that you have killed," the Queen Wraith of Demise continued in a grim voice.
"Do you deny your crimes?"
Yuan calmly responded to it, "I won't deny it since it's true. However, they attacked us first."
"Nay!"
The Queen Wraith of Demise loudly declared. "According to the witnesses, you were the ones who attacked first! You even declared war by damaging our territory!" "..."

Yuan was rendered speechless by this new revelation and turned to look at Supreme Ruler Dena, who was casually hovering behind him with a nonchalant expression, utterly oblivious to the trouble she had caused them.
"What is it?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked after noticing his gaze.
"This is all your fault," Yuan said with a sigh.
"Then do you want me to handle it?" She took Yuan's words at face value and made no attempt to refute them.
"Do you really think you can handle that in your current state?" Yuan asked while pointing at the Queen Wraith of Demise.
Supreme Ruler Dena shifted her gaze to it and fell silent for a moment before shaking her head, "Probably not."
"Then let me handle it."

Yuan turned back to the Queen Wraith of Demise and spoke, "I admit that we were at fault for damaging your territory, but nothing good will come from dwelling on what has already happened. Let us set aside our grievances and avoid escalating this any further."
"You dare to tell me to forget about my children's death?!" The Queen Wraith of Demise shouted as her aura surged, seemingly prepared to attack.

"Either that or you'll have to experience even more losses." Yuan suddenly unleashed some of his Soul Strength to show the Queen Wraith of Demise that he had the capability to kill many of them with ease.
"Of course, I am also willing to compensate for your losses.
The Queen Wraith of Demise fell silent after sensing Yuan's overwhelming Soul Strength.

She could tell just from his Soul Strength that he wasn't going all out and that even if the army of thousands of Nether Wraiths around her were to attack him simultaneously, he would likely be able to kill them all just by scattering his Soul Strength.

The Queen Wraith of Demise was enraged by the deaths of her children and was, by nature, a vengeful being. However, she was neither foolish nor reckless, and she realized that attacking the man before her could cost her countless more of her children.
After several minutes of silence, the Queen Wraith of Demise spoke again, "I am willing to forgive you for killing my children if you do something for me."
"I am listening."
"I will tell you more about it later. Wait here for my return."
Without any explanation, the Queen Wraith of Demise turned around and disappeared. However, her army of Nether Wraiths remained to keep watch, ensuring they wouldn't run away.
"What's happening?" Lev asked, as he wasn't able to listen to their conversation. "Why did the Queen Wraith of Demise suddenly leave without doing anything?"
He had even prepared himself for a massive fight when the Queen Wraith of Demise released her aura.
Yuan proceeded to explain the whole situation to them.
"What?! They attacked us because we—she destroyed their territory?!" Lev exclaimed after learning of this.
"Can we even believe her words? What if she's just making shit up?" he then asked.

Yuan shrugged, "That could be the case, but it doesn't change the fact that I killed her children. If we can avoid an all-out war with these beings, I don't mind helping them out... as long as it's not something unreasonable."
"What kind of help?" Supreme Ruler Dena asked.
"I don't know yet, but we should find out soon enough."
However, even after waiting around for several days, the Queen Wraith of Demise did not return.
"Hey, what happened to your queen?" Yuan tried to communicate with the Nether Wraiths, but it was a pointless effort, as none of them were able to speak like their queen.

chapters.title: Chapter 2383 Feeding Supreme Ruler Dena
paragraphs: Yuan had no choice but to continue waiting when his communication with the Nether Wraiths failed.
Several more days passed by without any information.
"Are you sure we're not being scammed?" Lev remarked with a bored look on his face.
"Have some patience," Yuan said as he cultivated his Soul Strength.
"Hey."
Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly approached him and called out.
"What is it?" Yuan asked, his eyes still closed.
"I think this is a good time to feed me your blood," she calmly said.
Yuan was speechless.
"It will also help me recover some of my strength," she continued, trying to convince him.

Yuan opened one of his eyes to look at her face and said in a sighing voice, "You still dare to ask for blood after causing all of this trouble? Even if I give you my blood now, you'll only recover a little of your strength—not nearly enough to help our current situation."
"I might recover enough to use Void Manipulation to take us out of here," she said without an ounce of shame on her face.
Yuan pondered for a moment, but before he could give her an answer, he suddenly stopped his cultivation and opened both eyes.
"She's back," he said.
The next moment, a familiar presence appeared. However, something about it felt different, even though it clearly belonged to the Queen Wraith of Demise.

Soon, Yuan realized why it felt so different. Her appearance had changed. Instead of her ghostly, spectral form, she now stood before them in a human vessel—a beautiful woman with an alluring figure, black hair, pale skin, and violet eyes.
"Are you... the Queen Wraith of Demise...?" Lev almost couldn't believe his eyes asked.
"Indeed, I am," she calmly replied.
"Where did you get that vessel? And did you really just leave to change your form?" Yuan then asked.
"This vessel belonged to someone who perished in this place a few billion years ago. I decided to use it since it no longer has an owner," she answered.
"Did you kill her?" Yuan raised an eyebrow.

"Does it matter?" The Queen Wraith of Demise shrugged off his question before continuing, "As for why I have decided to take this form, it's simply because the place I will be taking you requires it. Without this vessel, I am unable to get close to it."
"Is the place that dangerous? What do you even need my help with?"
"You will know once we get there. Now, enough chattering and follow me."
Without giving them an opportunity to respond, the Queen Wraith of Demise turned around and began flying away.
Half of the Nether Wraiths followed her while the other half remained to watch over Yuan and his group to ensure they wouldn't run away.
"Let's go," Yuan said as he followed the wraiths with a calm demeanor.
Meanwhile, Lev was shaking in his boots—not because of the situation, but because of the subtle aura Supreme Ruler Dena was emitting.
"There's no need to pout," Yuan suddenly spoke without looking back. "I'll let you suck my blood as we travel since it'll probably take some time."
Hearing his words, the displeasure on her face vanished in an instant, replaced by a delighted expression.
The next instant, Supreme Ruler Dena flew right behind Yuan before wrapping her legs around his waist, clinging to his back like a kuala hugging a tree.
"What the...?" Lev's eyes nearly popped out of their sockets after seeing Supreme Ruler Dena's shocking actions that were definitely not befitting of someone with her status.

Then, with a single smooth motion, as if she'd done this a million times before, she loosened the robe around Yuan's neck. Without hesitation, she sank her canine teeth—sharper and longer than a human's—into his neck, drawing blood.
Despite Yuan's powerful physique that could repel even top-quality treasures, Supreme Ruler Dena's teeth very easily penetrated his skin and flesh.
When Supreme Ruler Dena's teeth entered his neck, Yuan could instantly feel his blood being consumed at a rapid rate, faster than even a severed arm would expel.
"Slow down, or you'll kill me," he hastily said, even though his regeneration was keeping up with his blood loss.

Queen Wraith of Demise glanced back when she noticed their actions, but after looking for a brief moment, she lost interest and no longer cared, as it was ordinary for demons to drink blood and eat flesh.
After she began her feasting, Supreme Ruler Dena did not stop sucking for an hour straight.
Seeing this, Lev couldn't help but drool, the scent of Yuan's blood wafting into his nose.
'Fuck! Why does his blood smell so damn good?! I have never smelled anything this delicious before!' he cried inwardly.
However, as much as he wanted to also take a bite at Yuan's neck, he knew that if he couldn't control his urges, he'd likely end up being killed by Supreme Ruler Dena.
An hour later, Supreme Ruler Dena finally removed her mouth from Yuan's neck and took a deep breath.
"Hey, your blood tastes different from before," she remarked afterward.
"How so?" Yuan asked.
"It's much more delicious!" she replied before reaching for his neck and licking the leftover blood.
"Can I drink more?" she asked, then added a second later, "I'll let you drink my blood later in return."
It wasn't Yuan who was shocked by Supreme Ruler Dena's seemingly casual remark, but Lev, who looked even more stunned than when she had clung to Yuan earlier.

A Supreme Ruler's blood was unimaginably sought after for its ability to strengthen other demons. However, throughout history, the number of times a Supreme Ruler had shared their blood could be counted on one's fingers, despite the many who had held that position.

"Your blood, huh?" Even though he was human, Yuan didn't immediately dismiss such an offer, as he had never tasted the blood of a Supreme Ruler before, even as Tian Chenyu. In fact, he was actually very intrigued by its taste and whether it would benefit him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2384 A Black Mountain
paragraphs: "I'll let you drink as much as you want, too," Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly improved her offer when Yuan took a moment to ponder, worried that he might refuse.

'Unlimited blood?!' Lev nearly fell from the sky in shock after hearing her once-in-a-lifetime offer. Countless beings in the Demonic Realm would be willing to do anything for such an opportunity, yet Supreme Ruler Dena offered it so casually in exchange for Yuan's blood. This only deepened Lev's curiosity about its taste.
"Alright, I'll accept your offer, but I doubt I will need too much of it—"
Before Yuan could even finish his sentence, Supreme Ruler Dena dug her teeth into his neck and began sucking again.
Fearing that he might fail to control his urges, Lev sealed his sense of smell and stopped looking at Supreme Ruler Dena feed on Yuan, pretending they no longer existed.
This went on for several weeks until the Queen Wraith of Demise slowed down.
Of course, Supreme Ruler Dena fed on Yuan's blood until she was completely full, which took a little over two weeks.
"We'll arrive at our destination soon," said Queen Wraith of Demise.
Suddenly, the atmosphere changed, and the air became noticeably heavier.
Lev and Supreme Ruler Dena frowned when they sensed this aura, and they came to a complete halt.
"This feeling..." Lev trembled. "Chaotic Essence, huh?" Yuan mumbled after sensing what was clearly Chaotic Essence in the air. Not only that, but it was an immense amount.
"Sorry, but this is as far as I'll go," Lev said. "This is the same energy from the Corruption Shower. If I get too close, I'm afraid I might turn into a Forsaken."
Yuan nodded, not blaming him in the slightest. "I understand. You can stay here and wait for our return."
He turned to look at Supreme Ruler Dena and asked her, "What are you going to do? Want to stay here, too?
However, she shook her head and said, "As a Supreme Ruler, my resistance to this sort of energy is much higher."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this revelation.
"Is that how it works? Does that mean Supreme Rulers cannot turn into Forsaken?"
"Not necessary. It just means we're less likely to do so. However, we've never had a Supreme Ruler turn Forsaken, as we're essentially the Demon God's envoy."
"Makes sense," Yuan nodded.
"But I am not sure that I want to risk it. If you turned into a Forsaken... even I won't be able to stop you."
"If I stay here, that means you'll be with the Queen Wraith of Demise by yourself..." Supreme Ruler Dena said with a slight frown on her face.
"I'll be fine," Yuan said with a confident smile. "If you say so."

Yuan continued following the Queen Wraith of Demise, while the others stayed outside the Chaotic Essence. However, it wasn't just Lev and Supreme Ruler Dena who were forced to stop—even the ordinary Nether Wraiths halted their advance, clearly against their will, as they released wails unlike anything heard before, as if declaring their concern for their queen.
Seeing this, Yuan finally understood why the Queen Wraith of Demise had to enter a vessel.
'So these beings are weak against Chaotic Essence too, huh?' Yuan noted to himself.
As if she could read his thoughts, the Queen Wraith of Demise suddenly spoke out loud, "Not only are we weak against this sort of energy, but if we get too close, it will absorb us."
"Absorb you...?" Yuan muttered with a puzzled face.
He had no idea that Chaotic Essence was capable of such a thing. However, this wasn't necessarily a bad thing. In fact, it was quite advantageous for Yuan, who could wield its power.
Of course, the Queen Wraith of Demise wasn't aware of this and unknowingly revealed their weakness to the worst individual possible.

After traveling for several more days, Yuan suddenly spotted a black dot on the horizon. As they approached, it gradually came into view, revealing itself to be a massive black mountain. However, once they got close enough to see it in detail, it became apparent that the mountain was not made of stone but of an unknown material resembling obsidian.

Moreover, it was clearly the source of the Chaotic Essence, and the amount it emitted was unlike anything Yuan had ever experienced before—even during his time as Tian Yi, the Immortal Monarch, who was most familiar with Chaotic Essence.

In fact, even if he combined all of the Chaotic Essence that he absorbed from the Chaos Coins he'd amassed inside the Primordial Realm, it still wouldn't come close to the amount contained within the mountain.
Just how much stronger would his Chaotic Essence become if he were to absorb all of it? Yuan almost started drooling at that mere thought.
"Isn't it about time you tell me what you need my help with? I can assume it has something to do with that mountain, right?" Yuan said as they got closer.

The Queen Wraith of Demise nodded and said, "This object appeared out of thin air—or more specifically, fell from the sky—several billion years ago. When it first appeared, it was barely larger than a boulder. The energy it emitted wasn't particularly remarkable at the time, but it grew stronger and larger after absorbing some of my children who got too close out of curiosity."
"Once we realized it could absorb us and turn us into its own power, I forbade my children from approaching it. However, it continued to grow stronger and larger during a certain phenomenon."
"Let me guess... the Corruption Shower," Yuan said.

"Correct." The Queen Wraith of Demise turned to look at Yuan and spoke with a serious expression. "If this continues, this object will eventually take over our territory and threaten our existence, not to mention those living outside."

Yuan fell silent for a moment before speaking, "You clearly know that demons like the two following me are afraid of this energy, so why did you ask me to help you? Weren't you concerned that I might also be too afraid to get close and refuse to help?"

He had no idea that Chaotic Essence was capable of such a thing.
However, this wasn't necessarily a bad thing.
In fact, it was quite advantageous for Yuan, who could wield its power.
Of course, the Queen Wraith of Demise wasn't aware of this and unknowingly revealed their weakness to the worst individual possible.
After traveling for several more days, Yuan suddenly spotted a black dot on the horizon.
As they approached, it gradually came into view, revealing itself to be a massive black mountain.
However, once they got close enough to see it in detail, it became apparent that the mountain was not made of stone but of an unknown material resembling obsidian.

Moreover, it was clearly the source of the Chaotic Essence, and the amount it emitted was unlike anything Yuan had ever experienced before—even during his time as Tian Yi, the Immortal Monarch, who was most familiar with Chaotic Essence.

In fact, even if he combined all of the Chaotic Essence that he absorbed from the Chaos Coins he'd amassed inside the Primordial Realm, it still wouldn't come close to the amount contained within the mountain.
Just how much stronger would his Chaotic Essence become if he were to absorb all of it?
Yuan almost started drooling at that mere thought.
"Isn't it about time you tell me what you need my help with?
I can assume it has something to do with that mountain, right?" Yuan said as they got closer.
The Queen Wraith of Demise nodded and said, "This object appeared out of thin air—or more specifically, fell from the sky—several billion years ago.
When it first appeared, it was barely larger than a boulder.
The energy it emitted wasn't particularly remarkable at the time, but it grew stronger and larger after absorbing some of my children who got too close out of curiosity."
"Once we realized it could absorb us and turn us into its own power, I forbade my children from approaching it.
However, it continued to grow stronger and larger during a certain phenomenon."
"Let me guess... the Corruption Shower," Yuan said.
"Correct." The Queen Wraith of Demise turned to look at Yuan and spoke with a serious expression.
"If this continues, this object will eventually take over our territory and threaten our existence, not to mention those living outside."
Yuan fell silent for a moment before speaking, "You clearly know that demons like the two following me are afraid of this energy, so why did you ask me to help you?
Weren't you concerned that I might also be too afraid to get close and refuse to help?"

chapters.title: Chapter 2385 True Dragon Chaotic Core
paragraphs: Hearing Yuan's question, the Queen Wraith of Demise spoke as it calmly glared at him, "I don't know what you are, but you're clearly different from those two from the color of your soul, so I took a gamble. If you ran away and refused to help, I would've simply killed you."
"Do you really think you can kill me?" Yuan asked with a slight smile on his face.
The Queen Wraith of Demise remained silent, but her gaze lacked confidence.
"So, how do you want me to help you?" Yuan then asked.
"I don't care how, but I want you to get rid of this energy," she quickly answered.
"Get rid of that...?" Yuan raised his eyebrows as he looked at the black mountain that was oozing with Chaotic Essence.
He started calculating how long it would take him to absorb all the Chaotic Essence emanating from the black mountain and quickly reached a conclusion.
A thousand years. That's how long he estimated it would take.
"Alright, I'll do my best," Yuan said as he started approaching the black mountain.

Of course, he had no intention of spending the next thousand years absorbing the Chaotic Essence. Instead, he decided to spend a few years absorbing just enough to improve his cultivation and hopefully learn more about True Chaotic Qi.

'My second cultivation is now on par with my main cultivation base, so it would be best to keep them balanced. Instead of increasing my cultivation further, I can use this opportunity to create as many Chaotic Hearts as possible, which will also enhance my overall strength,' Yuan thought to himself as he reached the black mountain.
"What are you going to do?" The Queen Wraith of Demise suddenly asked him from afar, not daring to get too close, even with her vessel.
"You'll see soon," Yuan replied as he flew straight to the very peak of the mountain and sat down.
The Queen Wraith of Demise raised an eyebrow at his puzzling actions, wondering how he intended to deal with the energy this way.
In the very next moment, her eyes widened in shock and disbelief as Yuan began absorbing the energy, just as it had absorbed her children.
'He's absorbing that energy?!' she cried inwardly.
<You have absorbed Chaotic Essence>
<You have begun forming your third Chaotic Heart!>

With how much Chaotic Essence he was absorbing, Yuan started forming his third Chaotic Heart within days of his cultivation, completing it just a week later. With how much Chaotic Essence he was absorbing, Yuan started forming his third Chaotic Heart within days of his cultivation, completing it just a week later. <You have successfully formed your third Chaotic Heart!>
<Your third Chaotic Heart has merged with your Chaotic Dragon Core, drastically strengthening it!>
After his Chaotic Dragon Core was strengthened, so did Yuan's speed when absorbing the Chaotic Essence.
Then, two weeks later, he started forming his fourth Chaotic Heart.
<You have begun forming your fourth Chaotic Heart!>
<You have successfully formed your fourth Chaotic Heart!>
<Your fourth Chaotic Heart has merged with your Chaotic Dragon Core, drastically strengthening it!>
<Your Chaotic Dragon Core has activated!>
<Your Chaotic Dragon Core has begun evolving!>
Yuan was pleasantly surprised to discover that his Chaotic Dragon Core was capable of evolving, and his anticipation skyrocketed as he wondered how much stronger it would make him.
Three months later—
<Progress: 100%>
<Your Chaotic Dragon Core has evolved into a True Chaotic Dragon Core!>
<Due to your True Chaotic Dragon Core, your cultivation speed when absorbing Chaotic Essence has increased by 300,000%!>
<Due to your True Chaotic Dragon Core, your efficiency when using Chaotic Essence has improved by 50,000%, allowing you to unleash more strength while using less Chaotic Essence!>

However, even with his increased cultivation speed, the amount of Chaotic Essence required for each new Chaotic Heart continued to grow, and it still took Yuan half a year to begin forming his fifth Chaotic Heart.
Then, after another year—
<You have successfully formed your fifth Chaotic Heart!>
<Your fifth Chaotic Heart has merged with your True Chaotic Dragon Core, drastically strengthening it!>
'A thousand years? At this rate, I will only need a hundred years to absorb all of the Chaotic Essence!' Yuan laughed inwardly at his rapid progress.
Meanwhile, the Queen Wraith of Demise was utterly stunned by how quickly Yuan was eliminating the energy.
'I don't know how he's doing it, but at this rate, he might really get rid of it!'
She was in total disbelief.
'I was even prepared to dispose of him!'
The Queen Wraith of Demise had never truly expected Yuan to help solve their problem. Yet, against all expectations, he was doing exactly that.
Since the Chaotic Essence got weaker, Supreme Ruler Dena and Lev, who were waiting outside its influence, began moving closer and closer to the black mountain.

"This reminds me of when he purposefully entered the Corruption Shower," Lev suddenly remarked. "This energy turns us into Forsaken, but he seems unaffected by it. I wonder if it has something to do with being a human."
He turned to look at Supreme Ruler Dena and asked, "Just who is that man?"
"A troublemaker," she calmly replied and refused to further elaborate, puzzling Lev even more.
In the blink of an eye, another five years passed, and Yuan just finished his sixth Chaotic Heart.
<You have successfully formed your sixth Chaotic Heart!>
<Your sixth Chaotic Heart has merged with your True Chaotic Dragon Core, drastically strengthening it!>
<Your True Chaotic Dragon Core has begun evolving!>
'Hm? It's evolving again?' Yuan thought to himself.
One year... ten years... twenty years later—
<Progress: 100%>
<Your True Chaotic Dragon Core has evolved into a Supreme Chaotic Dragon Core!>
<Due to your Supreme Chaotic Dragon Core, your cultivation speed when absorbing Chaotic Essence has increased by 1,000,000%!>
<Due to your Supreme Chaotic Dragon Core, your efficiency when using Chaotic Essence has improved by 200,000%>
<Due to your Supreme Chaotic Dragon Core, your ability to sense True Chaotic Qi has drastically improved!>
"I can sense True Chaotic Qi more clearly now!" Yuan exclaimed with a look of surprise on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 2386 The Essence of True Chaotic Qi
paragraphs: Now that he could sense True Chaotic Qi clearly, Yuan temporarily stopped absorbing the Chaotic Essence to focus on studying it.
His sudden pause caused the Queen Wraith of Demise to raise her eyebrows.
"Are you... done?" She questioned him shortly after.
"No, I am just taking a break," he calmly replied before falling into complete silence again.
Very quickly, Yuan realized that the Supreme Chaotic Dragon Core not only helped him sense True Chaotic Qi better, but it even helped with his comprehension, allowing him to study it with more ease.
<Your understanding of True Chaotic Qi has improved significantly>

It didn't take long before Yuan started to grasp the essence of the energy. Perhaps it was because of his Supreme Chaotic Dragon Core, or that he'd already mastered Celestial Qi, but he was progressing much faster than usual.
Several weeks into his training, Yuan suddenly fell into a trance-like state.
He had entered the state of Enlightenment.

'What is he doing?' The Queen Wraith of Demise could sense the atmosphere around Yuan shifting, along with his aura. However, she had never seen someone enter a state of Enlightenment before, leaving her both intrigued and puzzled.
Supreme Ruler Dena, who was watching from afar with her divine sense, also noticed this change and became somewhat worried.
Although demons could also experience Enlightenment, it was far more uncommon. Moreover, they would emit a different aura, so Supreme Ruler Dena had no idea what was happening to Yuan at this moment.
"If Celestial Qi embodies the essence of life... then the true essence of True Chaotic Qi is to consume it!"
A year into his Enlightenment, Yuan's eyes snapped open, gleaming with a profound light. The aura around him changed drastically, as though something unseen was bowing before him.
<You have fully comprehended the essence of True Chaotic Qi!>
<You can now wield True Chaotic Qi!>

Unlike Celestial Qi, which was its own separate energy from ordinary Qi and Immortal Qi, True Chaotic Qi already existed within Chaotic Essence. However, only those who comprehend True Chaotic Qi are capable of sensing it could wield it.

After comprehending True Chaotic Qi, Yuan finally understood why ordinary cultivators couldn't use their spiritual energy normally when surrounded by Chaotic Essence. It was because the True Chaotic Qi within it was extremely sensitive to spiritual energy and would actively absorb it.

True Chaotic Qi didn't merely respond to spiritual energy; it was attracted to anything spiritual in nature. As such, entities like Nether Wraiths, which were completely spectral, became its prime targets.

Moreover, not only could it absorb energy, but it can use that energy to strengthen itself. In a way, it was similar to Yuan's physique, which can absorb all sorts of energy and turn it into his own power.

Yuan had a strong desire to test out his newfound strength, but with the Queen Wraith of Demise nearby, Yuan didn't want to make her feel threatened. Thus, he started to absorb the rest of the Chaotic Essence from the black mountain.
Even though he'd already formed five additional Chaotic Hearts, he had only absorbed about a third of the available Chaotic Essence, so he could easily create a few more.
When Yuan resumed his cultivation, he shifted his focus from the Chaotic Essence to the True Chaotic Qi within it, allowing him to absorb it at a far greater speed.
A small black vortex suddenly formed around him as he devoured the Chaotic Essence. It steadily grew larger until Yuan resembled a black hole.
Five years later—
<You have successfully formed your seventh Chaotic Heart!>
<Your seventh Chaotic Heart has merged with your True Chaotic Dragon Core, drastically strengthening it!>
Although it had taken him over twenty years to absorb 30 percent of the Chaotic Essence within the black mountain, it now took him only five years to absorb another 20 percent.
Suddenly, Yuan halted his cultivation and lowered his gaze, a slight frown appearing on his face as he stared at the mountain beneath him.
Perhaps the overwhelming Chaotic Essence had concealed it, but only after absorbing half of it did he finally sense a hidden presence within the black mountain.
Something had been lurking inside it all along.
The moment Yuan sensed the presence, it reacted. As if awakened, the black mountain suddenly began to tremble.
Yuan immediately got up and distanced himself from the black mountain.
"What's happening?!" Queen Wraith of Demise exclaimed with a puzzled look on her face.
"There's something hidden within that!" Yuan shouted back as he pointed at the black mountain.
"What?!"
The pitch-black mountain suddenly began to fade in color, gradually turning semi-transparent and revealing a massive silhouette within it.
The silhouette had a long, snake-like body with ten lizard-like limbs—five on each side. Most striking was its head—or rather, its heads, as there were two.
Moments later, the trembling stopped briefly before returning even stronger than before. Cracks began to spread across the mountain, making it clear that the entity within was trying to emerge.
It wasn't long before the mountain exploded and collapsed, completely revealing the entity hidden within.
The entity was a massive black lizard with a long, snake-like body and two menacing heads, each bearing a deadly gaze.
It radiated an overwhelming amount of Chaotic Essence, far surpassing what the black mountain had contained, as though the mountain had only housed a portion of its true strength.

As for its cultivation, it was clearly above the True God realm but not quite at the level of an Absolute God. However, since its cultivation was based on Chaotic Essence rather than Celestial Qi, it was far more powerful.
"What the hell is that?!" Lev cried out loud when he saw the lizard-like being.
Supreme Ruler Dena did not say a word. Instead, she flew to Yuan, despite the Chaotic Essence in that area growing stronger than before.
"Wait a—!" Lev wanted to follow, but he lacked the confidence and could only watch as she disappeared into the horizon.

chapters.title: Chapter 2387 Ancient Chaos
paragraphs: "What a disgusting thing!"
The Queen Wraith of Demise's expression twisted in disgust at the sight of the beast, yet it was not its grotesque form that repulsed her, but the sheer density of Chaotic Essence it exuded.

Unlike the black mountain, which leaked its Chaotic Essence in all directions, this creature possessed absolute control over its aura, compressing it into something far more concentrated—and infinitely more terrifying.
"What kind of beast is that?" Yuan asked, as he had never seen or heard of such a being before.
"I don't know," said the Queen Wratih of Demise. "But you'll get rid of it, right?"
"I might have no other choice..." Yuan sighed with a bitter smile.

Meanwhile, the unknown beast remained eerily still, its gaze fixed solely on Yuan after its emergence—completely disregarding the Queen Wraith of Demise despite her close proximity. In fact, it did not spare her even a single glance.
Suddenly, it parted its massive jaws, revealing its sharp teeth, and a hoarse, eerie voice resounded from within, "How dare a mere human covet my power..."

Yuan raised a brow at the beast's words, a flicker of surprise crossing his face. Yet it wasn't its ability to speak that caught him off guard, but it was the fact that it had seen through him and recognized him as human.
"What are you?" Yuan asked.
"I am Ancient Chaos, one of the most primordial beings in this universe!" The beast declared.
"Ancient Chaos? Never heard of you."
"Ignorant human... I have existed long before your kind ever came into existence..."
"Then enlighten me. Why were you hiding inside that mountain?"
The Ancient Chaos narrowed its eyes and fell silent for a moment before speaking, "What you just witnessed was not my emergence... but my birth."

"Your birth? So you're nothing more than a newborn?" Yuan said, his disbelief evident. It was hard to fathom how a being born mere moments ago could speak so clearly, let alone possess such overwhelming power.
Suddenly, a chilling sensation crawled up Yuan's spine as the Ancient Chaos began to exude overwhelming killing intent.
"Had you not stolen my power and interrupted my birth, I would have been born whole! For your crime, I shall devour your existence!
The Ancient Chaos shot toward Yuan in a blur, its immense body tearing through the air as both heads lunged forward, jaws stretched wide to devour him whole.
However, before it could reach Yuan, the Ancient Chaos snapped its jaws shut—biting into nothing but empty air.
'This is—!'
Sensing something amiss, Yuan reacted instantly and left his position.

The very moment he moved, a black hole manifested where he had stood. It vanished less than a heartbeat later, leaving behind a gaping void in space itself, as though everything within it had been completely erased from existence.
'What the hell?!' Yuan cried inwardly.
The attack resembled his Demon Devouring Sword's ability but appeared far more versatile and powerful.
"Oh? You actually managed to dodge that?" The Ancient Chaos commented in a somewhat impressed tone.
"So you can also use Void Manipulation, huh? Even though you were just born..." Yuan remarked with a cold smile.

Realizing this would be no easy battle, Yuan immediately activated Absolute Dragon Awakening and retrieved Number One Under Heaven. And seeing that the creature bore some resemblance to a dragon, he also summoned the Dragon God's Vengeance without hesitation.
"Toys like that won't be able to harm me!" The Ancient Chaos laughed menacingly as it lunged forward again.
Yuan swung his sword, unleashing a torrent of Supreme Sword Aura infused with Chaotic Essence.

Yet the Ancient Chaos did not so much as flinch, charging straight into the attack without hesitation. To Yuan's astonishment, the strike passed cleanly through its body, as though it were nothing more than an illusion.
"Use Void Manipulation to attack it!" A familiar voice suddenly resounded from afar.
It was Supreme Ruler Dena.
Hearing this, Yuan immediately attacked again, this time using Void Manipulation.
"Your Void Manipulation is far too weak!" the Ancient Chaos mocked as it devoured Yuan's second attack without effort.
"Then how about mine?!" Supreme Ruler Dena roared, unleashing her power as she struck with Void Manipulation.
This time, the Ancient Chaos did not charge in so recklessly, and its figure vanished into the void as it chose to evade her attack instead.
"He's behind you!" Supreme Ruler Dena shouted, but the Ancient Chaos had already slipped behind Yuan like a phantom.
Just as its jaws began to part, a surge of Eternal Essence erupted from Yuan's body, forcing the Ancient Chaos to recoil in startled surprise.
Then, it hastily retreated to a safe distance.
"That power...!" The Ancient Chaos fixed Yuan with its pitch-black gaze, a storm of fear and hatred churning within its eyes, its expression twisted as though recalling a distant, long-buried memory.
"You recognize this power as well?" Yuan asked, his intrigue deepening at the creature's increasingly enigmatic existence.
"What is your name?" The Ancient Chaos suddenly asked.
"Yuan."
"Yuan...?"
The Ancient Chaos fell silent for a moment, its presence turning eerily still before it spoke once more, its voice cold and resolute.
"Consider yourself fortunate today, Yuan. Newly born and incomplete, I lack the power to contend with both of you at once. But mark my words—I will return, and when I do, I will kill... devour you."
"You're going to run away? Do you think I'll let you do that?" Yuan said.
"Try to stop me if you can..."
As it finished those words, the Ancient Chaos slipped into the void again.
Yuan tried to stop its retreat, but alas, his Void Manipulation was too weak to do anything. As for Supreme Ruler Dena, she was also in no condition to chase after it.
"Seriously, what the hell was that thing?" Yuan muttered out loud as he helplessly watched the Ancient Chaos disappear toward the Starry Sky. Suddenly, a voice resounded inside Yuan's head.
"Ancient Chaos... It's been a while since I heard that name..."
Hearing this voice, Yuan turned to look at the Dragon God's Vengeance.
"Yeyou? You recognize it?" he immediately asked.

Meanwhile, the unknown beast remained eerily still, its gaze fixed solely on Yuan after its emergence—completely disregarding the Queen Wraith of Demise despite her close proximity.
In fact, it did not spare her even a single glance.
Suddenly, it parted its massive jaws, revealing its sharp teeth, and a hoarse, eerie voice resounded from within, "How dare a mere human covet my power..."
Yuan raised a brow at the beast's words, a flicker of surprise crossing his face.
Yet it wasn't its ability to speak that caught him off guard, but it was the fact that it had seen through him and recognized him as human.
"What are you?" Yuan asked.
"I am Ancient Chaos, one of the most primordial beings in this universe!" The beast declared.
"Ancient Chaos?
Never heard of you."
"Ignorant human...
I have existed long before your kind ever came into existence..."
"Then enlighten me.
Why were you hiding inside that mountain?"
The Ancient Chaos narrowed its eyes and fell silent for a moment before speaking, "What you just witnessed was not my emergence... but my birth."
"Your birth?
So you're nothing more than a newborn?" Yuan said, his disbelief evident.
It was hard to fathom how a being born mere moments ago could speak so clearly, let alone possess such overwhelming power.
Suddenly, a chilling sensation crawled up Yuan's spine as the Ancient Chaos began to exude overwhelming killing intent.
"Had you not stolen my power and interrupted my birth, I would have been born whole!
For your crime, I shall devour your existence!
The Ancient Chaos shot toward Yuan in a blur, its immense body tearing through the air as both heads lunged forward, jaws stretched wide to devour him whole.
However, before it could reach Yuan, the Ancient Chaos snapped its jaws shut—biting into nothing but empty air.
'This is—!'
Sensing something amiss, Yuan reacted instantly and left his position.
The very moment he moved, a black hole manifested where he had stood.
It vanished less than a heartbeat later, leaving behind a gaping void in space itself, as though everything within it had been completely erased from existence.
'What the hell?!' Yuan cried inwardly.
The attack resembled his Demon Devouring Sword's ability but appeared far more versatile and powerful.
"Oh?
You actually managed to dodge that?" The Ancient Chaos commented in a somewhat impressed tone.
"So you can also use Void Manipulation, huh?
Even though you were just born..." Yuan remarked with a cold smile.
Realizing this would be no easy battle, Yuan immediately activated Absolute Dragon Awakening and retrieved Number One Under Heaven.
And seeing that the creature bore some resemblance to a dragon, he also summoned the Dragon God's Vengeance without hesitation.
"Toys like that won't be able to harm me!" The Ancient Chaos laughed menacingly as it lunged forward again.
Yuan swung his sword, unleashing a torrent of Supreme Sword Aura infused with Chaotic Essence.
Yet the Ancient Chaos did not so much as flinch, charging straight into the attack without hesitation.
To Yuan's astonishment, the strike passed cleanly through its body, as though it were nothing more than an illusion.
"Use Void Manipulation to attack it!" A familiar voice suddenly resounded from afar.
It was Supreme Ruler Dena.
Hearing this, Yuan immediately attacked again, this time using Void Manipulation.
"Your Void Manipulation is far too weak!" the Ancient Chaos mocked as it devoured Yuan's second attack without effort.
"Then how about mine?!" Supreme Ruler Dena roared, unleashing her power as she struck with Void Manipulation.
This time, the Ancient Chaos did not charge in so recklessly, and its figure vanished into the void as it chose to evade her attack instead.
"He's behind you!" Supreme Ruler Dena shouted, but the Ancient Chaos had already slipped behind Yuan like a phantom.
Just as its jaws began to part, a surge of Eternal Essence erupted from Yuan's body, forcing the Ancient Chaos to recoil in startled surprise.
Then, it hastily retreated to a safe distance.
"That power...!" The Ancient Chaos fixed Yuan with its pitch-black gaze, a storm of fear and hatred churning within its eyes, its expression twisted as though recalling a distant, long-buried memory.
"You recognize this power as well?" Yuan asked, his intrigue deepening at the creature's increasingly enigmatic existence.
"What is your name?" The Ancient Chaos suddenly asked.
"Yuan."
"Yuan...?"
The Ancient Chaos fell silent for a moment, its presence turning eerily still before it spoke once more, its voice cold and resolute.
"Consider yourself fortunate today, Yuan.
Newly born and incomplete, I lack the power to contend with both of you at once.
But mark my words—I will return, and when I do, I will kill... devour you."
"You're going to run away?
Do you think I'll let you do that?" Yuan said.
"Try to stop me if you can..."
As it finished those words, the Ancient Chaos slipped into the void again.
Yuan tried to stop its retreat, but alas, his Void Manipulation was too weak to do anything.
As for Supreme Ruler Dena, she was also in no condition to chase after it.
"Seriously, what the hell was that thing?" Yuan muttered out loud as he helplessly watched the Ancient Chaos disappear toward the Starry Sky.
Suddenly, a voice resounded inside Yuan's head.
"Ancient Chaos...
It's been a while since I heard that name..."
Hearing this voice, Yuan turned to look at the Dragon God's Vengeance.
"Yeyou?
You recognize it?" he immediately asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 2388 Ancient Chaos(2)
paragraphs: Dragon Goddess Yeyou responded to Yuan's inquiry, her tone wary, "The Ancient Chaos is a singular existence of unfathomable power—one that came into being long before even I did. From the moment of its birth, it wields Void Manipulation with flawless mastery, and its cultivation already stands at the level of a Cultivation God."

"Though never confirmed, there are rumors that even if it is slain, it will one day reincarnate, retaining all of its past memories. To be frank, its existence is somewhat like yours. Completely abnormal."
"What is its purpose?" Yuan asked.

"The Ancient Chaos' purpose?" Dragon Goddess Yeyou murmured. "It lies within its very name—Chaos. It devours all things to strengthen itself. In that sense, it is similar to the Eater of Stars... yet it does not feast out of hunger. It devours simply because that is its nature."
"Since it was just reborn, it must have been killed before. I wonder who killed a monster like that," Yuan wondered out loud.
Dragon Goddess Yeyou returned to being quiet.
Not wanting to bother her any longer, Yuan stowed away his weapons and deactivated his Absolute Dragon Awakening.
"Although that thing is gone..."
Yuan's gaze shifted to the shattered remains of the black mountain—the Ancient Chaos' discarded shell—its fragments strewn across the land, still faintly leaking traces of Chaotic Essence.

He proceeded to absorb every last trace of Chaotic Essence until nothing remained. However, upon closer inspection of the shattered shell, he realized it possessed the potential to become an invaluable material. So, he gathered all of the shells and tossed them into his spatial ring.
<You have obtained Ancient Chaos' Shell>
Afterward, he returned to the Queen Wraith of Demise and said, "I've cleared out that energy as promised. You should honor your end of the bargain and let bygones be bygones."

The Queen Wraith of Demise remained silent. Yuan narrowed his eyes slightly and spoke again, this time in a colder voice, "Don't tell me you still want to fight?" The Queen Wraith of Demise closed her eyes and drew a slow, steady breath before replying in a resigned voice, "No... I will abide by my word and forgive you for slaughtering my children."
Though she did not voice it, after witnessing Yuan's overwhelming prowess and his command over Chaotic Essence, the very power her kind feared, she realized he could easily defeat them.
If she were to escalate things between them, it would only result in the extinction of her race.
Yuan nodded and said, "I will also promise not to attack any more Nether Wraiths for as long as I am within the Demise Ravine. Of course, that is if they don't attack us first."
"You need not worry about that, as I will guarantee that not a single one of my children will attack you from this point forth," said the Queen Wraith of Demise.
"I'm glad we managed to settle this without bloodshed. Then, I'll be taking my leave now."
Yuan turned around and flew away with Supreme Ruler Dena closely following behind.
The Queen Wraith of Demise did not follow and stayed behind.
"You're back!" Lev almost started crying when he saw Yuan and Supreme Ruler Dena, as he'd been alone with thousands of Nether Wraiths this entire time.
"We've settled things with the Queen Wraith of Demise, so we're leaving now," Yuan said to him.
Lev nodded and followed them.
Meanwhile, the Nether Wraiths completely ignored them and returned to their queen's side.
"They won't attack us again, right?" Lev asked as he watched them leave.
"Unless they want to die." "Then the rest of our journey through this Demise Ravine should be smooth sailing."

Sure enough, for the next several months, they were not bothered by any more Nether Wraiths. While they would occasionally spot some, the Nether Wraiths would only watch them from afar and never approach.
"I'm hungry." Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly said.
"I fed you not long ago," Yuan said.
"I used too much energy saving you."
"You only unleashed a single attack with Void Manipulation..."
"You wouldn't understand how much power I used because your level of Void Manipulation is lacking," she countered.
Yuan was left speechless, unable to refute her reasoning.
'I really need to improve my Void Manipulation soon...' he sighed inwardly.
"Go ahead."
Yuan pulled down the clothes around his neck.
Without hesitation, Supreme Ruler Dena jumped on his back and started feasting on his blood.
Yuan noticed Lev staring at them with an envious gaze and said to him a moment later, "I would let you taste my blood, but you'll likely regret it."
"Huh? What makes you say that?" Lev asked, looking confused.
"Because my blood contains Demon Sealing Aura. If you drink it, you'll likely be sealed."
"Then how come she's fine?" Lev pointed at Supreme Ruler Dena, who was sucking away without a care in the world.
"She's strong enough to ignore it."
"That's it?"
"That's all."
Of course, Yuan could unseal him if Lev got sealed, but since it would be a hassle, he decided not to say anything.
Luckily, Lev no longer dared to drink his blood.

Eventually, they reached the end of the Demise Ravine. But since they started traveling from the end, they were technically exiting from the entrance. "I'm so glad we're finally out of that place..." Lev released a deep sigh after they escaped the place.
"Now where to?" Yuan asked Supreme Ruler Dena.
Supreme Ruler Dena pondered for a moment before pointing in a certain direction.
"The closest city should be in that direction."
They followed the direction she pointed at shortly later.
Meanwhile, somewhere in the Starry Sky...
"That was a little dangerous..." The Ancient Chaos sighed aloud once it confirmed it was safe.
"That bastard called Yuan... just what the hell is he? How can a mere human use Eternal Essence? And that familiar scent on him... Is he related to that monster?"
The Ancient Chaos trembled just at the thought of that 'monster'.
"No matter! Once I regain my strength and mature into my true form, I will surely devour him!" he swore loudly as he continued drifting deeper into the Starry Sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 2389 Bloody Expanse
paragraphs: Somewhere in the Demonic Realm, the current Supreme Leader sat before several high-ranking demons as they relayed their news to him.

"I have just received confirmation that 'woman' has disappeared from the Deprived Crimson Valley's Final Valley. However, we have yet to confirm whether she simply left the Final Valley and moved to a new location or the Deprived Crimson Valley altogether."
"Does she even have the capability to leave the Deprived Crimson Valley?" someone suddenly asked.

The Supreme Ruler responded, "Since we have never replaced a Supreme Ruler without the former one dying or being properly removed, there is no telling how much of the Demon God's Authority she still retains—if she can access it at all."

"However, we will proceed under the assumption that she still retains her powers and may have already escaped the Deprived Crimson Valley. Dispatch both the Elite Execution Squad and the Special Execution Squad, but do not engage. Observe her movements and report back to me immediately."
"As you command, Supreme Ruler!"
"Is there anything else I should be aware of?" the Supreme Ruler asked.

After a brief silence, one of the individuals raised his hand and spoke hesitantly, "I'm not certain how credible it is—or even if it's real—but there's been a rumor circulating within the Deprived Crimson Valley... of someone wielding Demon Sealing Aura."
"What?! Demon Sealing Aura?!"
The room erupted into chaos. "But all of the Sealers are dead—at least, they should be!"
"Perhaps one of them managed to escape? If they're already within the Deprived Crimson Valley, then there's no need to panic," another suggested.
"Right? It's not like they can leave the Deprived Crimson Valley alone."
However, the Supreme Ruler spoke once more, his voice turning cold and resolute.

"No. We will treat this matter with the same urgency as Dena. The Demon Sealing Aura, with its accursed power against our kind, is a blatant affront to the Demon God. I will not permit anyone to wield such power... even within the confines of the Deprived Crimson Valley.
"Trace the source of this rumor and verify its truth. If a Demon Sealer is indeed alive... execute them without hesitation."
"As you command, Supreme Ruler!"
The meeting ended shortly after, and everyone but the Supreme Ruler left.
"The reemergence of a Demon Sealer... and Dena's disappearance..." The Supreme Ruler muttered, his expression turning grave. "Is this mere coincidence... or something far more deliberate?"
Meanwhile, Yuan and his group arrived at a new location—a boundless sea of deep crimson liquid, as though it were an endless ocean of blood.
"This must be the Bloody Expanse," Yuan remarked as he took in the scene.
"It looks even redder than I remember," he added, recalling the moment Tian Chenyu had first laid eyes upon it.

True to its name, the Bloody Expanse was a vast sea stained crimson with blood, spilled by the countless sea creatures that endlessly slaughtered and devoured one another, as well as demons fighting over it. After all, the Bloody Expanse encompassed more than half of the entire Demonic Realm.

Unlike the beings of the Nine Heavens, those within the Demonic Realm possessed unnaturally thick blood that did not easily disperse in water. After trillions of years of ceaseless slaughter and corruption, that very blood accumulated, giving rise to the Bloody Expanse.
Moreover, despite being an ocean of blood, it was unfit for consumption—even by demons—its essence so deeply corrupted that not even their kind could safely devour it without getting sick.

Of course, for a demon to fall ill meant that something was wrong with its blood, and for their kind, that was no different from becoming crippled, akin to a cultivator whose spiritual energy had been corrupted.
"Whenever you're ready," Supreme Ruler Dena said as she hovered above the blood-red sea.

Yuan followed without hesitation. Lev, however, trailed behind with visible reluctance. Even as a First Level False God, the Bloody Expanse remained an exceedingly perilous domain, where a single lapse in awareness could result in being dragged beneath the surface and devoured by the lurking sea creatures below.

Though one might assume they could simply ascend into the sky and distance themselves from the sea, such thoughts were futile, as many of the creatures below were capable of leaping beyond the clouds themselves.
Yet, even after traveling for three consecutive days, not a single sea creature made an attempt to attack them.
This left Lev puzzled.
"Is there something wrong with the Bloody Expanse? The Sea Devils aren't attacking at all," he wondered out loud.
In the Demonic Realm, the sea creatures were called Sea Devils. "They're likely wary of Dena's presence," Yuan remarked calmly.
However, Supreme Ruler Dena shook her head. "No... that can't be. They've attacked me before."
"Seriously?" Even Yuan couldn't hide his surprise now, his curiosity piqued as his earlier assumption began to falter.
He proceeded to expand his divine sense even deeper into the sea.
"It's empty," he said a moment later. "I cannot sense a single creature in the water within a ten-thousand-mile radius."
"What? How is that possible? The Bloody Expanse is usually teeming with Sea Devils," Lev said, bewildered. "It's common knowledge that they reproduce far faster than they can kill one another."
Suddenly, Lev came to an abrupt halt, his face draining of color as an expression of absolute terror took hold.
"What's wrong?" Yuan asked, his brows furrowing slightly.
"Actually... I think I might know what happened here..." Lev replied, swallowing hard as unease crept into his voice.

"There is a legend of a powerful Sea Devil that dwells within the Bloody Expanse—the Bloody Devil Emperor. It is a mysterious entity said to appear only once every hundred billion years. And whenever it does, the Bloody Expanse deepens in crimson, while all other Sea Devils retreat into hiding until it vanishes again."
"Bloody Devil Emperor? Do you know anything about this entity?" Yuan asked, turning to Supreme Ruler Dena.
"It's nothing more than folklore," she replied calmly. "No one has ever actually laid eyes on this so-called Bloody Devil Emperor."

chapters.title: Chapter 2390 Bloody Devil Emperor
paragraphs: "Folktale or not, it doesn't change the fact that something weird is happening within the Bloody Expanse," Yuan said. "Let's keep moving. If we encounter the source, we'll deal with it then."
"Deal with it...?" Lev's jaw dropped. "If the Bloody Devil Emperor is real, I'd rather we just run from it."
"What are you so afraid of? You're traveling with the strongest Supreme Ruler and Demon Sealer in the world. If I were you, I'd even dare provoke the Demon God," Yuan laughed.

Lev glanced at Supreme Ruler Dena with a wry smile. Though she was undoubtedly the strongest among the Supreme Rulers, she had yet to recover her full strength. As for Yuan—despite his overwhelming prowess—he was still only at the First Level False God.
They continued their journey shortly after.
However, even after traveling for another week, they have yet to encounter a single Sea Devil, almost as if their existence had been completely wiped from this world.
It wasn't just Lev who found the situation unsettling. Even Supreme Ruler Dena felt a faint sense of unease at the unusual stillness.
Suddenly, Supreme Ruler Dena stopped moving and shouted, "Something is coming!"

Supreme Ruler Dena was the first to spot this presence due to her superior cultivation, but Yuan wasn't too far behind and also sensed it a few moments later. As for Lev, he remained oblivious. "What a terrifying presence..." Yuan swallowed, a rare hint of unease surfacing in his voice.

Whatever was emitting this aura surpassed even the Ancient Chaos. In fact, he had only encountered something remotely similar a handful of times. If he had to draw a comparison, the closest would be Long Wu Qing, the eldest daughter of the Dragon God.
"W-What is it?! What's coming?!" Lev cried out, panic rising as he caught sight of their tense expressions.

Several agonizing minutes passed in silence. Just as Lev was about to speak again, the surface of the crimson sea began to swell—bulging outward as though a colossal air bubble were forming beneath it.
First, a massive crimson horn broke through the surface, followed by the rest of its form—a bloated, balloon-like figure rising from the blood sea.
When Yuan saw the creature, his brows lifted, disbelief flickering across his face.
"This is... a goldfish?!" Yuan exclaimed, startled by how the creature's plump, rounded form resembled that of a goldfish—albeit an absurdly massive one.

Sure enough, the Sea Devil bore a striking resemblance to a goldfish, its body cloaked in crimson and silver scales. Six majestic fins fanned out from its sides, while a regal dorsal fin rose from its back, shaped like a crown.
The crimson goldfish rose fully from the Bloody Expanse, ascending into the sky until it hovered above Yuan's group like a blazing sun.
Then, its round, golden eyes settled upon them—or more precisely... upon Yuan.
Suddenly, a voice resounded, its origin impossible to discern, echoing from all directions at once.

"I came here because I sensed a familiar presence, but you are not who I first believed you to be. More surprising still... you are merely a human," the goldfish spoke, its voice still echoing from all directions at once.
"Are you the Bloody Devil Emperor?" Yuan asked.
"Bloody Devil Emperor? What a dreadful name," the goldfish replied, its voice laced with disdain. "Do I truly resemble a being that would bear something so distasteful?"
It continued, "I am the splendid, dignified, majestic, Primal Sovereign of the Seas!" The goldfish introduced itself as the Primal Sovereign of the Seas.
"Primal?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this familiar word.
"Are you a being from the Primal Expanse? If so, how did you come to be here?" Yuan asked.

"Oh? So you have set foot in the Primal Expanse as well," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas replied, a hint of intrigue in its voice. "I am the Sovereign of the Seas—there is no body of water in this universe beyond my reach. Wherever water exists, I may travel as I please."
Yuan glanced at the Bloody Expanse before continuing, "Are you responsible for the absence of Sea Devils?"
"Indeed," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas replied without hesitation.
"These waters had grown far too crowded, so I purged half of their population. And this is hardly the first time I've done so," it added, its tone laced with pride.
"Why would you do something like that?" Yuan asked, his brows knitting in confusion.
"It is my hobby—duty as the Sovereign of the Seas to maintain balance and prevent these waters from descending into unchecked chaos, no matter the world they belong to," it replied calmly.
Then, with a hint of satisfaction in its tone, it added, "Besides... the creatures here are far more succulent—fresh and full of vitality, unlike the tasteless refuse of the Primal Expanse."
"Now, it is my turn to ask you some questions."

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas narrowed its eyes at Yuan and asked in a serious voice, "You... why do you smell like the Primal Monarch? Because of your scent, I came here. However, now that I think about it, there's no reason that old man would be here."
"The Primal Monarch, huh? I had a feeling you knew him." Yuan said with a smile. "He's my father."
"WHAT!"
The Primal Sovereign exclaimed in disbelief, its eyes widening until they bulged like overinflated orbs on the verge of bursting.
Then, its massive body plunged back into the crimson sea, sending a towering tidal wave surging outward.
"What the hell?!" Lev shouted in alarm.
With a casual flick of her sleeve, Supreme Ruler Dena split the oncoming wave in two, parting it cleanly so it flowed past them without harm.

After a few minutes of silence, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas emerged from the Bloody Expanse once again and asked in an awkward voice, "The Primal Monarch... giving birth to a human? Is that even possible?"
"Oh, I should clarify," Yuan said suddenly. "He's not my real father—more of an adoptive one."
"You should have stated that earlier! Nearly gave me a heart attack!" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas roared.

chapters.title: Chapter 2391 Primal Sovereign of the Seas
paragraphs: Yuan watched the Primal Sovereign of the Seas with amusement before asking, his curiosity piqued, "What is your relationship with the Primal Monarch?"
After a brief pause, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas replied, "We are... something akin to acquaintances."
"Something akin?" Yuan echoed, raising a brow at the peculiar choice of words.
"If you're concerned that we might be enemies, you may set your mind at ease. Anyone who understands what the Primal Monarch is capable of would never be foolish enough to stand against him."
"Well, he is the most powerful being in the Primal Expanse," Yuan remarked.
However, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas let out a low chuckle, as though it found Yuan's statement rather amusing for some reason.
"What is it?" Yuan inquired with a puzzled face.
"You really know nothing about the Primal Monarch despite being his adopted son, huh? Just how much do you know about the Primal Monarch?" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas asked.

Yuan sifted through his memories, trying to recall everything he knew about the Primal Monarch. Yet after some time, he came to a realization—that beyond the fact that the Primal Monarch stood at the very apex of the Primal Expanse, he knew almost nothing about him.
"Now that you mention it... I don't really know much about him. I trained under him for a time, yet he never spoke of himself or revealed his true capabilities," Yuan said aloud.
"I see. So the Primal Monarch told you nothing," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas replied. "I suppose he has his reasons."
"How about you share some insight about him?" Yuan said with a faint smile.
"And potentially offend the Primal Monarch? You might as well starve me to death." The Primal Sovereign of the Seas viciously shook his head, causing his round body to shake like firm jello.
"If you want to know more about him, you can simply ask him yourself."
"I will do just that... whenever I see him again.
"What is it? I noticed that you have been glaring at me for some time now. If you have any questions, go ahead and ask." The Primal Sovereign of the Seas said after a moment of silence.
Yuan hesitated for a second before asking, "Do you have any connections to the True Emperor of the Seas? I noticed that both of you have a similar name."
"True Emperor of the Seas?" the Primal Sovereign of the Seas repeated, its voice dripping with immense disdain, as though it were spitting out something foul.
"There is absolutely no connection between this majestic one and that disgusting impostor. In fact, I would kill it if I could."
Yuan was genuinely taken aback by the sheer intensity of its response—and the deep-seated repulsion it harbored toward the so-called True Emperor of the Seas.
"You mean even you are not strong enough to kill it?" Yuan asked, genuine surprise coloring his voice.

Even he lacked the confidence to defeat the Primal Sovereign of the Seas at full strength—yet such a being spoke as though it could not deal with the True Emperor of the Seas. If that were the case... just how powerful was that creature?

"Let me correct you first. It's not that I am unable to kill it. I simply do not wish to entangle myself in unnecessary trouble by killing it. If I wished to kill that imposter, I could easily do so with a single flap."
However, such a response only gave Yuan more questions than answers.
"Do you mind telling me what kind of consequences killing it would bring? To be frank... it's on my kill list," he said.
"What?"
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' round eyes widened with delight.
"You... want to kill it? I'd like to ask why."
"It's a long story, but I have some unsettled grudges with it.
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas suddenly fell silent. Then, it spoke with a profound grin on its face, "Since you are the Primal Monarch's son, I suppose it will be fine even if you kill it."
"Huh? What's that supposed to mean?"
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas chuckled, "Don't mind the minor details. Instead, I have a proposition for you."
Yuan narrowed his eyes at the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' suspicious behavior.
"I'm listening."
"If you succeed in killing that impostor known as the True Emperor of the Seas, I shall reward you with a single drop of this majestic being's Blood Essence!"
"What?!" Yuan exclaimed, his shock palpable.

"You heard correctly," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas continued, leaving no room for doubt. "Slay the True Emperor of the Seas, and I will grant you my Blood Essence. You need the Blood Essence of Supreme Bloodlines to complete your bloodline, right?"
"How do you know about that?" Yuan muttered in a daze.
To know about his bloodline so well, there was no way the Primal Sovereign of the Seas was a mere 'acquaintance' to the Primal Monarch.

"There are very few things this majestic one does not know, especially when it pertains to the Primal Monarch." "I'll do it! I'll kill the True Emperor of the Seas!" Yuan declared without a hint of hesitation, his voice firm and resolute.
It was something he had intended to do one day, regardless of the consequences, so he might as well reap some amazing rewards that came with it.
"That's what I like to hear, Primal Monarch's son! Now, prepare yourself!" "Wait, what?" Yuan tilted his head with a puzzled expression after hearing the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' last few words.
"What is there to be confused about? I am going to drag the True Emperor of the Seas here so you can kill it," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas explained, leaving Yuan momentarily speechless.
"You mean you're going to summon it? Here? Right now?" Yuan asked, struggling to process how abruptly the situation had escalated.
"That's right," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas replied calmly, as though summoning such a being were no more extraordinary than stirring the tides.

chapters.title: Chapter 2392 Primal Sovereign of the Seas(2)
paragraphs: "You can't be serious..." Yuan refused to believe that the Primal Sovereign of the Seas would drag the True Emperor of the Seas to the Demonic Realm just so he could kill it.

"Don't worry, it won't take long to drag that imposter here," said the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, thinking that Yuan was worried it might take too long to bring the True Emperors of the Seas to him.

Yuan fell silent, deep in thought, questioning whether he truly possessed the strength to face the True Emperor of the Seas—a being said to be beyond even the reach of Cultivation Gods—at his current level.
"It's now or never," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas suddenly said, snapping Yuan out of his thoughts. "Once I depart, I will enter hibernation, and I will not emerge again for millions of years."
Yuan rubbed his eyes and let out a long sigh before nodding, a trace of resignation in his expression.
"Alright... I'll fight it now. But whether I can kill it is another matter, so don't be disappointed if I fail."

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas let out a low chuckle before replying, "In my eyes, you possess what it takes to slay that impostor, but it will be a difficult fight. However, if you would rather have more time to prepare, I can afford to wait a while longer. I am still in the midst of my purge and will remain awake for a few hundred more years."
Yuan stared into the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' eyes for a moment before asking, "Are you really not going to tell me the consequences of killing it—why you are hesitant to kill it?"

A grin appeared on the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' face as it responded, "If you are worried that it might be a trap, you are free to refuse. But there's a reason I am offering you my Blood Essence as a reward, something I have never even considered doing until today."
Yuan closed his eyes and took a deep breath. When he opened his eyes, they were brimming with resolve and confidence.
"Very well. I accept your challenge. There's no need to wait, either. We'll do it now," Yuan declared.
"WELL SAID!"
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas roared, its massive form surging skyward as it shot toward the heavens.
Then, it performed a majestic backflip in the sky before plunging back down toward the crimson sea.

Yuan and the others braced themselves for a towering tidal wave, yet to their astonishment, when the Primal Sovereign of the Seas struck the surface, not a single drop of water stirred, and its immense form vanished instantly into the crimson depths.
"I will return within a few days. You may use this time to prepare yourself."

The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' voice resounded shortly after. Instead of immediately beginning his preparations, Yuan took a moment to explain the situation to Supreme Ruler Dena and Lev, who had been observing from the sidelines, utterly bewildered by everything that had transpired.

"So, to sum it up," Lev began, trying to piece everything together, "the Bloody Devil Emperor is actually called the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, a being from an entirely different world—a third world—and it's going to drag another creature here for you to kill?"
"That sounds about right." Yuan calmly nodded.
Supreme Ruler Dena then asked, "Can we assist you?"
She had little interest in the situation itself, and her only concern was whether she could be of help to him.

Yuan smiled faintly and shook his head. "I appreciate the offer, but I'll handle this on my own. I'm not doing this solely because of the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, either. I have my own reasons for wanting it dead."
His gaze darkened slightly. "This is... a grudge carried over from a distant past."
"Then we'll wait for you to take care of it." Supreme Ruler Dena didn't say anything else and flew away, giving Yuan some space.
"Good luck, I guess." Lev didn't know what else to say and followed Supreme Ruler Dena shortly after.
Now that he was somewhat alone, Yuan sat in the lotus position in midair and closed his eyes to cultivate, preparing for the upcoming battle.

Meanwhile, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas had already departed the Demonic Realm, gliding through a spatial tunnel accessible only through its unique authority, its presence weaving effortlessly between worlds as it set out in search of the True Emperor of the Seas.
When the Primal Sovereign of the Seas emerged from the spatial tunnel, it found itself within a vast, boundless sea in the Nine Heavens.
It then began its search for the True Emperor of the Seas, and within mere moments, it found it.
To the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, locating any living creature within the waters of the three worlds was as effortless as a human observing the lines upon their own palm.
"Found you, you little imposter!"
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas slipped back into its spatial tunnel, traveling for only a few fleeting seconds before arriving at its destination.
When it emerged once more, it had arrived in the Ninth Heaven, within the Sea of Infinite Descent, one of the Four Gateways to Hell.

Meanwhile, not far from the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, the True Emperor of the Seas—who had slumbered for thousands of years—suddenly jolted awake, stirred by a menacing and all-too-familiar presence.

The moment it recognized the owner of that presence, the True Emperor of the Seas reacted without hesitation, immediately attempting to flee through its own spatial tunnel—one that connected every sea within the Nine Heavens.
"To think you would try to flee from me within water... how laughable!"
Behind it, the True Emperor of the Seas could hear the Primal Sovereign's mocking laughter, sounding like a chilling tide closing in.
"Damn it! What the hell do you want from me, you fat fuck?!" the True Emperor of the Seas cried out, not even daring to glance back.
