When the Primal Sovereign of the Seas emerged from the spatial tunnel, it found itself within a vast, boundless sea in the Nine Heavens.
It then began its search for the True Emperor of the Seas, and within mere moments, it found it.
To the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, locating any living creature within the waters of the three worlds was as effortless as a human observing the lines upon their own palm.
"Found you, you little imposter!"
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas slipped back into its spatial tunnel, traveling for only a few fleeting seconds before arriving at its destination.
When it emerged once more, it had arrived in the Ninth Heaven, within the Sea of Infinite Descent, one of the Four Gateways to Hell.

Meanwhile, not far from the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, the True Emperor of the Seas—who had slumbered for thousands of years—suddenly jolted awake, stirred by a menacing and all-too-familiar presence.

The moment it recognized the owner of that presence, the True Emperor of the Seas reacted without hesitation, immediately attempting to flee through its own spatial tunnel—one that connected every sea within the Nine Heavens.
"To think you would try to flee from me within water... how laughable!"
Behind it, the True Emperor of the Seas could hear the Primal Sovereign's mocking laughter, sounding like a chilling tide closing in.
"Damn it!
What the hell do you want from me, you fat fuck?!" the True Emperor of the Seas cried out, not even daring to glance back.

chapters.title: Chapter 2393 I Just Want to Talk
paragraphs: "How dare you address this majestic one with such foul language!" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas exclaimed with disbelief after hearing the True Emperor of the Seas' curse at it.
"I have a name, you know? I am the Primal Sovereign of the Seas—the true Ruler of the Seas, you imposter!"
"I know who the hell you are! Every sea creature in this world is aware of you! What I don't know is why the hell you're chasing after me!" The True Emperor of the Seas shouted, panic in its voice.
"Why are you running? I just want to talk," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas said in a calm voice, trying to convince it to stop.

"Do you think I am stupid or something?! There's no way in hell you're only here to talk when you're chasing after me so vigorously! If you really want to talk, we can talk like this!" Unsurprisingly, the True Emperor of the Seas did not fall for such an obvious trick.
"You're only making this more difficult for yourself later with all this running around."
"What are you talking about?!"
"Stop for a moment, and I'll tell you everything."
"Seriously, you can stop that nonsense! I am not going to stop running until you leave!"
"I guess we'll have to do this the hard way..." The Primal Sovereign of the Seas sighed out loud as it casually chased after the True Emperor of the Seas.

Of course, if it truly wanted to catch up, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas could easily do so. However, it wanted to toy with the True Emperor of the Seas for some time before doing so. This also allowed Yuan some more time to prepare for the battle.
The True Emperor of the Seas quickly realized that it was being toyed with and shouted in desperation, "Don't you know who's behind me?! If you kill me, you'll definitely be killed, too!"
"Of course, I am aware of your master. That's why I haven't touched you for so long despite my desire to.
"Then why the hell are you trying to kill me now?!
"Who said I am trying to kill you? I just want to talk."
"We're talking right now!"
"No, this is something that we can only discuss while motionless."
"That's utter bullshit!"
"Truly, I just want to talk."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas remained insistent that it merely wanted to talk, but the True Emperor of the Seas was having none of it and continued fleeing as if its life depended on it.

Over the course of the next week, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas relentlessly pursued the True Emperor of the Seas, chasing it across hundreds of seas and oceans throughout every realm within the Nine Heavens.
"Oh, right. A day in this world is a year in that world..." The Primal Sovereign of the Seas suddenly recalled this important detail after a week of chasing.

"I am a bit reluctant to end something this entertaining, but alas... consider yourself lucky that I hadn't thought of doing this earlier, as I could easily do this for thousands of years without getting bored."
"What are you going to do to me?!" The True Emperor of the Seas cried out in terror when it noticed its pursuer increasing in speed and gradually catching up to it.
"I just want to talk." The Primal Sovereign of the Seas kept to his original joke.
Eventually, the True Emperor of the Seas reached its limit.
It came to an abrupt halt and turned to face its pursuer after having already realized it could not outrun the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, leaving it no choice but to fight.
"Eat this, you fat fuck!"
The True Emperor of the Seas lashed out in desperation, unleashing a devastating attack that consumed half of its energy in the blink of an eye.

Yet the Primal Sovereign of the Seas did not so much as flinch. Instead, it merely laughed, its mocking voice echoing through the depths, "What a waste of energy! You'll regret exhausting yourself soon!
Then it confronted the attack, opening its mouth to devour it.
"What?!" The True Emperor of the Seas exclaimed in shock, its eyes widening as its attack was so effortlessly deflected.

It had always known the Primal Sovereign of the Seas was overwhelmingly powerful, but it had never imagined the gap between them would be this vast, almost like comparing a small lake to the boundless ocean.
After swallowing the attack, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' round figure vanished for a split second before reappearing directly before the True Emperor of the Seas.

Then, without hesitation, it opened its massive jaws and bit down. Yet it neither devoured nor harmed it. Instead, it simply held the True Emperor of the Seas in its mouth, as though a cat had caught its prey and was toying with it.
The next moment, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas activated its ability and disappeared from the Nine Heavens.
Meanwhile, Yuan had been waiting for the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' return for seven years straight, and he was beginning to wonder if something had gone wrong or if it had simply forgotten.
Just as Yuan lowered his gaze to the crimson sea and let out a deep sigh, he noticed the surface begin to bulge once more, but this time, it swelled far larger than before.
A second later, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas emerged from the crimson sea with a familiar-looking being in its mouth.
'No way! He actually dragged it here!' Yuan cried inwardly after seeing the True Emperor of the Seas.
"He's all yours!" The Sovereign of the Seas said to Yuan before spitting the True Emperor of the Seas out.

Without hesitation, Yuan activated Absolute Dragon Awakening and summoned Number One Under Heaven, even using Chaotic Essence and Eternal Essence before striking at the True Emperor of the Seas as it fell from the sky—its mind still in utter disbelief and confusion.
"WHAT THE FUCK IS GOING ON?!" It cried out loud as Yuan cut through its tentacles like tofu.

chapters.title: Chapter 2394 Fighting the True Emperor of the Seas
paragraphs: The True Emperor of the Seas fell from the sky after the Primal Sovereign of the Seas spat it out, but before the True Emperor of the Seas could even touch the surface of the crimson sea, Yuan had severed all of its massive tentacles.
Splash!
The True Emperor of the Seas fell into the water, causing a massive tidal wave to surge in all directions.
Yet, despite having all of its tentacles severed, the True Emperor of the Seas regenerated them almost instantly, its recovery ability surpassing even that of high-ranking demons.
Then, it rose from the crimson sea, an overwhelming aura erupting from its body—dense with bloodlust and seething fury.
"I don't care anymore! I am going to kill all of you, even if it's the last thing I do!" The True Emperor of the Seas declared as it set its eyes on Yuan, who was clearly the easiest target there.
"Oh? It can actually speak?" Yuan mumbled after confirming the True Emperor of the Seas could speak, as he doubted his ears earlier when it cursed out loud.
The True Emperor of the Seas wasted no time. Having marked Yuan, it raised its massive tentacles—each capable of flattening an entire mountain—before bringing them crashing down toward him.
"The same trick as last time, huh?" Yuan muttered, recalling how it had used the very same attack against Tian Yang before.
However, this time, he wasn't as weak as Tian Yang, and he actually had the prowess to fight back.
He gathered his Supreme Sword Aura and Eternal Essence before swinging his sword at the incoming tentacles, slicing them as easily as a hot blade going through a thin stick of butter.
"What?! That power is—!" The True Emperor of the Seas couldn't believe its eyes after seeing Yuan use Eternal Essence.
Although Yuan had also used Eternal Essence during his earlier attack, the True Emperor of the Seas was too distracted to notice. This time, however, he sensed it clearly.
"Why the hell do you have that power as a human?!" The True Emperor of the Seas questioned Yuan. No, it demanded an answer.
"Who the hell are you?! And why are you colluding with the Primal Sovereign of the Seas against me?!" It continued to bombard Yuan with questions.
"You don't remember me?" Yuan replied calmly. "Well... I suppose that's only natural, given how much time has passed," he added.
"My name is Yu—Tian Yang, and I am here to collect a debt you owe... one long overdue," he declared.
"A debt?! When the hell did that happen?!"
"Some time during the Primordial Era."
"Primordial Era?! You've got to be kidding me! That was countless years ago!"
Yuan let out a cold sneer, his gaze turning frigid. "I don't care how much time has passed—or whether you remember. Today... I will be the one to hunt you!"
After his declaration, Yuan started attacking the True Emperor of the Seas again.
"Fuck!"

The True Emperor of the Seas was quickly overwhelmed by Yuan's immense prowess. Not only had it spent an entire week being relentlessly pursued by the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, but it had also exhausted half of its energy just moments before encountering Yuan, leaving it in the most weakened state it had ever experienced.

"It's useless! Even with that power, you cannot kill me!" the True Emperor of the Seas declared, its mocking laughter echoing across the sea as Yuan severed thousands of its tentacles only for it to recover fully in the blink of an eye.

Even though Yuan had fought and defeated it before during the Supreme Sword Emperor Qualifications, the True Emperor of the Seas at that time was merely a fake clone, and all of its weak points were fabricated for the trial, so Yuan couldn't use the same method for the real thing.
Yet, he didn't seem worried in the slightest and continued to swing his sword at the giant squid.
"Hahaha! Are you dumb or something?! No matter how many times you sever my arms, they will endlessly regenerate!" The True Emperor of the Seas laughed out loud.
However, Yuan completely ignored it and continued attacking for the next several days, until the entire sea was littered with the True Emperor of the Seas' severed tentacles.
"Useless! Useless! Useless! Hahaha—?!"
The True Emperor of the Seas' laughter abruptly ceased as it sensed something amiss within its body after days of relentless regeneration. Its recovery—once near-instant—had begun to noticeably slow.
"What?! My regeneration! What the hell did you do to my body?!" The True Emperor of the Seas cried out in a terrified voice.

Yuan paid it no mind and continued his assault, unleashing a relentless barrage of attacks with shifting energies. At times, he struck with Supreme Sword Aura; at others, with Chaotic Essence—and sometimes, he wielded both in tandem, layering their might into a single, devastating strike.

The True Emperor of the Seas recognized four of the five energies Yuan wielded—his Supreme Sword Aura, Chaotic Essence, Celestial Qi, and Eternal Essence. However, the fifth was completely unfamiliar to it, and it immediately assumed that unknown power to be the source of the anomaly.

While the True Emperor of the Seas remained unaware, Lev and Supreme Ruler Dena—watching from afar—recognized that energy all too well. They had seen Yuan wield it before, and there was no mistaking it.
It was none other than Demon Sealing Aura.

Although Demon Sealing Aura was most effective against demons, it could also affect other beings if wielded with sufficient strength. It had been created specifically to counter demons and their regenerative abilities. In other words, it could suppress and weaken one's capacity to regenerate.

Despite Yuan's overwhelmingly powerful Demon Sealing Aura, the True Emperor of the Seas possessed the cultivation of a Cultivation God and an enormous physique, meaning it required a tremendous amount of that aura before its effects began to show.

When the True Emperor of the Seas realized that Yuan was somehow suppressing its regenerative ability and that it currently lacked the strength to fight back, it immediately began contemplating escape. However, with the Primal Sovereign of the Seas lurking nearby, such a plan was far easier imagined than executed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2395 The True Emperor of the Seas' Master
paragraphs: "Wait! Let's talk about this!" The True Emperor of the Seas suddenly shouted aloud, hoping to cease Yuan's relentless attack for a moment.
However, Yuan immediately rejected, "There's nothing to talk about!"
And he continued attacking.
Seeing that Yuan had no intention of listening, the True Emperor of the Seas had no choice but to dive toward the depths of the crimson sea to evade his attacks.

However, in the very next instant, it was struck with shock when it could not descend. It was as though an invisible barrier had formed beneath it, preventing it from entering the deeper waters entirely.

"YOU FAT FUCK!" The True Emperor of the Seas instantly realized the reason behind this phenomenon and turned to curse at the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, who was watching from afar with a wide grin on its face.
"LET ME GO RIGHT THIS INSTANT!" It roared with desperation.
"I have no idea what you're referring to," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas replied, its tone as nonchalant as ever.

The True Emperor of the Seas quickly returned its attention to Yuan and hastily said, "I don't know what he promised you, but he's definitely tricking you into killing me since he's afraid of doing it himself!"
"I am well aware of the risks," Yuan calmly remarked.
"You do not!" The True Emperor of the Seas insisted. "Do you know who my master is?! If you kill me, my master will definitely kill you!"
"Your master?" Yuan halted his attacks for the first time and inquired with a raised eyebrow. "Who is that?"
A hopeful grin appeared on the True Emperor of the Seas after it realized that Yuan wasn't aware of its master. This meant that there was a chance he would stop attacking if he knew.
"Listen well because I will only say this once!" The True Emperor of the Seas proceeded to announce in a bold and prideful voice, "My master is none other than Morveth!"
"...Who?" Yuan asked without batting an eye at this unfamiliar name.
"Y-You don't know Master Morveth?! Even though you can wield Eternal Essence?!" The True Emperor of the Seas couldn't believe what was happening.
"So what if I can use Eternal Essence? Should I automatically know every single Eternal in existence because of that?" Yuan remarked with a sneer.
"But Master Morveth is a Prime Eternal! Even if you don't know all of the Eternals, there's no way you wouldn't know about the top ten!"
"Prime Eternal?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this unfamiliar term.

"This is my first time hearing such a title," he said a moment later. "So the top ten strongest Eternals are called Prime Eternals, huh?" "You really aren't aware of this...?" The True Emperor of the Seas was in disbelief.
He'd never seen anyone so oblivious before.
After a moment of silence, it continued, "Now that you know the identity of my master, do you still dare to attack me?!"

Yuan silently looked at the True Emperor of the Seas before turning to look at the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, who was clearly aware of this and purposefully kept it a secret from him for some reason.
Yet, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas remained silent as it calmly met Yuan's gaze, almost as if it couldn't care less whether he knew about Morveth or not.

The True Emperor of the Seas smiled after seeing their weird interaction and asked, "Did that fat fuck not tell you about my master? I told you that he was tricking you! Why don't you help me kill him instead? I'll be sure to let my master know of your good deeds." Hearing such words, Yuan returned his attention to the True Emperor of the Seas and smiled.
"Morveth?" he muttered.

"I don't care if they're top ten or the strongest Eternal in the universe! Nothing will stop me from killing you!" Yuan laughed as he continued his relentless assault on the bewildered True Emperor of the Seas.

"Y-You're only saying that because you don't know how powerful my master is!" "Like I said... I don't care!" The True Emperor of the Seas' attempts at negotiation failed, and with no means of escape, it was reduced to nothing more than prey on the brink of slaughter.
For the first time—despite its immortality and unparalleled regenerative abilities—it felt utterly helpless.
"Fuck! I am not going to sit here and let you humiliate me like this any longer!"
The True Emperor of the Seas roared in defiance, lashing out in retaliation, yet its efforts were desperate, almost pitiful in their futility.
Several weeks of relentless battle passed before Yuan finally muttered under his breath, "It should be weak enough now..."
The True Emperor of the Seas' regenerative ability had deteriorated to the point where it now required an entire minute to restore even a single tentacle.
"I haven't used this ability since the incident with Bai Xutao, and since I am not in the Nine Heavens, there should be no issue using it now."
Yuan raised his hand and pointed toward the True Emperor of the Seas, drawing in a deep breath as a strange, unfamiliar energy began to surge from within his aura.
The moment the Primal Sovereign of the Seas sensed that aura, its eyes widened in shock.
"That power! Don't tell me he's going to...!" It immediately understood what Yuan was about to do, and its massive form trembled with excitement.
"W-What are you trying to do?!" the True Emperor of the Seas cried out, an ominous dread rising deep within its core.
"I heard that you're immortal and cannot be killed, right?" Yuan suddenly remarked. "Well, let's see how you'll deal with this!"
<Forbidden Blood Extraction!>
Yuan activated Forbidden Blood Extraction and started forcibly drawing out the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence.
"T-This is—!? It can't be! You're extracting my Blood Essence?!" the True Emperor of the Seas cried out in panic as it realized what Yuan was doing.

"Your master?" Yuan halted his attacks for the first time and inquired with a raised eyebrow.
"Who is that?"
A hopeful grin appeared on the True Emperor of the Seas after it realized that Yuan wasn't aware of its master.
This meant that there was a chance he would stop attacking if he knew.
"Listen well because I will only say this once!" The True Emperor of the Seas proceeded to announce in a bold and prideful voice, "My master is none other than Morveth!"
"...Who?" Yuan asked without batting an eye at this unfamiliar name.
"Y-You don't know Master Morveth?!
Even though you can wield Eternal Essence?!" The True Emperor of the Seas couldn't believe what was happening.
"So what if I can use Eternal Essence?
Should I automatically know every single Eternal in existence because of that?" Yuan remarked with a sneer.
"But Master Morveth is a Prime Eternal!
Even if you don't know all of the Eternals, there's no way you wouldn't know about the top ten!"
"Prime Eternal?" Yuan raised an eyebrow at this unfamiliar term.
"This is my first time hearing such a title," he said a moment later.
"So the top ten strongest Eternals are called Prime Eternals, huh?" "You really aren't aware of this...?" The True Emperor of the Seas was in disbelief.
He'd never seen anyone so oblivious before.
After a moment of silence, it continued, "Now that you know the identity of my master, do you still dare to attack me?!"

Yuan silently looked at the True Emperor of the Seas before turning to look at the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, who was clearly aware of this and purposefully kept it a secret from him for some reason.
Yet, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas remained silent as it calmly met Yuan's gaze, almost as if it couldn't care less whether he knew about Morveth or not.
The True Emperor of the Seas smiled after seeing their weird interaction and asked, "Did that fat fuck not tell you about my master?
I told you that he was tricking you!
Why don't you help me kill him instead?
I'll be sure to let my master know of your good deeds." Hearing such words, Yuan returned his attention to the True Emperor of the Seas and smiled.
"Morveth?" he muttered.
"I don't care if they're top ten or the strongest Eternal in the universe!
Nothing will stop me from killing you!" Yuan laughed as he continued his relentless assault on the bewildered True Emperor of the Seas.
"Y-You're only saying that because you don't know how powerful my master is!" "Like I said...
I don't care!" The True Emperor of the Seas' attempts at negotiation failed, and with no means of escape, it was reduced to nothing more than prey on the brink of slaughter.
For the first time—despite its immortality and unparalleled regenerative abilities—it felt utterly helpless.
"Fuck!
I am not going to sit here and let you humiliate me like this any longer!"
The True Emperor of the Seas roared in defiance, lashing out in retaliation, yet its efforts were desperate, almost pitiful in their futility.
Several weeks of relentless battle passed before Yuan finally muttered under his breath, "It should be weak enough now..."
The True Emperor of the Seas' regenerative ability had deteriorated to the point where it now required an entire minute to restore even a single tentacle.
"I haven't used this ability since the incident with Bai Xutao, and since I am not in the Nine Heavens, there should be no issue using it now."
Yuan raised his hand and pointed toward the True Emperor of the Seas, drawing in a deep breath as a strange, unfamiliar energy began to surge from within his aura.
The moment the Primal Sovereign of the Seas sensed that aura, its eyes widened in shock.
"That power!
Don't tell me he's going to...!" It immediately understood what Yuan was about to do, and its massive form trembled with excitement.
"W-What are you trying to do?!" the True Emperor of the Seas cried out, an ominous dread rising deep within its core.
"I heard that you're immortal and cannot be killed, right?" Yuan suddenly remarked.
"Well, let's see how you'll deal with this!"
<Forbidden Blood Extraction!>
Yuan activated Forbidden Blood Extraction and started forcibly drawing out the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence.
"T-This is—!?
It can't be!
You're extracting my Blood Essence?!" the True Emperor of the Seas cried out in panic as it realized what Yuan was doing.

chapters.title: Chapter 2396 Defeating the True Emperor of the Seas
paragraphs: "Hahaha! That kid is actually doing it! He's actually forcefully extracting that imposter's Blood Essence!" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas couldn't contain its amusement and burst out laughing.
"That Primal Monarch! He actually gave so much power to a mere human! Just what in heaven's name is he thinking?!"

Before Yuan revealed such a power, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas had not fully believed his claim of being the Primal Monarch's adopted son. Now, after witnessing Yuan wield the power, all doubt vanished like smoke. In fact, the Primal Sovereign of the Seas was even shocked that the Primal Monarch would grant a mere human such a terrifying power. "S-STOP! STOP IT RIGHT THIS INSTANT!" The True Emperor of the Seas exclaimed in terror as it sensed its Blood Essence being formed and forcefully being extracted.
Of course, Yuan completely ignored its plea and continued to extract its Blood Essence.
With no other choice, the True Emperor of the Seas turned and fled in sheer panic. Though it could not escape into the water, it could still try to put distance between itself and Yuan.

It hoisted its massive, severed tentacles into the air and slammed them down like makeshift legs, scrambling away in a sight so desperate and absurd that it would have been laughable were it not so pitiful.

"Hahaha!" The Primal Sovereign of the Seas' laughter grew louder and louder as it watched the True Emperor of the Seas' desperate attempt. As for Yuan, he didn't even bother giving chase and merely muttered a single command.
"Halt."
In an instant, the True Emperor of the Seas obeyed Yuan's command and halted its movements.
"T-This power! Primal Monarch?! What is your relationship with the Primal Monarch?!" The True Emperor of the Seas finally recognized Yuan's frightening power.

"Did the Primal Monarch tell you to do this?! Why?! WHYYY?!" "The Primal Monarch has nothing to do with this," Yuan calmly replied. "As I said from the very beginning, I am here to settle a personal grudge."
"BUT I DON'T EVEN REMEMBER DOING ANYTHING TO YOU!" The True Emperor of the Seas roared in anger.

Yuan suddenly tapped his forehead with a finger, drawing out a dim, glowing orb from within. With a flick of his arm, he sent the orb streaking across the sky before it plunged into the True Emperor of the Seas.
What he had just bestowed upon it was a fragment of his memories—the moment of its own crimes.

After receiving the memory, the True Emperor of the Seas became as stiff as a rock. It was so shocked by the memory's contents that it became a statue. It could hardly believe that a single act—toying with a small group of people out of sheer boredom hundreds of millions of years ago—had led to this very moment... to its current humiliation and impending downfall.
"You're killing me over something like that?! I didn't even kill you!" the True Emperor of the Seas roared, snapping out of its daze.
"No," Yuan replied coldly, "but you killed my partner's family... and I would even say it indirectly led to her death later."

He paused briefly before continuing, his voice lowering. "That said... If I'm being honest, this is nothing more than a petty act of revenge. I was too weak—too pathetic—to do anything back then. So now... I'm making up for that weakness."
"That's utterly ridiculous! Are you really going to invoke the wrath of a Prime Eternal over something like that?!"
"This is not my first time offending an Eternal, and I doubt it will be the last," Yuan admitted.
"SCREW YOOOOUUUU!!!" The True Emperor of the Seas released its loudest roar yet.
The next moment, Yuan finished forming the True Emperor of the Seas' Blood Essence and extracted it.
But instead of consuming it instantly, Yuan stored it inside a glass vial.

"Seeing that you're still alive..." Yuan remarked, his gaze cold as he observed the True Emperor of the Seas' sluggish movements, "I wonder if I can extract more than just a single drop of Blood Essence from you?"
"YOU DARE?!"
"Why wouldn't I dare?!"
Yuan immediately attempted to extract another drop of Blood Essence from the True Emperor of the Seas. However, it felt as though he were trying to squeeze juice from an already dried fruit.
"Most beings can only produce a single drop of Blood Essence in their lifetime," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas suddenly remarked. "If you forcefully try, it'll only devour their longevity."
"Is that so? In that case..."
A cold smile suddenly tugged at Yuan's lips, sending chills down the True Emperor of the Seas' boneless being.
"Let's keep at it until you're dead!" Yuan continued using Forbidden Blood Extraction on the True Emperor of the Seas in an attempt to kill it using this method.
With its Blood Essence forcibly extracted, the True Emperor of the Seas had been weakened to such an extent that it could barely move, let alone resist.
Yet Yuan showed no mercy and continued.
Eventually, with its lifeforce completely drained, the True Emperor of the Seas collapsed onto the surface of the sea, its immense body finally falling still.
However, even after its death, Yuan was not finished with it.
The next moment, Yuan activated another technique.
<Absolute Core Creation!>
Using his second forbidden technique, Yuan turned the True Emperor of the Seas' corpse into a monster core!
Meanwhile, somewhere within the boundless Starry Sky, a certain entity sensed the exact moment the True Emperor of the Seas perished and released a cry filled with piercing anguish.
"Who?! Who dared to kill my cute little pet?!"
This entity immediately set its sights on the direction of the Demonic Realm.
Then, it raised a finger and pointed it toward the world.
"I shall expunge you from this universe! Spear of Extinction!" A radiant glow gathered at its fingertip, swiftly condensing into a spear-like construct before it shot forward.
The attack tore through space itself, piercing the fabric of reality as it traversed the void—hurtling toward Yuan's location at an unimaginable speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 2397 Prime Eternal Morveth
paragraphs: As the Spear of Extinction streaked through the Starry Sky at speeds beyond light itself, anything that came into its path, or even drifted too close, was reduced to nothingness, dispersing like smoke.
In mere moments, hundreds of stars were erased from existence, their light extinguished as though they had never been.
The amount of Eternal Essence that surrounded this attack was immense and several times more powerful than Saaruk's final attack on Yuan.
Because Yuan was currently within the Demonic Realm and not the Nine Heavens, there was no Absolute Power to shield him.
Of course, Yuan remained completely unaware that he had been targeted... or that the attack would reach him within mere minutes.

However, just as the Spear of Extinction was mere moments from reaching the Demonic Realm, a profound and unfathomable energy suddenly enveloped it—halting its advance mid-flight before obliterating it entirely.
Sensing that her attack had been destroyed, Prime Eternal Morveth turned her attention to the individual who had intervened and spoke to them.
"What is the meaning of this, Deemo?" she questioned, addressing this individual as Deemo.
"I should be asking you that, Morveth," Deemo replied, his voice dripping with agitation. "What reason do you have for attempting to destroy my world without provocation?"
"I wasn't trying to destroy your world," she replied calmly. "I was merely punishing the bastard who killed my beloved pet."
"What kind of nonsense is that?" Deemo shot back, his voice rising with anger. "That attack of yours would have torn a hole straight through my entire world!"
"I may have used a bit more power than intended, given my... frustration," she replied, offering a rather half-hearted excuse.
Then, she continued, "Anyway, hand over the bastard who killed my pet, and I'll leave your world alone."

"Hahaha!" Deemo burst into laughter. "Who do you think you are, making demands of me? Don't mistake me for one of those ordinary Eternals you can order around. Have you forgotten? I stand as a Prime Eternal, just like you."
He continued, his voice laced with scorn, "Your pet was killed because it was weak. And yet you seek vengeance for it. Have you no shame, given your status and power?

Morveth sneered with clear disdain. "Had it been slain by some ordinary being from your world, I wouldn't have cared. But it was killed by someone wielding Eternal Essence, which is no different from a direct challenge to me!"
"Oh? Someone who wields Eternal Essence is in my world?" Deemo remarked with intrigue.
Then, he fell silent, presumably to look into his world.
A few moments later, he noticed three distinct and unique individuals in the same location somewhere at the Bloody Expanse.
'That's the Primal Sovereign of the Seas, as well as the old Supreme Ruler Dena... Hmm? A human? In my world? He also looks familiar...'
It took a moment, but Deemo recognized Yuan's face, and his soul, and his expression subtly stiffened.
'T-That human... Tian Chenyu?! When and how did he return to the Demonic Realm?! The gateway between our worlds is still clearly sealed!' he cried inwardly.
He wasn't sure how Yuan appeared in his world, but it was definitely a surprise he wasn't expecting.
'And to think the first thing he does after returning is stir up trouble that nearly destroyed my world...' Deemo sighed.
"I have located and identified the individual who killed your pet," Deemo revealed to Morveth shortly later.
"Then what are you waiting for? Hurry up and hand him over to me, and I will get out of your hair."
"Do you truly expect me to help you for nothing?" Deemo sneered.
"You... What is it that you desire that you cannot already obtain yourself?" Morveth asked, genuine intrigue flickering in her voice.

"It's not about what I want," he replied, a faint smirk tugging at his lips. "It's about what you're willing to offer for my trouble. You see... that individual is quite the nuisance to deal with, so I'll require proper compensation."
"A nuisance? For a Prime Eternal like you? And within your own domain, no less?" she replied, her voice thick with skepticism. "I don't believe that for a second."
"You don't have to believe me, but without proper compensation, I will not do anything for you," Deemo said in a stubborn tone. "...
After a long minute of silence, Morveth asked, "Just out of curiosity, what kind of compensation would you consider proper?"
"Let's see..." Deemo pondered for a moment before responding, "Thirty percent of your territory, as well as ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence."
Morveth's entire body stiffened, her composure cracking as disbelief surged through her upon hearing Deemo's demand.
"Are you out of your damn mind?! What kind of unreasonable compensation is that?! It's not like I am asking you to kill another Prime Eternal for me!" she exclaimed in bewilderment.
"The cost of your earlier transgression will be included in the compensation as well," he added nonchalantly. "In return, I will overlook your attack on my world."
"Deemo, how dare you mock me with such nonsense?! Are you trying to start a war with me?!" Morveth shouted in anger.
"No, I am being super serious with you right now," Deemo replied with a clear voice. "I believe that compensation is needed for me to get involved with that individual."
After a moment of silence, Morveth spoke, her tone sharp with suspicion. "Just who is that bastard, for you to act so hesitant—so cowardly?"

"Don't bother trying to provoke me with such petty tactics, Morveth," Deemo replied coolly. "I am not afraid of him. He is simply... too troublesome to deal with, especially when there is nothing to be gained from it."

"But you're asking for far too much!" she snapped. "Thirty percent of my territory? Ten trillion years' worth of Eternal Essence? Even a dozen Eternals wouldn't be worth that, let alone a single individual! At that point, you might as well demand I become your servant!"
"So, you're refusing my offer?" Deemo asked.
"Of course I am!" she shot back without hesitation. "That's nothing short of robbery! Nobody would be foolish enough to accept it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2398 Acquiring Primal Sovereign of the Seas’ Blood Essence
paragraphs: "I see... so you refuse," Deemo said after Morveth rejected his terms. "In that case, best of luck with your endeavors."
He paused briefly before adding, his tone turning colder, "And I still expect compensation for your aggression toward my world."
"Oh? And what will you do if I refuse?" Morveth asked, her tone laced with provocation.
"I won't allow anyone to attack my territory and walk away unscathed," Deemo replied coldly.
"Even if that individual is a Prime Eternal," he added.
"Do you truly intend to fight me over something so trivial? It's not as though I actually harmed your world," Morveth said.

Though her words suggested a desire to avoid conflict, it was not out of fear. As a Prime Eternal, her strength stood on equal footing with Deemo's, making the outcome of such a clash uncertain. Still, it would be a troublesome ordeal, especially over such insignificant matters.

"It's not about the outcome—it's about the principle," Deemo replied. "If I entered your territory, defiled it, and you were left to clean up after me, would you simply let it go because no lasting damage was done?"

Mervoth rubbed her eyes in a somewhat annoyed manner before speaking again, "Fine, I will compensate you for attacking your world later. As for that person you're protecting for some reason... I'll deal with him later as well, as I am no longer in the mood after dealing with your nonsense."
Deemo let out a cold chuckle before responding, "I am protecting him? That's quite the misunderstanding you have there."
"I don't care what you say. I cannot see it any other way."
Deemo suddenly released a deep sigh and spoke with an odd flicker in his eyes, "That man doesn't need any protection."

After a brief pause, he continued, "Morveth, speaking as someone who has experience with that man before, he's not someone you want to meddle with." "That's exactly what someone who's afraid would say! That bastard killed my pet! I will kill him, no matter the cost!"
Deemo simply shrugged in silence, having already anticipated her refusal to listen.
"I couldn't care less what you do, but do not involve me in your mess, and don't enter or mess with my territory again."
After issuing one final warning, Deemo's presence vanished completely, as though he had never been there at all.
Morveth departed as well, making preparations both to compensate Deemo for her attack on the Demonic Realm... and to deal with Yuan.
Meanwhile, in the Demonic Realm, after Yuan defeated the True Emperor of the Seas and turned it into a monster core, he stored it and its Blood Essence inside his spatial ring.
"I must say, you have far exceeded all of my expectations, son of the Primal Monarch," the Primal Sovereign of the Seas said, approaching Yuan with a satisfied grin on its round face.
"Though that impostor was weakened during my pursuit, I have little doubt you would have defeated him with relative ease even at full strength," it added.
Yuan turned to face the Primal Sovereign of the Seas and let out a quiet sigh.
"So you were wary of the Prime Eternal backing that squid, huh? I should've known... No, perhaps I did know and simply chose to accept it."
"Can you blame me? I cannot even handle an ordinary Eternal, let alone a Prime Eternal. Anyway, as promised, I shall bestow you my Blood Essence for getting rid of that nuisance."
The Primal Sovereign of the Seas immediately extracted its own Blood Essence and offered it to Yuan.

Yuan raised an eyebrow at how quickly the Primal Sovereign of the Seas produced its Blood Essence since it was something that usually required a tremendous amount of time and energy to create, almost as if it had prepared it in advance.

"It was a pleasure meeting you, son of the Primal Monach."

And hovering not far away from him was a single silhouette, silently staring at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 2399 A Brief Conversation With the Demon God
paragraphs: The first thing that came to Yuan's mind when seeing this silhouette was Prime Eternal Morveth, as he'd just killed her pet, the True Emperor of the Seas.
"Are you Morveth?" he asked out loud.
"What?" The silhouette immediately frowned at Yuan's question and said, "I know it's been a while since our last encounter, but to think you'd forgotten about me already."
Yuan raised an eyebrow at this familiar voice and quickly corrected himself, "You are... the Demon God?"
"I wasn't expecting you to approach me first, much less this soon," he added.
The Demon God slowly raised an arm and rubbed his eyes before speaking, "Do you have any idea what sort of trouble you've just caused for me?"
"Trouble...?" Yuan tilted his head with a puzzled look on his face, as he was unaware of Prime Eternal Morveth's earlier attack.

"Because you killed Morveth's little pet within my territory, she launched an attack on this world," the Demon God revealed, his tone calm yet heavy. "Had I not intervened... this entire realm would have been erased just now."
"Seriously...?" Yuan muttered, momentarily dazed. He had never expected Prime Eternal Morveth to retaliate so swiftly, nor had he realized how close he had come to death just moments ago.
"So you protected me? Thanks."
"What? Don't get it twisted," the Demon God sneered, his tone sharp with displeasure. "I didn't do it for you. I simply protected my world."
"Either way, I'm still alive because of your actions," he chuckled lightly. "So, in a sense... You did protect me."
"And to think we once fought each other with our lives on the line," Yuan suddenly remarked.
"Hahaha!" The Demon God burst into laughter. "You really do enjoy rewriting history, don't you? My life was never at risk back then, and it was yours that hung by a thread."

"Enough reminiscing," the Demon God suddenly said, his tone turning cold. "I didn't come here for that. I'm here to remind you that you owe me—for the trouble you've caused just now, and for entering my domain without permission, which is a direct violation of our agreement."
"How did you even enter my world? The gateway is still sealed," he then asked.

Yuan shrugged, "Honestly, I don't know. I was in my personal world before coming here, and it was never my intention to come here, so it was an accident." "Bastard... you created a pathway from your personal world to my world? Just what are you planning?" The Demon God narrowed his eyes at Yuan.
Yuan merely shook his head and explained, "I don't remember. As you can probably tell, I am not the same Tian Chenyu who fought you in the past. I am his reincarnation."
"That explains why your soul is so much stronger than before," the Demon God sucked his teeth in annoyance.
"Anyway, it's true that I owe you for saving me, but what do you want from me?" Yuan then asked.
"Frankly, there's nothing you can give me that I don't already have or can't acquire myself, nor is there anything you can do for me right now, so I will collect this debt later."
"That's fine too, I guess."
Yuan then asked, "By the way, what happened to Prime Eternal Morveth?"
"I chased her away for now, but she will definitely get her revenge one way or another. That said, as long as you're within the Demonic Realm, I doubt she will try to attack again."
"In that case, I'll stay here for a little longer," Yuan said in a joking voice.
The Demon God fell silent.
"What? Are you going to kick me out of the Demonic Realm because I came back here without your permission?"
"I had considered removing you," the Demon God said, his voice calm yet deliberate, "but there is something about you that intrigues me. So, I will allow you to remain here a while longer."

Yuan raised a brow but said nothing. Though the Demon God could have easily asked whatever piqued his curiosity, Yuan chose to remain silent. After all, this gave him the chance to stay in the Demonic Realm a little longer.
"I will be keeping a close eye on you... Tian Chenyu."
After saying that, the crimson world immediately collapsed, and the Demon God vanished into thin air.
"Yuan! Are you okay? What happened just now?" The moment Yuan was released from the crimson sphere, Supreme Ruler Dena rushed to his side, a rare look of concern evident on her face.
"As you can see, I am perfectly fine," he responded with a calm smile on his face.
"I just had a small conversation with the Demon God, that's all," he added.
"What did you just say?!" Supreme Ruler Dena and Lev exclaimed in unison.
"How can you say something that shocking so casually, as if it were nothing?!" Lev added, his voice filled with disbelief.
"You just spoke with the Demon God? Really?" Even Supreme Ruler Dena found it difficult to believe.
However, when she recalled how her full-power attack had failed to leave even a scratch on that barrier, the possibility no longer seemed so far-fetched.
"Yes," Yuan confirmed with a slight nod.

The two of them could only stare at Yuan in stunned silence, their mouths slightly agape. Though countless questions burned at the tip of their tongues, they dared not ask. After all, it would be like a mere servant inquiring what a general had discussed with the emperor.
"So... what now?" Lev asked after a long moment of silence.
"We resume whatever we were doing before meeting the Primal Sovereign of the Seas," Yuan said.
They nodded before continuing their journey across the Bloody Expanse.
Several months later, they had ventured far enough that the Sea Devils were no longer in hiding and began launching attacks on them.
Seeing this, Yuan thought of something and retrieved the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence.
The moment the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' aura appeared, the Sea Devils immediately stopped attacking and went into hiding, allowing them to travel in peace again.

chapters.title: Chapter 2400 Leaving the Bloody Expanse
paragraphs: With the Primal Sovereign of the Seas' Blood Essence keeping the Sea Devils away, Yuan and his group were able to traverse the rest of the Bloody Expanse in peace.
After several more years of travel, they finally reached land.

However, before actually entering the land, Yuan asked out loud, "Hey, Dena, will it be fine for you to walk around without any disguise? You're supposed to be inside the Deprived Crimson Valley, after all."
"There's no point in disguising myself. They'll discover that I've left sooner or later. In fact, I wouldn't be surprised if they already know," she replied calmly. "Besides... It's a hassle."
"Even so, it'll help us avoid detection for the time being," Yuan insisted. "You're still recovering, so it's better if you conceal yourself for now."

Had Supreme Ruler Dena been at full strength, such precautions would have been unnecessary. But in her current state, Yuan had no desire to deal with the current Supreme Ruler. More importantly, he wanted to avoid unnecessary trouble before fully understanding the circumstances behind her exile and the current state of the world.
"Fine..."

Supreme Ruler Dena let out a soft sigh before shifting her appearance, her hair turning pitch black as her figure grew several inches taller, and her presence transformed into something barely noticeable.
"What about me?" Lev suddenly asked aloud.
Yuan turned to look at him with raised eyebrows.
"Sorry, that was a dumb question..." An awkward smile tugged at Lev's lips when he realized that he was essentially a nobody.
"What about you?" Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly said to Yuan. "You will cause misunderstandings if you walk around like tha."
Yuan looked down at his own body and replied, "Is it because I look like a noble?"
She quietly nodded.
"In that case..." Unlike Supreme Ruler Dena, Yuan had to swallow an appearance-altering pill to change his appearance.
Moments later, Yuan transformed into a red-skinned Lower Demon.
Shortly after, they departed the crimson sea and entered a harbor at its very edge, one that belonged to a medium-sized city known as the City of Devils.
Upon arrival, Yuan extended his divine sense, sweeping it across the entire city in an instant.

There were just over ten million inhabitants, the majority of them Lower Demons. While the sheer population was already surprising for a city of this size, what truly caught Yuan off guard was that more than half of them had already reached the God Ascension realm.
'The number of God Ascension demons in this medium-sized city alone likely surpasses the entire population of God Ascension cultivators within the Nine Heavens! And this is just one city!'

Thanks to their immortality, demons were free from one of humanity's greatest limitations—their finite lifespan. With eternity at their disposal, they never had to fear running out of time before reaching the next realm.
Moreover, demons were inherently superior to humans in terms of physique and bloodline, granting them a natural advantage in cultivation.
Where humans required extraordinary talent to ascend to higher realms like the God Ascension Realm, demons could do so with far greater ease.
Seeing such an overwhelming number of demons at this level, Yuan could easily imagine them sweeping across the Nine Heavens should they ever choose to invade.
Fortunately, these demons were not Forsaken and had no reason nor desire to invade another world.
Once they were inside the city, Yuan looked at the two and asked, "Now, where should we begin? How does one acquire information in this world?"
"Well, it depends on what sort of information you're after. For general questions, just about anyone can help. But for lucrative intel like what you seek, you'll need the Crimson Brokers."
"Where can we find them?" Yuan asked.
"There's at least one stationed in almost every city. In a medium-sized city like this, they're almost certainly here. They usually wear a black robe with a crimson symbol on their chest."
Yuan used his divine sense to scan the entire city again.
"I found him. Let's go."
Some time later, Yuan and his companions approached a black‐robed figure loitering in a shadowy alley, looking extremely suspicious.
"Hey, are you a Crimson Broker?" Yuan asked as he calmly approached the individual.
"Why are you asking?" The Crimson Broker asked.
"I'm looking for information on a certain individual.
"What's their reputation like?"
"One of the most famous—or infamous individuals in this world."
"In that case, there's likely no need for an investigation. Who is this person? And what sort of information are you looking for?"
"She's Supreme Ruler—" Yuan abruptly halted his speech when he remembered that Supreme Ruler Dena's name was forbidden.
"Ahem," he cleared his throat before restarting, "She used to be a Supreme Ruler, and her name is one that cannot be uttered. I want to know what she did that caused her to be—"
"W-Wait!" the Crimson Broker suddenly interrupted him. "If you're talking about 'that' Supreme Ruler, then you can forget it because I cannot help you!"
Without elaborating, the Crimson Broker hastily left the scene the next second.
"Looks like this will be more difficult than I initially anticipated..." Yuan sighed out loud after a moment of silence.
He turned to look at Lev and asked, "What now? Is there anyone else who can provide us with the information we seek?"
"Well..." Lev started, his gaze shifting to Supreme Ruler Dena. "Considering how that Crimson Broker reacted just now, I doubt we'll be able to gather information on 'her' through normal means."
"Although Crimson Brokers aren't official informants, they just skirt the edges of shady. As for those in the shadows who are willing to do anything for money... I only know of the Abyssal Council."
"Great. Where can we find them?" Yuan asked without hesitation and a single ounce of fear in his voice.
"Um... sorry, but I have no clue. I am only aware of their existence," Lev said while shaking his head.
However, before Yuan could respond, Supreme Ruler Dena suddenly spoke, "I know where we can find the Abyssal Council."
